title.en: In West Bank, date farmers weigh impact of UK sanctions on Israeli settlers
title.zh: 在约旦河西岸，椰枣农权衡英国制裁以色列定居者的影响

summary.en: Palestinians strongly back a ban on settlement goods, but Israel's government says it is a "big mistake".
summary.zh: 巴勒斯坦人坚决支持禁止定居者商品，但以色列政府称这是“一个大错误”。

body.en:
Juicy brown and ripening yellow dates dangle down from the branches of each palm tree at Israeli settler farms in the Jordan Valley, in the occupied West Bank.

This year, as Israeli growers get ready for a good harvest, they are also preparing for the impact of new Western sanctions against settlements, which are illegal under international law.

The UK government has announced an import ban on settlement goods and said it planned to take action against companies and individuals who provide services for settlement expansion, as part of what it calls a "comprehensive reset" of policy towards Israel following similar moves by several other European countries.

Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain and Sweden have also confirmed their intention to introduce national restrictions, or support European restrictions, on trade in goods with settlements.

Palestinians strongly back such a move, but Israel's foreign minister called it "hostile" and announced a series of counter measures, including the closure of the British consulate in East Jerusalem.

Israeli date farmer Avigdor Arbel, from the settlement of Mesua, calls such boycotts "really disgusting".

Arbel sells his produce mostly to Europe but also to the US and now, India. However, he says the sector is ready for any new UK ban on settler goods.

"As soon as we have a situation of pressure and boycotts, we always break out and look for other markets," he tells me. "So, I believe that if we get to a situation in which there's no place to sell my fruits in Europe, we'll find other markets."

West Bank settlements have expanded rapidly under the current Israeli government, whose ministers say they want "to bury the idea" of an independent Palestinian state - part of the long-standing international formula for peace in the region known as the two-state solution.

At the same time, settler violence against Palestinians has surged to what the UN says is "an all-time high".

With new settler outposts - which are also illegal under Israeli law - now dotting the barren hilltops of the Jordan Valley, there have been repeated attacks on local Palestinians, particularly Bedouin and herding communities.

In January, the last of some 600 villagers fled their homes in Ras Ein al-Ouja after intense harassment by hardline settlers, often backed by Israeli security forces. It was the largest single displacement of a Palestinian community in the past three years.

Further north, in March, Israeli settlers brutally beat and sexually assaulted a Palestinian shepherd during a night raid on Khirbet Humsa.

British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told Parliament on Tuesday that a set of facts on the ground had been created "to make the two-state solution unviable," while...
body.zh: 在被占领的西岸约旦河谷的以色列定居者农场，多汁的棕色和成熟的黄色枣子从每棵棕榈树的树枝上垂下来。 今年，当以色列种植者为丰收做好准备时，他们也在准备应对西方对定居点新制裁的影响，根据国际法，这些制裁是非法的。 英国政府宣布对定居点商品实施进口禁令，并表示计划对为定居点扩张提供服务的公司和个人采取行动，这是继其他几个欧洲国家采取类似举措后对以色列政策“全面重置”的一部分。 加拿大、丹麦、芬兰、法国、冰岛、爱尔兰、挪威、波兰、葡萄牙、西班牙和瑞典也已确认有意对定居点货物贸易实行国家限制或支持欧洲限制。 巴勒斯坦人强烈支持此举，但以色列外长称其为“敌对”，并宣布了一系列反制措施，包括关闭英国驻东耶路撒冷领事馆。 来自梅苏阿定居点的以色列枣农阿维格多·阿贝尔 (Avigdor Arbel) 称此类抵制“真的令人作呕”。 阿贝尔的产品主要销往欧洲，但也销往美国，现在又销往印度。不过，他表示，该行业已准备好应对英国对定居者商品的任何新禁令。 “一旦遇到压力和抵制的情况，我们总是会爆发并寻找其他市场，”他告诉我。 “所以，我相信，如果我们遇到在欧洲没有地方出售我的水果的情况，我们会寻找其他市场。” 在现任以色列政府的领导下，西岸定居点迅速扩大，以色列部长们表示，他们希望“埋葬”独立巴勒斯坦国的想法——这是该地区长期存在的国际和平方案的一部分，即两国解决方案。 与此同时，定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力已飙升至联合国所说的“历史最高水平”。 随着新的定居者前哨基地——根据以色列法律这也是非法的——现在遍布约旦河谷的贫瘠山顶，当地巴勒斯坦人，特别是贝都因人和牧民社区不断遭到袭击。 一月份，在遭到强硬派定居者（通常得到以色列安全部队支持）的强烈骚扰后，大约 600 名村民中的最后一批人逃离了 Ras Ein al-Ouja 的家园。这是过去三年来巴勒斯坦社区最大规模的一次流离失所事件。 再往北，三月份，以色列定居者在对基尔贝特·胡姆萨 (Khirbet Humsa) 的夜间袭击中残酷殴打并性侵犯了一名巴勒斯坦牧羊人。 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德周二告诉议会，已经制造了一系列事实，“使两国解决方案不可行”，同时……

reflection.en: The UK's import ban on settlement goods, while welcomed by Palestinians, highlights the ongoing debate over international law and the rights of those affected by settlement expansion. This action can be seen as an attempt to speak for those whose voices are often marginalized in such geopolitical conflicts.
reflection.zh: 英国禁止进口定居者商品，虽然受到巴勒斯坦人的欢迎，但凸显了关于国际法和受定居点扩张影响者的权利的持续辩论。这一行动可以被视为一种尝试，为那些在如此地缘政治冲突中声音常常被边缘化的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Russia says it will give a ‘harsh and painful’ response after Hungary expels 10 diplomats - Europe live
title.zh: 乌克兰总检察长因腐败指控辞职，俄罗斯恢复对基辅的袭击

summary.en: Ukraine's Prosecutor General, Ruslan Kravchenko, has resigned following allegations of corruption, which led to searches of his offices. This development coincides with Russia's resumption of attacks on Kyiv after a pause for peace talks, with local authorities reporting 12 people injured in the morning's strikes.
summary.zh: 乌克兰总检察长鲁斯兰·克拉夫琴科在面临腐败指控后辞职，其办公室周末遭到搜查。此前，莫斯科在暂停和平谈判后恢复了对基辅的袭击，当地官员称今晨的袭击已造成12人受伤。

body.en: Moscow’s foreign minister issues warning to ‘Russophobic lobby in Budapest’ after diplomats expelled for ‘unacceptable’ activities But the tone coming from Moscow is very different, as Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov told reporters that Russia was very confident that victory in its war against Ukraine is “very near.” “Yes, we are ​confident, and we ⁠are ​sure that ​victory ​is very near,” ​Peskov ‌said in comments reported by Reuters. Continue reading...
body.zh: 鲁斯兰·克拉夫琴科 (Ruslan Kravchenko) 的办公室在周末遭到搜查后离职，莫斯科在和平谈判暂停后重新发动袭击。地方当局称，今晨基辅袭击事件中受伤人数已增至 12 人。市长表示，两名窃贼闯入法国南部一座纪念法国印象派画家皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿的博物馆，偷走了四件艺术品，并在逃跑时掉落了一件。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of national crisis, the integrity of leadership is paramount. The resignation of Ukraine's Prosecutor General amid corruption allegations, while the nation faces renewed attacks, underscores the deep human yearning for justice and accountability. True leadership, as the prophet Micah reminds us, is found in acting justly, loving mercy, and walking...
reflection.zh: 在国家危机时刻，领导层的廉洁至关重要。乌克兰总检察长在面临腐败指控时辞职，而国家又面临新的袭击，这凸显了人们对公正和问责的深切渴望。正如先知弥迦提醒我们的，真正的领导力在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，即使在冲突和内部分歧之中。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Israel to close UK consulate in Jerusalem after sanctions against illegal settlements – UK politics live
title.zh: 美驻英大使警告，因非法以色列定居点制裁可能损害英美贸易

summary.en: The UK is set to reassert its support for Palestinian rights and a two-state solution, a move that has drawn criticism from the US and Israel. The UK plans to adopt a tougher stance on Israel by banning trade with illegal settlements. A Labour MP has warned that this proposed ban could increase the risk to British...
summary.zh: 英国将重申对巴勒斯坦权利和两国方案的支持，此举招致了美国和以色列的批评。英国计划采取更强硬的对以立场，禁止与非法定居点进行贸易。一位工党议员警告说，拟议中的贸易禁令可能会增加英国犹太人面临的风险，他担心以色列的反对者可能无法区分以色列政府的政策、犹太复国主义的政治理念和英国犹太人，从而可能导致更多袭击。

body.en: Foreign minister, Gideon Saar, claims UK ‘systemically working against the state of Israel’ as MPs including Jeremy Corbyn are also banned from country UK accuses Israeli ‘terrorists’ of ethnic cleansing in West Bank with government backing The Liberal Democrats say they have been granted a Commons urgent question today about t he latest Argentinian threats to the Falkland Islands . A Foreign Office minister will be responding at about 12.30pm. Isaac Herzog , the Israeli president, has said that Britain will be “on the wrong side of history” if it goes ahead with plans to ban trade with the illegal settlements on the West Bank. Later today, we expect to see headlines announcing certain British trade sanctions on Israeli settlements in Judea and Samaria. If this happens – and other nations may join – I believe it will prove to be a grave miscalculation, a decision that will fall on the wrong side of history. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国重申支持巴勒斯坦权利和两国解决方案，此举招致美国和以色列的批评 英国将对以色列采取更强硬立场，禁止非法定居点贸易 一名工党议员警告称，拟议的禁止与约旦河西岸以色列非法定居点进行贸易的提议可能会增加英国犹太人面临的风险。以色列工党之友副主席彼得·普林斯利在接受《今日》节目采访时表示：我担心以色列的反对者不会区分以色列政府政策、犹太复国主义政治哲学和英国犹太人。就他们而言，整个事情都是一样的，我认为这确实存在增加对英国犹太社区的攻击机会的风险。这正是两三晚前我被要求见埃德·米利班德时对他说的。我认为时机太糟糕了。我认为我们需要等待以色列选举的结果，然后我们需要再考虑一下。我们必须尽一切努力维护两国解决方案，我认为目前当选的以色列政府在这方面的行为确实令人愤慨。我有一种可怕的感觉，我们正在做的事情不仅会增强内塔尼亚胡现任政府的气焰，而且有能力影响选举本身，而选举本身正处于危险之中。我们认为这是一种表演姿态。很难区分来自约旦河西岸地区和以色列其他地区的货物。所以实际上，实施起来非常困难。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The proposed trade ban on Israeli settlements raises complex geopolitical issues, but also a deeply human concern: the potential for increased antisemitism. The MP's warning about the risk to British Jews underscores the need to protect vulnerable communities. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all those who...
reflection.zh: 拟议中的以色列定居点贸易禁令引发了复杂的地缘政治问题，但也带来了一个人性化的深切担忧：反犹主义可能加剧。这位议员关于英国犹太人面临风险的警告，凸显了保护弱势群体的必要性。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“要为贫穷的人和一切孤苦无告的人伸冤，为他们辩屈。”这一原则不仅适用于受定居点影响的巴勒斯坦人，也适用于面临潜在反弹的犹太社区。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Recovery from UK flight disruption ‘will take some time’, as several airports affected – business live
title.zh: 也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施，油价逼近每桶100美元

summary.en: Saudi authorities reported that operations at some energy facilities were halted following attacks by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis, which injured over 70 people. This event has caused oil prices to approach $100 a barrel, increasing pressure on European countries to secure energy supplies before winter.
summary.zh: 沙特当局称，也门伊朗支持的胡塞武装袭击了部分能源设施，导致70多人受伤，部分设施的运营已暂停。此次袭击导致油价逼近每桶100美元，给需要在冬季前储备能源的欧洲国家带来了压力。

body.en: National Air Traffic Services apologise for technical issue disrupting departures today Air traffic control issue causes flight delays and disruption across UK Gas prices are rising this morning, putting pressure on European countries who need to stock up their storage levels before the winter. The month-ahead UK gas price is up around 1% at 184p a therm, close to yesterday’s highs when gas hit its highest since January 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 早上好，欢迎收看我们对商业、金融市场和世界经济的滚动报道。 随着中东冲突的持续，全球经济再次面临每桶100美元的油价前景。 布伦特原油本周已回升至每桶 98 美元大关，为 7 月 24 日以来的最高水平。有报道称也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装袭击了沙特阿拉伯的能源设施，从而推高了油价。 沙特当局表示，在也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装发动袭击造成 70 多人受伤后，一些能源设施的运营已于今天停止。 这些袭击增加了该地区石油和天然气生产的压力，该地区仍然受到正在进行的伊朗战争的严重干扰。 今天早些时候，伊朗威胁称，如果美国继续对德黑兰实施“经济战”，伊朗将在海湾地区设立新的禁区。 这样的区域可能会进一步破坏美国重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的努力。 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书穆赫森·礼扎伊表示，伊朗已经“从根本上重新调整”了对美军的态度。 近日来，华盛顿收到了伊朗新型导弹的明确警告。经济战将通过波斯湾到封锁周边的海上禁区来应对。针对美国军舰和基地的作战姿态已经从根本上重新调整。 本周通过霍尔木兹海峡的航运交通已经放缓——周一只有七艘商品船通过霍尔木兹海峡，低于周日的八艘。战争开始前，每天约有130艘船只穿越海峡。 这对央行行长来说都是一个令人头疼的问题，因为高油价会给经济带来通胀压力。今天晚些时候，伦敦议员将质询英格兰银行行长安德鲁·贝利 (Andrew Bailey) 及其同事最近将银行利率维持在 3.75% 的决定。 该委员会表示，议员们可能会向证人询问伊朗正在进行的战争对通胀的潜在影响，以及货币政策委员会如何看待人工智能的最新发展。 英国夏令时下午 2.15 点：英格兰银行政策制定者出席财政部特别委员会会议

reflection.en: The news of attacks on Saudi energy facilities and the subsequent rise in oil prices paints a picture of global instability and economic pressure. In times of such conflict and uncertainty, Psalm 46:9 reminds us that Yahweh is the ultimate power who brings an end to warfare and dismantles weapons. It offers a perspective of hope beyond human conflict,...
reflection.zh: 关于也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施以及随后油价上涨的新闻，描绘了一幅全球动荡和经济压力的图景。在这样的冲突和不确定时期，《诗篇》46:9提醒我们，雅伟是终结战争、拆毁武器的终极力量。它提供了一种超越人类冲突的希望视角，指向神圣的干预与和平。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Democrats hit back at Trump after president floats changing name of New Mexico to ‘New America’ - US politics live
title.zh: 民主党人回击特朗普，此前总统曾提议将新墨西哥州更名为“新美国”——美国政治直播

summary.en: A state senator is among politicians pushing back against the president's social media post suggesting New Mexico should be renamed 'New America.' Meanwhile, in New Hampshire, the Democratic primary for Chris Pappas's House seat features eight candidates, with Republicans seeing the traditionally Democratic district...
summary.zh: 州参议员是抨击总统社交媒体帖子、建议将新墨西哥州更名为“新美国”的政界人士之一。与此同时，在新罕布什尔州，克里斯·帕帕斯的众议院席位民主党初选有八名候选人，共和党人认为这个传统上属于民主党的选区有可能被翻转，唐纳德·特朗普已endorse了一位共和党候选人。

body.en: State senator among politicians hitting back at president’s social media post saying New Mexico should be change to ‘New America’ Sign up for US Breaking News emails Further down the ballot in New Hampshire, the Democratic primary for Chris Pappas’s House seat has drawn eight candidates, with Stefany Shaheen – daughter of the outgoing senator – and Maura Sullivan , a former Obama administration official, leading the field. The district, long purple, has been reliably blue since 2017. Republicans now see it as flippable, and Donald Trump has endorsed Anthony DiLorenzo , a businessman who owns several car dealerships, in the GOP race. Continue reading...
body.zh: 政界人士中的州参议员回击总统的社交媒体帖子，称新墨西哥州应该改为“新美国”。在新罕布什尔州的投票中，克里斯·帕帕斯众议院席位的民主党初选已经吸引了八名候选人，其中即将卸任参议员的女儿斯蒂芬妮·沙欣和前奥巴马政府官员莫拉·沙利文领先。这个长紫色的选区自 2017 年以来一直是可靠的蓝色。共和党人现在认为它是可以翻转的，唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在共和党竞选中支持拥有多家汽车经销店的商人安东尼·迪洛伦佐 (Anthony DiLorenzo)。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Disputes over names and symbols, like the suggestion to rename New Mexico, often reflect deeper debates about national identity and values. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that a nation's moral character is foundational to its flourishing. Political discourse can easily become a battle of egos, but the enduring health of a society depends on its commitment to...
reflection.zh: 关于名称和象征的争论，例如将新墨西哥州更名的提议，常常反映出对国家身份和价值观的更深层次辩论。《箴言》14:34 提醒我们，一个国家的道德品格是其繁荣的基础。政治言论很容易变成一场自负的较量，但社会的持久健康取决于其对公义的承诺。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Netanyahu was warned of 7 October Hamas attacks, book claims
title.zh: 书称内塔尼亚胡在 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击前收到警告

summary.en: A book by Israeli journalists claims that the president of the United Arab Emirates warned Benjamin Netanyahu about a large-scale Hamas offensive more than a week before the October 7, 2023 attack. Netanyahu has denied this, calling the allegation an 'absolute lie.' The report has led to opposition calls for him to be...
summary.zh: 以色列记者的一本书声称，阿拉伯联合酋长国总统在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯发动大规模袭击前一周多就发出了警告。内塔尼亚胡否认了这一说法，称其为“彻头彻尾的谎言”。该报道已引发反对派要求宣布其不适合担任总理的呼声。

body.en: Israeli PM says allegation that UAE president alerted him more than a week before major offensive is ‘absolute lie’ Benjamin Netanyahu was personally alerted by the president of the United Arab Emirates that Hamas was planning a large-scale offensive against Israel a week before its 7 October 2023 attack, but did not act on the warning, according to a book by Haaretz reporters. The claim, which comes amid a crucial election campaign, prompted Israeli opposition leaders to describe the prime minister as “unfit” for office, even as Netanyahu denounced the report as an “absolute lie” and denied he spoke to the Emirati leader at that time. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据《国土报》记者出版的一本书称，以色列总理表示，有关阿联酋总统在重大进攻一周多前向他发出警报的指控“绝对是谎言”。阿拉伯联合酋长国总统亲自向本杰明·内塔尼亚胡发出警告，称哈马斯正计划在 2023 年 10 月 7 日发动袭击前一周对以色列发动大规模进攻，但他没有按照警告采取行动。这一说法是在一场关键的竞选活动中提出的，促使以色列反对派领导人称总理“不适合”担任职务，尽管内塔尼亚胡谴责该报告是“绝对的谎言”，并否认他当时与阿联酋领导人交谈过。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news raises profound questions about leadership and accountability. When warnings are allegedly ignored, the consequences can be devastating. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that leaders are called to uphold justice and integrity, for 'Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people.' The pursuit of truth and accountability is essential for...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻引发了关于领导力和问责制的深刻问题。当警告据称被忽视时，后果可能是毁灭性的。《箴言》16:12 提醒我们，领导者被呼召要维护公正和正直，“恶事会使君王败坏；因为审判会使国家兴旺。”追求真相和问责制对任何社会的福祉都至关重要。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
title.zh: 俄无人机袭击乌克兰电视台大楼，基辅已致五人死亡

summary.en: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of the We Are Ukraine TV channel in Kyiv while it was broadcasting live, resulting in at least five deaths and injuries, according to President Zelensky. This attack occurred despite a recent agreement for a three-day halt to strikes on each other's capitals.
summary.zh: 据泽连斯基总统称，一架俄罗斯无人机在“我们是乌克兰”电视台直播期间袭击了该频道位于基辅的总部，造成至少五人死亡和受伤。此次袭击发生之际，两国此前曾同意在为期三天内停止袭击对方首都。

body.en:
A Russian drone has struck a Ukrainian TV channel headquarters in Kyiv, injuring at least five people as journalists were broadcasting live, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

Zelensky said the daytime attack was a "new page in Russian degradation", while photos shared by the president show a partially collapsed building.

At least five people have been killed in overnight and daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv, while a separate attack on a passenger train in southern Ukraine killed a female employee, officials have said.

Both countries had earlier agreed to halt strikes on each other's capitals for three days while US Donald Trump's top envoys visited Moscow and Kyiv over the weekend.

Referring to Tuesday's Russian drone attack on the Ukrainian TV channel We Are Ukraine, Zelensky said: "Today, Russia carried out a strike on the media, journalists.

"Russia must be stopped, and this is possible only through joint efforts," he added in a renewed plea to Ukraine's allies in Europe, the US and around the world.

Earlier on Tuesday, air raid alerts warned civilians to seek shelter as Russian forces carried out missile and drone strikes on Kyiv, the local authorities said.

A series of explosions across Ukraine's capital overnight killed three people and injured another 25, the state emergencies service DSNS said.

Residential buildings were hit, including a five-storey house in the Solomianskyi district, while vehicles caught fire in the Podilskyi district.

People sought shelter inside a metro station in Kyiv during the overnight attack, something that is routine for residents protecting themselves during the ongoing war.

According to a BBC Verify analysis , Kyiv is suffering more daily air raid alerts than at any time since Russia's full-scale invasion.

In Russia, buildings were struck in the city of Saratov during a Ukrainian drone attack, its regional governor Roman Busargin said early on Tuesday.

The talks with Trump's top envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Moscow and Kyiv ended without any major breakthroughs.

Zelensky said he expected the war to continue into the winter, following the envoys' first visit to Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.

In Moscow, President Vladimir Putin's senior adviser Yuriy Ushakov said the US envoys were informed about "the significant advances made by the Russian armed forces" on the battlefield and stressed that the Kremlin's "set objectives would be achieved".

Putin has so far showed no sign of backing down from his maximalist demands, which included more territorial concessions from Ukraine.

Meanwhile, Witkoff said that "substantive progress was made", without giving any further details.

Zelensky told reporters they had agreed that officials from Ukraine, Europe and America would...
body.zh: 总统泽连斯基表示，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了位于基辅的乌克兰电视频道总部，造成至少五人受伤，当时记者正在现场直播。 泽伦斯基表示，白天的袭击是“俄罗斯退化的新一页”，而总统分享的照片显示一座部分倒塌的建筑。 官员称，俄罗斯在夜间和白天对基辅发动的袭击已造成至少五人死亡，而乌克兰南部一列客运列车的另一次袭击导致一名女雇员死亡。 两国早些时候同意停止对对方首都的袭击三天，而美国唐纳德·特朗普的高级特使周末访问了莫斯科和基辅。 在谈到周二俄罗斯无人机对乌克兰电视频道“我们是乌克兰”的袭击时，泽连斯基说：“今天，俄罗斯对媒体、记者进行了袭击。 他在再次向乌克兰在欧洲、美国和世界各地的盟友发出的呼吁中补充道：“必须阻止俄罗斯，而这只有通过共同努力才有可能实现。” 当地政府表示，周二早些时候，俄罗斯军队对基辅发动导弹和无人机袭击，空袭警报警告平民寻求庇护。 国家紧急服务机构 DSNS 称，乌克兰首都一夜之间发生一系列爆炸，造成 3 人死亡、25 人受伤。 索洛米扬斯基区的住宅楼遭到袭击，包括一栋五层楼的房屋，波多利斯基区的车辆起火。 在夜间袭击期间，人们在基辅的一个地铁站内寻求庇护，这对于居民在持续的战争期间保护自己来说是例行公事。 根据英国广播公司验证分析，基辅每天收到的空袭警报比俄罗斯全面入侵以来的任何时候都要多。 俄罗斯萨拉托夫市州长罗曼·布萨金周二早些时候表示，在一次乌克兰无人机袭击中，该市的建筑物遭到袭击。 与特朗普高级特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳在莫斯科和基辅的会谈结束时没有取得任何重大突破。 泽连斯基表示，自俄罗斯 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰以来，特使们首次访问乌克兰，预计战争将持续到冬季。 在莫斯科，弗拉基米尔·普京总统的高级顾问尤里·乌沙科夫表示，美国特使获悉“俄罗斯武装部队在战场上取得的重大进展”，并强调克里姆林宫的“既定目标将会实现”。 到目前为止，普京还没有表现出放弃其最高要求的迹象，其中包括乌克兰做出更多领土让步。 与此同时，威特科夫表示“取得了实质性进展”，但没有透露任何进一步的细节。 泽伦斯基告诉记者，他们已经同意乌克兰、欧洲和美国的官员将...

reflection.en: The relentless cycle of violence in Ukraine continues to inflict suffering. As journalists broadcast, a drone strike shatters the ordinary, a stark reminder of the temptation to meet aggression with more aggression. Yet, the ancient call remains: 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.' This is a difficult path, especially for those caught...
reflection.zh: 乌克兰冲突中无休止的暴力循环仍在造成苦难。当记者们进行直播时，无人机袭击打破了平静，这 stark地提醒人们以暴制暴的诱惑。然而，古老的呼召依然存在：“不要被邪恶打败，反而要用善来打败邪恶。”这是一条艰难的道路，尤其对于那些身处战火中的人们，但它是打破毁灭性链条的唯一途径。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Sudan's healthcare system on brink of collapse after cuts, medical charity warns
title.zh: 苏丹医疗系统因削减资金而濒临崩溃，医学慈善机构发出警告

summary.en: Médecins Sans Frontières is urging world leaders to increase funding to help the millions who need aid.
summary.zh: 无国界医生组织敦促世界领导人增加资金，以帮助数百万需要援助的人。

body.en:
Sudan's fragile health system is on the brink of collapse as global funding cuts have led to the closure of healthcare facilities across the country, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has warned.

Dozens of organisations were unable to find alternative funding after the US - the largest donor to Sudan - closed USAID, its body for delivering foreign aid, last year, the medical charity said.

MSF urged world leaders gathering at the UN General Assembly in New York to take action.

The war that erupted in April 2023 between the army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) has created one of the worst humanitarian crises in the world, with more than 33 million people needing medical assistance.

MSF said while the US was still the largest donor to Sudan, existing grants to many USAID-funded organisations ran out in June - as European governments were also reducing international assistance.

According to the Paris-based Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), international aid fell globally by 21.3% in 2025 compared to the previous year.

"War is driving Sudan's needs; funding cuts are shrinking the response," said Muhammad Ibrahim, the head of charity in Sudan.

"MSF's work in Sudan is privately funded. But when funding disappears from other health services, clinics close, patients have fewer places to go, and pressure shifts to the facilities that remain, including ours."

This has meant that patients often have to make dangerous and long trips to get treatment.

"After a longer and more expensive journey, patients often arrive in a much more serious condition, and the hospital may already be full," explained Sebastián Traficante, MSF's emergency co-ordinator in the western region of Darfur, which has experienced much of the fighting over the last three years.

Between January and April 2026, MSF saw admissions jump by 22.5% in facilities it supports in central Darfur, when compared to the same time last year.

In May alone, 45 healthcare centres in the area had stopped receiving funding, it said.

According to MSF, the closure of frontline services was putting other hospitals under severe strain - as they were losing their capacity to function and medicines were disappearing.

It gave Gedaref state's Tanedba camp, where 18,400 people who have fled their homes live, as an example. Its maternity and surgical wards have closed down after a humanitarian organisation left in June.

As a result, MSF is now running an emergency room there, but pregnant women who need surgery to deliver a baby, have to travel three hours to the nearest city.

In the Um Rakuba camp - also in Gedaref - the number of aid agencies working there has dropped from 35 in 2021, to less than 10.

According to the charity, the camp currently hosts around...
body.zh: 无国界医生组织 (MSF) 警告称，由于全球资金削减导致苏丹各地医疗机构关闭，该国脆弱的卫生系统正处于崩溃的边缘。 该医疗慈善机构表示，去年苏丹最大的捐助国美国关闭了其提供对外援助的机构美国国际开发署后，数十个组织无法找到替代资金。 无国界医生敦促聚集在纽约联合国大会的世界领导人采取行动。 2023 年 4 月，军队与准军事快速支援部队 (RSF) 之间爆发的战争造成了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一，超过 3300 万人需要医疗援助。 无国界医生表示，虽然美国仍然是苏丹最大的捐助国，但由于欧洲各国政府也在减少国际援助，美国国际开发署资助的许多组织的现有赠款已于 6 月用完。 总部位于巴黎的经济合作与发展组织 (OECD) 的数据显示，2025 年全球国际援助较上年下降 21.3%。 苏丹慈善机构负责人穆罕默德·易卜拉欣表示：“战争正在推动苏丹的需求；资金削减正在缩小应对措施。” “无国界医生在苏丹的工作是由私人资助的。但是，当其他卫生服务机构的资金消失时，诊所就会关闭，患者可去的地方就会减少，压力就会转移到剩下的设施上，包括我们的设施。” 这意味着患者常常不得不进行危险的长途旅行才能获得治疗。 无国界医生组织驻达尔富尔西部地区的紧急协调员塞巴斯蒂安·特拉菲坎特（Sebastián Traficante）解释说：“经过更长、更昂贵的旅程后，患者抵达时病情往往更加严重，而医院可能已经住满了。”过去三年来，该地区经历了大部分战斗。 2026 年 1 月至 4 月期间，与去年同期相比，无国界医生在其支持的达尔富尔中部设施中的入院人数增加了 22.5%。 报告称，仅 5 月份，该地区就有 45 个医疗中心停止接受资助。 无国界医生表示，前线服务的关闭使其他医院面临严重压力，因为它们正在失去运作能力，药品也正在消失。 它以盖达里夫州的塔内德巴难民营为例，那里居住着 18,400 名逃离家园的人。六月一个人道主义组织离开后，其产科和外科病房已关闭。 因此，无国界医生现在在那里开设了一个急诊室，但需要手术分娩的孕妇必须花三个小时才能到达最近的城市。 在同样位于盖达里夫的乌姆拉库巴难民营，在那里工作的援助机构数量已从 2021 年的 35 个减少到不到 10 个。 据该慈善机构称，该营地目前接待了大约......

reflection.en: The collapse of healthcare facilities in Sudan leaves millions without essential medical care, a stark reminder of Christ's words to care for the sick. When we extend aid and support to those suffering, we are ministering directly to Him. May leaders heed the call to fund these vital services, recognizing the profound spiritual significance of their actions.
reflection.zh: 苏丹医疗设施的崩溃使数百万人无法获得必要的医疗护理，这有力地提醒我们基督关于照顾病人的话语。当我们向受苦者伸出援手并提供支持时，我们就是在直接服侍祂。愿领导人响应呼吁，为这些重要的服务提供资金，并认识到他们行动的深远属灵意义。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
title.zh: 加拿大为美国反制关税生效后的长期贸易战做准备

summary.en: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on a range of US goods, amounting to nearly C$28bn ($20bn), have taken effect, with no immediate prospect of a trade deal. The tariffs, which can be as high as 50%, apply to products from steel to furniture and T-shirts. While fresh fish and lobster were initially included, they were later...
summary.zh: 加拿大对一系列美国商品实施的报复性关税已生效，涉及近280亿加元（200亿美元）的商品，且短期内看不到达成贸易协议的希望。这些关税最高可达50%，适用于从钢铁到家具和T恤的各类产品。尽管最初将海鲜和龙虾列入清单，但在收到海产业界的反对后被删除，这凸显了加拿大在与最大贸易伙伴的互动中必须维持的微妙平衡。美加双方官员均表示...

body.en:
Prime Minister Mark Carney has said that Canada's pivot away from the US as its largest trading partner "will come at a cost", as a wave of Canadian retaliatory tariffs on American goods come into force.

In a video address, Carney added that the counter-tariffs against the US "are necessary to protect our workers".

Canada's levies will apply to nearly C$28bn ($20bn; £15bn) of American products, from steel to furniture to cotton T-shirts, and will be as high as 50%.

Both US and Canadian officials have said they would like to strike a deal, but no new talks have been scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August.

In Tuesday morning's 15-minute video address, Carney said his country's main focus was to diversify its trade relationships and build its economy.

He added that his government would also support workers affected by the ongoing trade war with the US "for as long as it takes".

"We have everything we need to pivot and prosper," the prime minister said. "That pivot will come at a cost.

"There's always a cost to action, but it doesn't come close to the cost of standing still."

US trade representative Jamieson Greer meanwhile said that Washington would consider imposing tit-for-tat tariffs on Canada as early as Tuesday.

President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to halt all US business with Canada-based airplane maker Bombardier unless it moved its manufacturing south.

The aerospace giant is one of the largest in the country, contributing over C$7bn to Canada's annual GDP in 2024, according to a report by accounting firm PwC that was commissioned by Bombardier.

Trump argues that these import taxes encourage consumers to buy American-made goods and boost investment in the US from foreign companies.

But economists warn that prices rise for consumers on everyday goods that are targeted by tariffs.

Another post showed a map of North America - including Canada and Mexico - and Greenland all overlaid with the US flag.

Canada and the US have the world's largest bilateral trading relationship valued at nearly $900bn last year. The US economy is about 13 times larger than Canada's, and the majority of Canadian exports are sold to the US.

Businesses on both side of the border are scrambling to deal with what comes next.

The US currently has in place a 25% tax on Canadian cars and trucks, as well as taxes on Canadian steel, aluminium and lumber.

In late August, Trump imposed new 50% tariffs on other goods like dairy, alcohol, hockey sticks and perfume.

Canada's counter-tariffs, which range from 15% to 50%, will from Tuesday be applied to hundreds of items coming in from the US.

Products like American milk, golf clubs, steel, aluminium and jackets and T-shirts will face 50% tariffs.

Cheese, toilet paper and certain household...
body.zh: 加拿大对一系列美国商品的报复性关税于周二生效，但没有迹象表明即将达成贸易协议。 反关税将适用于价值近 280 亿加元（200 亿美元；150 亿英镑）的美国产品，从钢铁到家具再到棉质 T 恤，关税​​将高达 50%。 新鲜的鱼和龙虾也在名单上，但加拿大后来在受到其海鲜行业的抵制后将其排除在外——这表明加拿大在对其最大的贸易伙伴进行报复时必须取得微妙的平衡。 美国和加拿大官员均表示愿意达成协议，但自八月下旬谈判破裂后，尚未采取任何恢复谈判的行动。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼上周对记者表示，加拿大仍在寻求与美国达成一项“持久”且符合两国最佳利益的协议。 卡尼说：“当美国人准备好时，我们准备坐下来达成协议。” 与此同时，美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周四表示，球在加拿大这边。 格里尔在接受福克斯新闻采访时说：“我们向他们提供了最好的交易，他们正视了这个交易，然后转身离开。”他补充说，自谈判破裂以来，与加拿大方面的沟通很少。 在接受加拿大广播公司 CBC 的单独采访时，格里尔警告不要进行报复，并暗示美国可能会通过禁止进口某些加拿大产品进行反击。 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一威胁称，除非加拿大飞机制造商庞巴迪将其制造业务转移到南方，否则美国将停止与该公司的所有业务。 根据公共会计师事务所普华永道 (PwC) 委托庞巴利 (Bombarier) 委托编写的一份报告，该公司是加拿大最大的公司之一，到 2024 年将为加拿大的年度 GDP 贡献超过 70 亿加元。 特朗普周末在“真相社会”网站上发表了一系列其他帖子，矛头直指加拿大，其中一篇称加拿大与美国的汇率“不可接受”。 另一篇帖子展示了北美（包括加拿大和墨西哥）和格陵兰岛的地图，上面都覆盖着美国国旗。 加拿大和美国拥有世界上最大的双边贸易关系，到 2025 年价值将接近 9000 亿美元。 随着美国新关税和加拿大反关税现已生效，双方企业都在争先恐后地应对接下来发生的事情。 美国目前对加拿大汽车和卡车征收 25% 的税，并对加拿大钢铁、铝和木材征税。 8 月底，唐纳德·特朗普总统对乳制品、酒类、曲棍球棒和香水等其他商品征收 50% 的新关税。 卡尼将加拿大的反关税称为“一美元对一美元”，将从周二午夜开始对数百种来自美国的商品实施反关税。 它们是加拿大现有报复性税的补充……

reflection.en: The imposition of tariffs and counter-tariffs escalates economic tensions, impacting businesses and consumers. While nations may feel compelled to retaliate, the path to resolution often lies in dialogue and a commitment to finding common ground, even when negotiations are difficult. May wisdom guide leaders to pursue peace and stability in their trade...
reflection.zh: 关税和反制关税的实施加剧了经济紧张局势，影响着企业和消费者。尽管国家可能感到有必要进行报复，但解决之道往往在于对话和寻求共同点的承诺，即使谈判过程充满挑战。愿智慧引导领导者在其贸易关系中追求和平与稳定。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 50 years after his death, Mao still shapes China
title.zh: 毛泽东逝世50年后，他仍塑造着中国

summary.en: Mao Zedong, a highly influential and controversial figure in 20th-century China, died 50 years ago on September 9, 1976. His legacy continues to shape the nation, marked by narratives of revolution and nation-building alongside profound social trauma from political campaigns and persecutions.
summary.zh: 毛泽东是20世纪中国最具影响力但也最具争议的人物之一，他于50年前的1976年9月9日去世。他的遗产至今仍在塑造着中国，既有革命和建国的叙事，也伴随着政治运动和迫害造成的巨大社会创伤。

body.en:
Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his...
body.zh: 毛泽东也许是 20 世纪中国最有影响力、当然也是最具争议性的人物之一。即使在他去世五年后，他那个时代的遗产仍然影响着今天的中国。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强...

reflection.en: Fifty years after his death, Mao Zedong's complex legacy continues to shape China. His era brought both national independence and immense social trauma, a stark reminder that a nation's moral foundation profoundly impacts its trajectory. "Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people."
reflection.zh: 在他去世50年后，毛泽东复杂的遗产仍在塑造着中国。他的时代既带来了民族独立，也留下了巨大的社会创伤，这鲜明地提醒我们，一个国家的道德根基对其发展轨迹有着深远的影响。“惟有公义能使邦国高举，过患则万民所羞。”

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Hungary expels 10 Russian diplomats as relations worsen
title.zh: 匈牙利驱逐10名俄罗斯外交官，关系恶化

summary.en: Hungary has ordered 10 Russian diplomats to leave Budapest due to their involvement in "unacceptable" activities, according to Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán. This decision, aimed at protecting Hungary's security and sovereignty, marks a shift away from its previous pro-Kremlin stance under the new government,...
summary.zh: 匈牙利外交部长安妮塔·奥尔班表示，匈牙利已下令10名俄罗斯外交官因参与“不可接受”的活动离开布达佩斯。此举旨在保护匈牙利的国家安全和主权，标志着新政府已放弃了其前任的亲克里姆林宫立场，但并未暗示要断绝与俄罗斯的外交关系。

body.en:
Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán says 10 Russian diplomats have been ordered to leave Budapest for taking part in "unacceptable" activities.

"This decision protects Hungary's security and sovereignty," she wrote on social media, without giving details.

Hungary was viewed as Russia's closest ally in the European Union under Viktor Orbán for years, but since his election defeat in April the new government has pivoted away from his pro-Kremlin stance.

The Hungarian foreign minister said the decision to expel the diplomats "does not imply breaking off diplomatic relations with Russia", but the foreign ministry spokeswoman in Moscow said "the response to the Russophobic lobby will be harsh and painful".

Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised "pragmatic" relations with Moscow from the moment his Tisza party was elected in April. He and the foreign minister have both called on Russia to bring an end to the war in Ukraine.

In May Anita Orbán summoned the Russian ambassador to protest against a big drone attack on the Transcarpathia region of Ukraine that is home to a large Hungarian minority. Commentators have pointed out that her predecessor had not summoned the ambassador since the start of the Russian full-scale invasion in 2022.

Then last month Magyar formally broke with the previous Fidesz government's policies, with new guidelines spelling out that Russia's conduct in Ukraine "poses a threat to Hungary, Europe and the global order, and also puts the Hungarian minority living in Transcarpathia in serious danger".

Russia's Ambassador to Budapest, Evgeny Stanislavov, reacted bitterly to Anita Orbán's intention to continue "the necessary dialogue, based on mutual respect and adherence to the rules".

Budapest's promise of pragmatic co-operation was worth absolutely nothing, he complained, adding that Hungary's "extremely unfriendly step constitutes an unprecedented and ungrounded escalation".

Before Magyar was voted into office, Hungary had for years insisted on maintaining close relations with Moscow, partly citing cheap Russian oil imports. Viktor Orbán objected to the EU's supply of aid to Ukraine and repeatedly delayed packages of sanctions on Russia.

Ahead of the April elections, independent Russian investigative website Agentsvo reported that 15 of the 47 Russian embassy staff in Budapest were linked to Russian intelligence agencies and six more might be linked.

Former Hungarian counter-intelligence chief András Telkes told the BBC that even though "Russian spying activity" had been investigated before the election, the Fidesz government had prevented any action being taken.

The Russian embassy in Budapest had also rejected as false a report alleging that three Russian military intelligence officers had travelled to Budapest...
body.zh: 匈牙利外交部长安妮塔·奥尔班表示，10 名俄罗斯外交官因参加“不可接受的”活动而被勒令离开布达佩斯。 “这一决定保护了匈牙利的安全和主权，”她在社交媒体上写道，但没有透露细节。 欧尔班·维克多 (Viktor Orbán) 领导下的匈牙利多年来一直被视为俄罗斯在欧盟最亲密的盟友，但自 4 月份选举失败以来，新政府已经放弃了亲克里姆林宫的立场。 匈牙利外交部长表示，驱逐外交官的决定“并不意味着与俄罗斯断绝外交关系”，但莫斯科外交部发言人表示，“对仇俄游说团体的反应将是严厉和痛苦的”。 匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔承诺，从他的蒂萨党四月份当选那一刻起，就与莫斯科建立“务实”关系。他和外交部长都呼吁俄罗斯结束乌克兰战争。 五月，安妮塔·欧尔班召见俄罗斯大使，抗议无人机对乌克兰外喀尔巴阡地区发动的大规模袭击，该地区是匈牙利少数民族的聚居地。评论人士指出，自2022年俄罗斯全面入侵以来，她的前任就没有召见大使。 然后上个月，马扎尔正式打破了前青民盟政府的政策，新的指导方针明确指出，俄罗斯在乌克兰的行为“对匈牙利、欧洲和全球秩序构成威胁，也使生活在外喀尔巴阡山脉的匈牙利少数民族面临严重危险”。 俄罗斯驻布达佩斯大使叶夫根尼·斯坦尼斯拉沃夫对安妮塔·欧尔班打算继续“在相互尊重和遵守规则的基础上进行必要的对话”做出了激烈的反应。 他抱怨说，布达佩斯的务实合作承诺毫无价值，并补充说匈牙利的“极其不友好的举动构成了前所未有的、毫无根据的升级”。 在马扎尔当选之前，匈牙利多年来一直坚持与莫斯科保持密切关系，部分原因是进口廉价的俄罗斯石油。欧尔班·维克多反对欧盟向乌克兰提供援助，并一再推迟对俄罗斯的制裁计划。 在 4 月选举之前，俄罗斯独立调查网站 Agentsvo 报道称，俄罗斯驻布达佩斯大使馆的 47 名工作人员中有 15 人与俄罗斯情报机构有联系，另外 6 人可能也有联系。 匈牙利前反情报负责人安德拉斯·特尔克斯告诉英国广播公司，尽管“俄罗斯间谍活动”在选举前就已受到调查，青民盟政府仍阻止采取任何行动。 俄罗斯驻布达佩斯大使馆也驳斥了一份指控三名俄罗斯军事情报官员前往布达佩斯的报道，称其为虚假报道。

reflection.en: In a world where diplomatic tensions can easily escalate, Hungary's decision to expel Russian diplomats, while signaling a shift in alliances, is presented as a measure to safeguard its own interests rather than an act of aggression. This situation calls to mind the call to "live at peace with everyone" as much as possible, navigating complex international...
reflection.zh: 在一个外交紧张局势很容易升级的世界里，匈牙利驱逐俄罗斯外交官的决定，虽然标志着联盟的转变，但被表述为一项保障自身利益的措施，而非侵略行为。这种情况让人想起“尽力与众人和睦相处”的呼吁，在复杂国际关系中寻求稳定。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Ratko Mladic’s funeral casts shadow over Bosnia and Herzegovina vote
title.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼给波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的投票蒙上阴影

summary.en: The funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade, attended by Serbian and Bosnian Serb leaders, has intensified regional tensions and could potentially influence the upcoming election in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Belgrade has stated it did not organize a state funeral for Mladic, who was convicted of genocide and crimes against...
summary.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德的葬礼，塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚塞族领导人出席，加剧了地区紧张局势，并可能影响波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那即将举行的选举。贝尔格莱德方面表示，并未为被判犯有种族灭绝罪和反人类罪的姆拉迪奇举行国葬，但他的遗体由司法部长陪同，并在国家控制的场所举行了带有军事荣誉的仪式，高级政治领导人出席，但没有明确谴责对死者...

body.en:
Ratko Mladic’s funeral in Belgrade, attended by Serbian and Bosnian Serb leaders, has deepened regional tensions and could affect the upcoming election in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Belgrade has made a point of insisting that it did not organize a state funeral for former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic , who was convicted of genocide in Srebrenica and crimes against humanity in 2017.

But when the body of a war criminal is flown home accompanied by the country's justice minister, when ceremonies unfold with military honors in state-controlled venues in the presence of senior political leaders and when clear condemnation of glorification of the deceased is absent, the message is unambiguous.

In Bosnia and Herzegovina — the state created by the 1995 Dayton Peace Agreement, which comprises two entities linked by a weak central government — reactions were as deeply divided as the country itself.

Republika Srpska, the Serb-majority entity covering about 49% of the country's territory, sent its officials to the funeral .

Public discourse there was dominated by narratives of "defending the people" and "the injustice of international courts."

"Without Ratko Mladic , there would be no Republika Srpska," was the refrain among thousands of mourners at the funeral in Belgrade .

Sarajevo , the seat of the central government of Bosnia and Herzegovina, sees this approach as a continued policy of relativizing war crimes and a threat to stability.

In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the entity where Bosniaks and Croats form the majority, the response was very different and the tone sharp.

Foreign Minister Elmedin Konakovic described Serbia's official response as a conscious choice by Belgrade, not something imposed on it.

He announced measures to cool diplomatic ties with Serbia , withdrawing almost all staff from the country's embassy in Belgrade, leaving only the ambassador, explaining that he lacks the authority to close the embassy but can reduce its presence to a minimum. The move effectively froze day-to-day diplomatic communication on the ground.

"We will pull out everyone we can; consular services will be relocated to Zagreb and Podgorica," he said.

Denis Becirovic, chair of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina, called the funeral with military honors an "anti-civilizational act" and warned of far-reaching consequences for the entire region.

For representatives of Mladic's victims, any public glorification of the former general is a direct insult to the families of those killed.

At a time when both Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina are facing general elections — Bosnia on October 4 and Serbia likely just a few weeks later — emotions become a resource.

In both countries, parts of the electorate still see Mladic as a symbol of...
body.zh: 塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚塞族领导人出席了拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德举行的葬礼，这加剧了地区紧张局势，并可能影响波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那即将举行的选举。 贝尔格莱德坚称没有为前波斯尼亚塞族军队指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇举办国葬，他于2017年在斯雷布雷尼察被判犯有种族灭绝罪和危害人类罪。 但当战犯的尸体在该国司法部长的陪同下空运回国时，当在国家控制的场所在高级政治领导人在场的情况下以军事荣誉举行仪式时，当没有明确谴责美化死者时，所传达的信息是明确的。 在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那——根据 1995 年《代顿和平协议》创建的国家，由两个由薄弱的中央政府联系在一起的实体组成——人们的反应和该国本身一样存在严重分歧。 塞族共和国是一个塞族占多数的实体，覆盖该国约 49% 的领土，派出官员参加了葬礼。 那里的公共话语主要是“保卫人民”和“国际法庭的不公正”的叙述。 “没有拉特科·姆拉迪奇，就不会有塞族共和国”，这是贝尔格莱德葬礼上数千名哀悼者的口号。 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那中央政府所在地萨拉热窝认为，这一做法是一项持续的政策，使战争罪行相对化，并对稳定构成威胁。 在波斯尼亚人和克罗地亚人占多数的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦，人们的反应截然不同，语气也很尖锐。 外交部长埃尔梅丁·科纳科维奇表示，塞尔维亚的官方回应是贝尔格莱德有意识的选择，而不是强加的。 他宣布采取措施冷却与塞尔维亚的外交关系，从该国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆撤回几乎所有工作人员，只留下大使，并解释说他无权关闭大使馆，但可以将大使馆的存在减少到最低限度。此举实际上冻结了当地的日常外交沟通。 他说：“我们将撤出我们能撤出的所有人；领事服务将转移到萨格勒布和波德戈里察。” 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那主席团主席丹尼斯·贝西罗维奇称，以军事荣誉举行的葬礼是“反文明行为”，并警告称这会给整个地区带来深远的后果。 对于姆拉迪奇受害者的代表来说，任何对这位前将军的公开颂扬都是对遇难者家属的直接侮辱。 当塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那都面临大选时——波斯尼亚将于 10 月 4 日举行，塞尔维亚可能在几周后举行——情绪成为一种资源。 在这两个国家，部分选民仍然将姆拉迪奇视为......的象征。

reflection.en: The funeral of a convicted war criminal, attended by political leaders, has stirred painful memories and deepened divisions in Bosnia and Herzegovina. In times of such heightened tension, the call to pursue peace, even when faced with actions that seem to glorify past conflict, remains a vital challenge for leaders and citizens alike. May wisdom guide those...
reflection.zh: 一位被定罪的战犯的葬礼，在政治领导人的出席下，在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那激起了痛苦的回忆并加深了分裂。在如此紧张的局势下，即使面对似乎在颂扬过去冲突的行为，追求和平的呼吁仍然是对领导人和公民 alike 的一项重要挑战。愿智慧引导那些寻求搭建桥梁而非筑墙的人。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Japan's empty temples seek new ways to survive
title.zh: 日本的空寺庙寻求生存之道

summary.en: Japan's temples are facing significant challenges due to a declining population, shrinking congregations, and economic pressures, leading to the sale or closure of many historic structures. This raises questions about the future of religion in modern Japan.
summary.zh: 由于人口下降、信徒减少和经济压力，日本的寺庙正面临严峻挑战，导致许多历史悠久的寺庙被出售或关闭。这引发了关于现代日本宗教未来的疑问。

body.en:
With a declining population, shrinking congregations and growing economic pressures, temples are struggling to stay relevant. As more temples are sold or closed, is religion in decline in modern Japan?

The 370-year-old structure has all the attributes of a classically designed Japanese temple , from the curved roof to the timber-frame walls, spacious tatami-mat prayer hall and elaborately decorated altar.

Set in manicured gardens on the Chita Peninsula in central Japan , the 350-square-meter (3,767-square-foot) property is on the market for 482 million yen (€2.66 million, US3.01 million). The estate agent's pitch says the price includes dismantling by "expert heritage craftsmen" and delivery to anywhere in Japan, where it would be fully restored into a "stunning" two- or three-bedroom home.

The sale and removal of the temple marks the end of its role in the local community in the hills above the Nagasawacho district, but it is a better fate than many places of worship across Japan.

There are around 77,000 temples across the country, but as many as 17,000 no longer have a full-time resident priest as congregations have shrunk — particularly in rural districts experiencing rapid depopulation — and financial pressures have taken their toll.

That means many temples are being sold off or simply shuttered and left to deteriorate quietly. 

Tomomi Iwayama took on the abandoned Ganshu-ji temple in Odawara, a coastal town about 80 kilometers (50 miles) southwest of Tokyo, a decade ago. Today, he is the abbot of a growing congregation.

"The temple had no abbot for 70 years before I arrived because it was just so difficult to operate, and it has taken me until now to get it financially back on track," he told DW.

"Even in a relatively large urban area such as Odawara, which has around 200,000 residents, it has been very hard," he said. "In the countryside, it is much more difficult."

Iwayama's biggest problem is the country's shrinking population : fewer worshippers and falling demand for funerals and other traditional rites make it harder to finance the temple's upkeep. He has worked hard to reach out to the local community and has had success in selling plots in the temple graveyard.

One innovation that has attracted attention is the temple's "smart graveyard," where families scan a card, and a robotic system recovers a relative's ashes from the columbarium.

"Young people in villages usually leave to go to university, and then they find a job in one of the big cities, so they rarely go back," he said. "Maybe they will go back once a year to pay their respects to their ancestors at the village temple, but that is not enough for the temple to get by on."

Equally, when the head priest of a rural temple retires, his children...
body.zh: 随着人口的减少、会众的减少和经济压力的增加，寺庙正在努力保持相关性。随着越来越多的寺庙被出售或关闭，现代日本的宗教是否正在衰落？ 这座拥有 370 年历史的建筑拥有古典设计的日本寺庙的所有特征，从弧形屋顶到木结构墙壁、宽敞的榻榻米祈祷大厅和精心装饰的祭坛。 这处占地 350 平方米（3,767 平方英尺）的房产坐落在日本中部知多半岛修剪整齐的花园中，市场售价为 4.82 亿日元（266 万欧元，301 万美元）。房地产经纪人的宣传称，价格包括由“专家遗产工匠”拆除并运送到日本任何地方，在那里它将被完全修复成“令人惊叹的”两居室或三居室住宅。 这座寺庙的出售和拆除标志着它在长泽町地区山上当地社区中的作用的结束，但它的命运比日本各地的许多礼拜场所都要好。 全国大约有 77,000 座寺庙，但由于会众数量减少（特别是在人口迅速减少的农村地区）以及财政压力造成的损失，多达 17,000 座寺庙不再有全职常驻牧师。 这意味着许多寺庙正在被出售或干脆关闭，任其静静恶化。 十年前，岩山友美 (Tomomi Iwayama) 接管了位于东京西南约 80 公里（50 英里）的沿海小镇小田原废弃的甘州寺 (Ganshu-ji)。如今，他是一个不断壮大的会众的住持。 他告诉德国之声：“在我到达之前，这座寺庙已经有70年没有方丈了，因为它的运营非常困难，直到现在我才让它的财务状况回到正轨。” “即使是在像小田原这样拥有约 20 万居民的相对较大的城市地区，情况也非常困难，”他说。 “在农村，这要困难得多。” 岩山面临的最大问题是该国人口不断减少：信徒减少，葬礼和其他传统仪式的需求下降，使得寺庙的维护变得更加困难。他努力接触当地社区，并成功出售了寺庙墓地的土地。 引起关注的一项创新是寺庙的“智能墓地”，家人可以扫描卡片，机器人系统从骨灰龛中回收亲属的骨灰。 “农村的年轻人通常会离开去上大学，然后他们在大城市找到一份工作，所以他们很少回去，”他说。 “也许他们每年都会回去村里的寺庙祭拜祖先，但这不足以让寺庙维持下去。” 同样，当乡村寺庙的住持退休时，他的孩子们......

reflection.en: The news from Japan paints a stark picture of aging populations and dwindling religious communities. As temples, some centuries old, are put up for sale, it prompts reflection on what sustains a community. The psalmist reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a blessing that speaks to continuity and vitality.
reflection.zh: 日本传来的消息描绘了一幅人口老龄化和宗教社群萎缩的严峻图景。一些拥有数百年历史的寺庙被出售，这促使人们反思是什么支撑着一个社群的延续。诗人提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是生命力和传承的祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: US-Canada tariff dispute weighs on cross-border ties
title.zh: 美加关税争端影响跨境关系

summary.en: As Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect, Canadian and US car industries fear the trade war will hit them hard, while Canadians are cutting back on travel.
summary.zh: 随着加拿大的报复性关税生效，加拿大和美国的汽车行业担心贸易战将对他们造成沉重打击，而加拿大人则在削减旅行开支。

body.zh: 随着加拿大的报复性关税生效，加拿大和美国汽车行业担心贸易战将对其造成沉重打击，而加拿大人则在减少旅行。 经过二十多年的规划，一座连接美国和加拿大的新吊桥最近开通，但只有加拿大人到场庆祝。 戈迪·豪国际大桥横跨底特律河，连接密歇根州底特律和安大略省温莎。它以一位为美国队效力的加拿大曲棍球运动员的名字命名。 密歇根州汽车行业发言人格伦·史蒂文斯 (Glenn Stevens Junior) 告诉德国之声：“在正常情况下，这将是一场非常非常盛大的庆祝活动，一场盛大的活动，两国领导人都会出席。” 7 月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布对来自加拿大的多种商品征收 50% 的关税。 几天后，特朗普第二次宣布将加拿大汽车和汽车零部件的关税加倍至 50%，引发了新大桥两侧企业的更多担忧。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼对从美国进口的价值 200 亿美元（172 亿欧元）的商品征收 15% 至 50% 的关税进行反击。 报复措施于 9 月 8 日星期二东部标准时间 12 点（格林威治标准时间/美国标准时间 05:01）生效。加拿大非营利组织 Angus Reid 的民意调查显示，大多数加拿大人赞成在关税方面采取更强硬立场。 商界领袖也警告关税对两国经济造成的有害影响。 总部位于底特律的加拿大和美国商业协会（CUSBA）在一份声明中针对针锋相对的关税上调表示：“不断升级的关税和报复循环最终将损害边境两侧的企业、工人和消费者。” “每一项新关税都会增加成本，扰乱生产，推迟投资，并削弱美国和加拿大企业的竞争力。” 再往北，安大略省金融问责办公室估计，新的关税制度将在 2026 年减少 119,000 个当地工作岗位。 其中许多预计将出现在汽车行业，与无关税情景相比，预计 2026 年安大略省的汽车制造业产量将萎缩 8%。 预计美国方面也会感受到这种收缩，特别是在密歇根州，2022 年美国生产的所有汽车中有超过五分之一是在密歇根州生产的，其中包括几个家喻户晓的品牌。 底特律地区商会在八月份强调，密歇根州和安大略省的经济紧密相连。 “密歇根州制造的发动机安装在安大略省制造的卡车上，安大略省制造的发动机安装在密歇根州制造的卡车上，”商会的格伦·史蒂文斯 (Glenn Stevens Jr) 说。

reflection.en: The opening of the Gordie Howe International Bridge, a symbol of connection, is overshadowed by the imposition of retaliatory tariffs. This situation underscores the difficulty of maintaining positive relationships when economic friction arises, reminding us of the ongoing call to pursue peace and understanding, even when it is challenging.
reflection.zh: 连接美国和加拿大的戈迪·豪国际大桥的开通，本是连接的象征，却被报复性关税的实施蒙上了阴影。这一局面凸显了在经济摩擦出现时维持积极关系所面临的挑战，提醒我们即使在困难时期，也要不断追求和平与理解。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: 'We are not the AfD': Barnaby Joyce rejects German far-right question
title.zh: “我们不是德国选择党”：巴纳比·乔伊斯否认与德国极右翼有关联

summary.en: Australian MP Barnaby Joyce has stated that One Nation is not aligned with Germany's far-right party, the AfD, following the latter's significant win in a German state election. The AfD, classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence, faces isolation as other parties refuse to cooperate with them.
summary.zh: 在德国极右翼政党德国选择党（AfD）在一场州选举中取得显著胜利后，澳大利亚议员巴纳比·乔伊斯表示，他的政党“一人党”（One Nation）与德国选择党无关。德国选择党被国内情报机构归类为“极右翼极端分子”，由于其他政党拒绝与其合作，该党在组建政府方面面临困难。

body.en:
Barnaby Joyce has sought to distance One Nation from the Alternative for Germany party (AfD), after the far-right, anti-immigration group's state election win on Sunday.

At a German state election in east-central Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD surged into first place, winning 44 per cent of the vote and delivering a significant blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives, while short of an overall majority.

The AfD, which has been classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence agencies, will have a difficult time forming government as other parties have said they will refuse to cooperate.

The party is seeking to secure a foothold for advancing its agenda, which includes heavy restrictions on immigration, restoring ties with ‌Russia, cutting support to Ukraine and quitting the euro.

The election win has placed a far-right party within reach of power at the state level in Germany for the first time since World War Two.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's the latest indication of a surge in far-right populism across Europe over recent years.

Asked whether One Nation was taking anything from the German populist party's victory, Joyce said: "I'm not — We are not the AfD. That is a different party."

"I have a completely different view about the AfD than I would to ... say Giorgia Meloni in Italy, who is just a very direct and competent lady doing a good job."

The member for New England went on to list several world leaders and the Donald Trump-linked MAGA movement described as right-wing populists: "Well, I don't see (the UK's Reform leader Nigel Farage) as dangerous at all ... the MAGA movement, they're just conservatives, and they're deciding now whether Trump's in them or not ... Then [2027 French presidential hopeful Marine] Le Pen... I suppose Le Pen is slightly to the right but, you know, tolerable."

"We are very aware of what fascism does; it's a disgusting, horrendous thing, and it's got nothing to do with One Nation or anything I would be involved with."

Thousands of people across Germany have protested against the AfD since Sunday's election.

Protesters carried banners with slogans including "Fascism is not an alternative" and "Stop AfD Nazis! End racism and social cuts," while crowds chanted: "All together against fascism!"

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 在极右翼反移民组织德国另类选择党周日赢得州选举后，巴纳比·乔伊斯试图拉开一国党与德国选择党的距离。 在德国中东部萨克森-安哈尔特州举行的州选举中，选择党以 44% 的选票飙升至第一，虽然未能获得绝对多数席位，但对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的保守派造成了沉重打击。 被国内情报机构列为“极右极端分子”的德国选择党将很难组建政府，因为其他政党已表示将拒绝合作。 该党正在寻求为推进其议程奠定基础，其中包括严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、削减对乌克兰的支持以及退出欧元区。 这次选举的胜利使极右翼政党自第二次世界大战以来首次获得德国州一级的权力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是近年来欧洲极右民粹主义激增的最新迹象。 当被问及一国党是否从德国民粹主义政党的胜利中获益时，乔伊斯说：“我没有——我们不是选择党。那是一个不同的政党。” “我对德国选择党的看法与意大利的乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 的看法完全不同，她是一位非常直接、能干、工作出色的女士。” 新英格兰的成员接着列出了几位世界领导人和被描述为右翼民粹主义者的与唐纳德·特朗普有关的 MAGA 运动：“嗯，​​我不认为（英国改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇）有任何危险......MAGA 运动，他们只是保守派，他们现在正在决定特朗普是否在其中......然后是[2027 年法国总统候选人海军陆战队]勒庞......我认为勒庞稍微偏右，但你知道，可以容忍。” “我们非常清楚法西斯主义的所作所为；这是一件令人厌恶、可怕的事情，它与一国党或我参与的任何事情都没有关系。” 自周日选举以来，德国各地数千人抗议德国选择党。 抗议者举着写有“法西斯主义不是替代方案”和“阻止德国选择党纳粹！结束种族主义和社会削减”等口号的横幅，而人群则高呼：“大家一起反对法西斯主义！” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of global politics, leaders often face the challenge of defining their own identity and values, especially when confronted with the rise of extremist ideologies. Barnaby Joyce's clear rejection of association with the AfD highlights the importance of maintaining distinct political stances and seeking peaceful, constructive...
reflection.zh: 在全球政治的复杂格局中，领导人常常面临界定自身身份和价值观的挑战，尤其是在面对极端主义意识形态崛起之时。巴纳比·乔伊斯明确拒绝与德国选择党（AfD）产生关联，这凸显了保持政治立场独立性，并寻求和平、建设性交往的重要性，而非与分裂性的力量为伍。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: A war criminal was given a hero's send-off. It could have broader impacts
title.zh: 战犯获英雄式送别，恐有更广泛影响

summary.en: Thousands paid their respects to the man convicted for the Srebrenica genocide.
summary.zh: 数千人向因斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪被定罪的男子致敬。

body.en:
On Monday in Serbia, thousands of people waited in line to attend the funeral of the former Bosnian Serb military commander and convicted war criminal dubbed the "Butcher of Bosnia", who died last month aged 84 while serving a life sentence at The Hague.

Ratko Mladić's body lay in state at a Serbian Orthodox Church in the capital Belgrade, his coffin given military honours and flanked by soldiers in fatigues — a show of support that defied European Union warnings against allowing public tribute to the man charged with the continent's worst atrocity since World War Two.

In 2017, the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia convicted Mladić on charges of genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes committed during his time as a senior military official, including terrorising the civilian population of Sarajevo during a years-long siege of the Bosnian capital, and for his role in the Srebrenica massacre.

A United Nations-declared "safe zone" for Bosnian Muslims during the Bosnian War, Srebrenica was overrun in July 1995 by Serbian forces who made men and boys strip before killing them and bulldozing bodies into mass graves.

More than 8,300 men and boys were killed in the massacre on Mladić's orders.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In addition to the killings, ethnic cleansing was confirmed by the court, with an estimated 20,000 to 30,000 civilians abused and expelled from the area.

Mladić's funeral drew immediate criticism from the EU, further threatening Serbia's years-long bid for admission already contested by the country's democratic decline, crackdown on press freedoms and refusal to sanction Russia for its war on Ukraine.

Christian Wigand, a spokesperson for the EU's diplomatic service, the European External Action Service, said glorification of war criminals had no place in EU candidate countries.

"Any glorification of war criminals, genocide denial and revisionism contradict the most fundamental European values and have no place in the EU or in EU candidate countries," he said in a statement released on Monday.

"We are standing in solidarity with all victims, survivors and their families who suffered from war crimes in countries of former Yugoslavia."

The European enlargement commissioner Marta Kos cancelled a planned trip to Belgrade this week over what she described as the "glorification" of Mladić.

"Ratko Mladić was convicted of genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes. The return of his remains to Belgrade reminds Europe of the darkest pages in our recent history," Kos said in a post on X.

body.zh: 周一在塞尔维亚，数千人排队等候参加前波斯尼亚塞族军事指挥官、被称为“波斯尼亚屠夫”的被定罪战犯的葬礼，他上个月在海牙服无期徒刑期间去世，享年 84 岁。 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的遗体安放在首都贝尔格莱德的塞尔维亚东正教教堂内，他的灵柩被授予军事荣誉，两侧是身着迷彩服的士兵——这一举动无视欧盟关于允许公开悼念这位被控犯有第二次世界大战以来欧洲大陆最严重暴行的男子的警告，以示支持。 2017年，前南斯拉夫问题国际刑事法庭判定姆拉迪奇犯有种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪，罪名是他在担任高级军官期间犯下的罪行，包括在对波斯尼亚首都长达数年的围困期间恐吓萨拉热窝平民，以及他在斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀中所扮演的角色。 斯雷布雷尼察是波斯尼亚战争期间联合国宣布的波斯尼亚穆斯林的“安全区”，1995 年 7 月，塞尔维亚军队占领了斯雷布雷尼察，他们将男子和男孩脱光衣服，然后将其杀害，并将尸体推入乱葬坑。 超过 8,300 名男子和男孩在姆拉迪奇下令的大屠杀中被杀。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 除了杀戮之外，法院还证实了种族清洗，估计有 20,000 至 30,000 名平民受到虐待并被驱逐出该地区。 姆拉迪奇的葬礼立即招致了欧盟的批评，进一步威胁到塞尔维亚多年来的入盟申请，该国的民主衰落、压制新闻自由以及拒绝制裁俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争已经引发了争议。 欧盟外交部门欧洲对外行动署发言人克里斯蒂安·维甘德表示，美化战犯在欧盟候选国中没有立足之地。 他在周一发布的一份声明中表示：“任何美化战犯、否认种族灭绝和修正主义的行为都违背了最基本的欧洲价值观，在欧盟或欧盟候选国中都没有立足之地。” “我们与前南斯拉夫国家遭受战争罪行的所有受害者、幸存者及其家人站在一起。” 欧盟东扩委员玛尔塔·科斯取消了本周前往贝尔格莱德的计划，她称这是对姆拉迪奇的“颂扬”。 科斯在 X 上发帖称：“拉特科·姆拉迪奇被判犯有种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪。他的遗体运回贝尔格莱德让欧洲想起了我们近代历史上最黑暗的一页。” “围绕他的死亡的颂扬与......

This event raises profound questions about how societies grapple with past atrocities and the enduring impact of such figures. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves "doing...
reflection.zh: 被判犯有战争罪的拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼，以军事荣誉和公众致敬为标志，这与受害者所寻求的正义形成了鲜明对比。这一事件引发了关于社会如何处理过去的暴行以及这些人物的持久影响的深刻问题。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于“施行公平，喜爱慈爱，谦卑地与你的雅伟同行。”这要求问责制和对真理的承诺，即使在困难的时候也是如此。

title.en: Flights resume in Indonesia despite fresh volcanic eruptions
title.zh: 印尼航班恢复，尽管火山再次喷发

summary.en: Indonesia has reopened its main airport in Jakarta and four others that had been closed due to volcanic ash, although fresh eruptions on Tuesday raised the risk of further disruption. Ash from the Anak Krakatau volcano has blanketed Jakarta and surrounding areas since its eruption late Friday, leading to the closure...
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚已重新开放雅加达的主要机场和因火山灰关闭的另外四个机场，尽管周二的最新喷发增加了进一步中断的风险。自周五晚上的安那克喀拉喀托火山喷发以来，其火山灰已覆盖雅加达及周边地区，导致八个机场关闭，影响了超过34万名旅客。

body.en:
Indonesia has reopened its main airport in Jakarta and four others that had been closed due to volcanic ash, although fresh eruptions on Tuesday raised the risk of further disruption.

Ash from the Anak Krakatau volcano, which sits halfway between Java and Sumatra islands, has blanketed Jakarta and some surrounding areas since its initial eruption late on Friday.

It led to the closure of eight airports for safety reasons, with more than 340,000 travellers impacted.

Soekarno-Hatta Airport, Jakarta's main airport, resumed operations on Tuesday after wind blew the ash away, transport minister Dudy Purwagandhi said in a statement, adding that authorities would check the airworthiness of 178 planes that were grounded there during the closure.

Traveller Alvin Pratama Putra, 31, who had arrived at Soekarno-Hatta on Sunday for a flight to South Korea for work, said his flight had now been rescheduled to Thursday.

"What can you do? It's nature. It's dangerous for the plane if you force it," he said, adding that he had been sleeping on a bench at the airport.

Four other airports, including a smaller one in Jakarta and another in the neighbouring city of Bandung, also reopened on Tuesday. Another airport had already reopened on Monday, while two remain closed.

Bayu Sutanto, secretary general of the Indonesia National Air Carriers Association (INACA), said the delays put strain on airlines' finances, with lost revenue from cancelled flights and higher operating expenses.

Bayu said airlines would have to incur various expenses such as extra fuel costs from route diversions, aircraft parking, or crew-related costs, adding that a delay of one plane at Soekarno-Hatta could affect the next three or four flights using the same aircraft.

Airlines could lose up to $1.5 million a day during such a disruption, Bayu said.

Anak Krakatau erupted again three times on Tuesday morning, the local volcano monitoring agency said.

While smaller than the earlier eruptions, there was still potential for further flight disruption depending on ash height and wind direction.

"So far, the impact is not as big as the previous eruptions, but we'll continue to monitor," said Lana Saria, head of the geological agency.

The volcano is one of about 130 active volcanoes in Indonesia, which straddles the 'Pacific Ring of Fire', a highly seismically active zone where tectonic plates meet to produce numerous earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.

Other volcanoes, including Mount Ibu and Ili Lewotolok, both on islands east of Java, also erupted on Tuesday.

Anak Krakatau, which means child of Krakatau, began emerging a century ago from the area...

In moments of natural upheaval, when the earth itself seems to shift and threaten our plans, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength. Even amidst the chaos of ash clouds and flight cancellations, we can find solace in His...

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

title.en: 50 years after his death, Mao still shapes China
title.zh: 他去世50年后，毛泽东仍塑造着中国

summary.en: Mao Zedong, a highly influential and controversial figure in 20th-century China, died 50 years ago. The legacy of his era, marked by nation-building and independence narratives but also by social trauma from political campaigns and persecution, continues to shape China today.
summary.zh: 毛泽东是20世纪中国最具影响力但也最具争议的人物之一，他去世已50年。他那个时代留下的遗产，既有革命、建国和民族独立的叙事，也因历次政治运动和迫害造成了巨大的社会创伤，至今仍在影响着中国。

body.en:
Mao Zedong was perhaps the most influential, and certainly one of the most controversial, figures in 20th-century China. Even five decades after his death, the legacy of his era continues to influence China today.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his...
body.zh: 毛泽东也许是 20 世纪中国最有影响力、当然也是最具争议性的人物之一。即使在他去世五年后，他那个时代的遗产仍然影响着今天的中国。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强...

reflection.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China grapples with his complex legacy. He is remembered for leading the nation to power and independence, yet his era also inflicted deep social trauma through political campaigns. This duality calls to mind the ancient wisdom: 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' (Romans 12:21). The enduring...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东去世50年后，中国仍在应对他留下的复杂遗产。他被铭记为带领国家走向独立和强大的领导者，但他的时代也通过政治运动造成了深刻的社会创伤。这种矛盾令人想起古老的智慧：“不要被邪恶打败，反而要用善来打败邪恶”（罗马书12:21）。任何国家都面临着如何处理既是基石又带来深重创伤的历史，并努力寻求治愈与进步的挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."
