title.en: Contractors will bear repair costs for lift defects at Queen Mary Hospital, Hong Kong development chief says
title.zh: 香港发展局局长称皇后码头医院电梯缺陷的维修费用将由承包商承担

summary.en: Hong Kong's development chief has stated that government contractors will be responsible for the full repair costs of faulty elevator work in a redeveloped building at Queen Mary Hospital, which led to tilted elevator shafts. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn also indicated that the government reserves the...
summary.zh: 香港发展局局长表示，皇后码头医院一栋重建建筑中存在缺陷的电梯工程的全部维修费用将由政府承包商承担，这些工程导致电梯井道倾斜。发展局局长林郑月娥周二还表示，政府保留向负责缺陷工程的承包商和分包商寻求赔偿的权利，该工程已导致港岛最大公立医院临床大楼一号楼的全面重新开放延迟。

body.en: Hong Kong’s development chief has said that government contractors will bear the full repair costs for faulty lift work in a redeveloped building at Queen Mary Hospital that resulted in tilted elevator shafts. Queen Mary Hospital. File photo: GovHK. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn also said on Tuesday that the government reserves the right to seek compensation from the contractors and subcontractors responsible for the defective work, which has delayed the full reopening of Clinical Block 1 at the largest public hospital on Hong Kong Island. Linn confirmed on Tuesday that the external walls of the building’s elevator shafts had structural “errors,” following media reports that revealed the defects last week. “The errors may have left insufficient room for elevators to operate smoothly inside the buildings,” Linn told reporters in Cantonese, adding that some lift components were installed “improperly.” The Hong Kong Economic Times first reported on the structural defect last week, with unnamed sources saying that the new elevator shafts had a “rhombus” shape that they likened to Italy’s leaning Tower of Pisa. Linn said on Tuesday that the contractors were confident that the defects could be fixed in the final quarter of this year. Proper disclosure in due course She also defended a piecemeal-style disclosure process employed by various government departments regarding the issue, saying that full transparency at this stage could lead to legal disputes in the future. Hong Kong Development Secretary Bernadette Linn addresses the Legislative Council on January 14, 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Architectural Services Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department – the two governmental departments with direct oversight in the incident – have been criticised for a lack of transparency regarding the structural defects. “Precisely because there could be contractual claims to be made later, it is undesirable to publicly discuss every detail at this stage… so as not to affect the government’s right to make compensation claims,” Linn said. She pledged that proper disclosures would be made in due course. Linn added that the government will also review whether the two departments can improve their inspection and acceptance procedures. The Development Bureau said last week that it had requested the two departments submit reports regarding the incident and minimise further delays to Queen Mary Hospital’s redevelopment work.
body.zh: 香港发展负责人表示，政府承包商将承担玛丽医院重建大楼电梯故障导致电梯井倾斜的全部维修费用。玛丽皇后医院。资料图片：香港政府一站通。发展局局长林恩周二还表示，政府保留向对工程缺陷负责的承包商和分包商寻求赔偿的权利，该工程导致港岛最大公立医院一期临床大楼全面重新开放的时间被推迟。继上周媒体报道披露了这些缺陷后，林恩周二证实，该建筑电梯井的外墙存在结构“错误”。林恩用粤语告诉记者：“这些错误可能导致电梯在建筑物内平稳运行的空间不足。”他补充说，一些电梯部件安装“不当”。香港经济日报上周首次报道了这一结构缺陷，未透露姓名的消息人士称，新电梯井呈“菱形”形状，他们将其比作意大利的比萨斜塔。林恩周二表示，承包商有信心在今年最后一个季度修复这些缺陷。适时适当披露 她还为各政府部门就该问题采用的零敲碎打式披露程序进行了辩护，称现阶段的完全透明可能会导致未来的法律纠纷。香港发展局局长林贝尔纳黛于 2026 年 1 月 14 日在立法会发表讲话。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。建筑署和机电工程署这两个直接监管该事件的政府部门因结构缺陷缺乏透明度而受到批评。 “正是因为以后可能会提出合同索赔，所以现阶段不宜公开讨论每一个细节……以免影响政府提出赔偿要求的权利，”林恩说。她承诺将在适当的时候进行适当的披露。林恩补充说，政府还将审查这两个部门是否可以改进其检查和验收程序。发展局上周表示，已要求两部门就事件提交报告，尽量减少对玛丽医院重建工作的进一步延误。

reflection.en: When construction projects go awry, as with the tilted elevator shafts at Queen Mary Hospital, the question of accountability arises. The development chief's statement that contractors will bear the costs underscores the importance of ethical responsibility in public works. This echoes Micah 6:8, which calls for justice and accountability, reminding us that...
reflection.zh: 当建筑工程出现问题时，例如皇后码头医院的电梯井道倾斜，问责制的问题就随之而来。发展局局长关于承包商将承担费用的声明，强调了公共工程中道德责任的重要性。这呼应了弥迦书6章8节所呼吁的公义和问责，提醒我们，在我们的交易中，尤其是在影响公众福祉的交易中，诚信是至关重要的。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Global innovation index recognises GBA's strengths'
title.zh: 全球创新指数认可大湾区优势

summary.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster has maintained its top position in the latest Global Innovation Index, reaffirming the Greater Bay Area's comprehensive innovation strength. This success is seen as a reflection of Hong Kong's research capabilities and the increasing collaboration between Hong Kong and mainland...
summary.zh: 最新的全球创新指数显示，深圳—香港—广州集群保持了其首位，重申了大湾区全面的创新实力。根据香港思汇政策研究所的说法，这一成功反映了香港的研究能力以及香港与大湾区内地城市日益增长的合作。

body.en: Local think tank Our Hong Kong Foundation said the latest Global Innovation Index, of which the Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retained the top spot, reaffirmed the comprehensive innovation strength of the Greater Bay Area. The result was published by the World Intellectual Property Organisation on Tuesday. “It reflects not only Hong Kong’s distinctive strengths in basic research, but also the sustained recognition by an authoritative international institution of closer I&T collaboration in recent years between Hong Kong and mainland GBA cities,” the foundation's deputy research director Victor Kwok said. He said China leads all nations with the most clusters in the ranking for the fourth straight year – showcasing the effectiveness of its policies in science, technology and innovation. The SAR should lure more global I&T investment to the city and the GBA through the government's HK$10 billion innovation fund and its international capital networks, Kwok added. Meanwhile, DAB lawmaker Elizabath Quat said the result showed that the GBA has already formed a complete innovation ecosystem encompassing research, transformation and capital. She said that moving forward, deepening cooperation between Hong Kong and other GBA cities will boost the nation's overall I&T development. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 本地智库团结香港基金会表示，最新的全球创新指数中，深港广集群蝉联榜首，再次肯定了大湾区的综合创新实力。世界知识产权组织周二公布了这一结果。该基金会副研究总监郭伟表示：“这不仅反映了香港在基础研究方面的独特优势，也体现了国际权威机构对香港与大湾区内地城市近年来更加紧密的创科合作的持续认可。”他表示，中国连续第四年在集群数量最多的国家排名中名列前茅，显示了其科技创新政策的有效性。郭补充说，特区应通过政府100亿港元的创新基金及其国际资本网络，吸引更多全球科技投资到香港和大湾区。与此同时，民建联议员Elizabath Quat表示，这一结果表明，大湾区已经形成了涵盖研究、转化和资本的完整创新生态系统。她表示，展望未来，香港与大湾区其他城市深化合作将推动国家整体创科发展。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster's continued leadership in innovation is a testament to focused effort and collaboration. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that committing our plans and work to Yahweh is key to their success. May this achievement inspire continued dedication and wisdom in pursuing innovation for the common good.
reflection.zh: 深圳—香港—广州集群在创新领域持续领先，是专注努力和协作的证明。箴言16:3提醒我们，将我们的计划和工作交托给雅伟是成功的关键。愿这一成就激励人们继续致力于创新，以促进共同福祉。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: China’s top court posts guidelines on deepfakes, voice cloning, algorithmic price discrimination
title.zh: 中国最高法院发布关于深度伪造、声音克隆和算法价格歧视的指南

summary.en: China's Supreme People's Court has released new guidelines addressing emerging issues in artificial intelligence, including the unauthorized creation and distribution of deepfakes and cloned voices, as well as algorithmic price discrimination. These guidelines aim to provide legal clarity for AI-related disputes...
summary.zh: 中国最高人民法院发布了新的指导方针，以应对人工智能领域出现的新问题，包括未经授权的深度伪造和声音克隆，以及算法价格歧视。这些指导方针旨在为中国境内与人工智能相关的纠纷提供法律清晰度。

body.en: China’s top court issued guidelines on Monday covering a range of emerging pitfalls associated with artificial intelligence, including unauthorised deepfakes and voice cloning, state media reported. The Supreme People’s Court in Beijing. File photo: GovCN. The move provides judicial guidance for AI-related disputes in China, which is currently engaged in an intense competition with the United States for dominance in the key technology. The guidelines released by the Supreme People’s Court “make clear that people cannot use AI to create or distribute recognisable digital replicas of others without their consent, including cloned faces and voices”, state news agency Xinhua reported. Other disputes targeted include “algorithmic price discrimination and AI-generated false information”, Xinhua said. Recent years have seen widespread adoption of AI technologies that allow individual users to easily create content that convincingly replicates the appearance and voices of real humans. Chinese authorities have invested heavily in domestic AI, seeking to build up the country’s prowess in the increasingly crucial sector. But President Xi Jinping has also warned of potential dangers, urging attendees at a conference in July to “strengthen risk-awareness and ensure that AI is secure and controllable”. Chinese President Xi Jinping attends a China-US bilateral meeting at the Gimhae International Airport terminal, in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Under the new rules, service providers can be found legally liable if they fail to “take timely action” once notified that their systems have generated content infringing on others’ rights, Xinhua reported. The guidelines offer legal recourse for “someone whose face has been digitally altered and used to spread false and defamatory sexual claims”, it added. The court’s Vice President Tao Kaiyuan said that the guidelines seek to “balance development and security”, according to a transcript of a press conference on Monday published on the court’s website. They seek to clarify rules for procedural matters in AI-related disputes, said Tao. “For issues where consensus is currently difficult to reach, (the guidelines) leave room for clarification, allowing for further experience accumulation and appropriate clarification when conditions are ripe,” she added.
body.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国最高法院周一发布了指导方针，涵盖了一系列与人工智能相关的新兴陷阱，包括未经授权的深度伪造和声音克隆。北京最高人民法院。资料图片：GovCN。此举为目前与美国争夺关键技术主导地位的中国人工智能相关纠纷提供了司法指导。据官方通讯社新华社报道，最高人民法院发布的指导意见“明确规定，未经他人同意，不得使用人工智能创建或传播他人可识别的数字复制品，包括克隆面孔和声音”。新华社称，其他针对的争议包括“算法价格歧视和人工智能生成的虚假信息”。近年来，人工智能技术得到广泛采用，个人用户可以轻松创建令人信服地复制真人外观和声音的内容。中国当局在国内人工智能领域投入巨资，寻求在这个日益重要的领域增强国家实力。但习近平主席也对潜在危险发出警告，敦促与会者“强化风险意识，确保人工智能安全可控”。 2025 年 10 月 30 日，中国国家主席习近平在韩国釜山金海国际机场航站楼出席中美双边会议。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。据新华社报道，根据新规定，服务提供商如果在得知其系统生成了侵犯他人权利的内容后未能“及时采取行动”，可能会被追究法律责任。它补充说，该指南为“面部经过数字化改造并用于传播虚假和诽谤性言论的人”提供了法律追索权。根据法院网站周一发布的新闻发布会文字记录，法院副院长陶开元表示，该指导方针旨在“平衡发展与安全”。陶说，他们寻求澄清人工智能相关争议中的程序问题规则。 “对于目前难以达成共识的问题，（指南）留有澄清的空间，以便进一步积累经验，并在条件成熟时进行适当的澄清。”她补充道。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, the potential for misuse, such as creating convincing deepfakes and cloned voices, grows. The Supreme People's Court's guidelines highlight the need for ethical boundaries in technology, reminding us of the biblical call to speak truth and avoid deception, ensuring our words and creations reflect integrity. In a...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，滥用的可能性，例如制造逼真的深度伪造和克隆声音，也在增加。中国最高人民法院的指导方针强调了在技术领域设定道德界限的必要性，提醒我们圣经呼吁要说诚实话，避免欺骗，确保我们的言语和创作反映出正直。在一个数字复制品可以轻易伪造的世界里，真实沟通和诚实呈现的价值变得更加重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Sep 8
title.zh: 香港电视32台晚间新闻 - 9月8日

summary.en: Top stories for Tuesday, Sep 8, 2026 - Lifts too big for their shafts at Queen Mary Hospital prompt a review into the supervision of public works projects. - Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou is again ranked as the world's top innovation cluster. - Mainland imports and exports surge...
summary.zh: 2026年9月8日星期二主要新闻 - 玛丽医院的电梯井尺寸不符导致公共工程项目监管审查。 - 深圳-香港-广州再次被评为全球顶尖创新集群。 - 内地进出口激增……

reflection.en: When public projects falter, as seen with the oversized lifts at Queen Mary Hospital, it raises questions about accountability and the integrity of oversight. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves not just grand pronouncements but the humble practice of justice and mercy in all our dealings, especially those that affect the public good.
reflection.zh: 当公共工程出现失误，如玛丽医院电梯井尺寸不符的问题时，这引发了对问责制和监管诚信的质疑。弥迦书6章8节提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于宏大的宣告，更在于我们所有交往中，尤其是在那些影响公共福祉的事务上，谦卑地实践公义和怜悯。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou retains crown as world’s top innovation hub
title.zh: 深港广携手，连续两年蝉联全球创新中心桂冠

summary.en: The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster has been recognized as the world's leading innovation hub for the second consecutive year, according to the 2026 Global Innovation Index released by the World Intellectual Property Organization. This achievement reaffirms the region's strength in innovation, surpassing other...
summary.zh: 根据世界知识产权组织发布的《2026年全球创新指数》，深圳-香港-广州集群连续第二年被评为世界领先的创新中心。这一成就重申了该地区在创新方面的实力，超越了东京-横滨和首尔等其他主要中心。

body.en: A cluster comprising Hong Kong and two mainland Chinese cities has been ranked the world’s top innovation hub for the second consecutive year by a United Nations body. The Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retained its crown in the 2026 Global Innovation Index released by the World Intellectual Property Organization on Tuesday. Tokyo-Yokohama, San Jose-San Francisco, Seoul and Beijing followed in the rankings. A government spokesman welcomed the ranking, saying it reaffirmed the Greater Bay...
body.zh: 由香港和中国大陆两个城市组成的集群连续第二年被联合国机构评为世界顶级创新中心。世界知识产权组织周二发布的2026年全球创新指数中，深港广集群蝉联冠军。东京-横滨、圣何塞-旧金山、首尔和北京紧随其后。政府发言人对这一排名表示欢迎，称其再次肯定了大湾区...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of knowledge and technology is a hallmark of our age, as noted in Daniel's prophecy. This cluster's continued success is a testament to human ingenuity and collaboration. May this innovation be guided by wisdom and a commitment to serving humanity.
reflection.zh: 知识和技术的飞速发展是我们这个时代的标志，正如但以理的预言所指出的。这一集群的持续成功证明了人类的创造力和协作精神。愿这些创新能以智慧和致力于服务人类的精神为指导。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Nepal flood death toll rises to 1,357 as rescuers scour tunnels
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数升至1357人 搜救人员仍在搜寻隧道

summary.en: The death toll from Nepal's devastating flood rose to 1,357, with 5,326 people still missing, nearly two weeks after the August 26 disaster. Rescue efforts continued for a 14th day after a glacial and mountain collapse near the China-Nepal border caused widespread destruction. In China, the toll reached 43 dead and...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性洪灾的死亡人数周二升至1357人，仍有5326人失踪，这是自8月26日灾难发生近两周后的情况。在8月26日中国-尼泊尔边境附近发生冰川和山体崩塌引发毁灭性洪水近两周后，尼泊尔的救援工作仍在继续。在中国，已有43人确认死亡，519人失踪，使总死亡人数达到1400人，失踪人数达到5845人。

body.en: The death toll from Nepal’s devastating flood rose on Tuesday to 1,357, with 5,326 people still missing, the country’s disaster authority said nearly two weeks after the August 26 disaster. People look to recover their belongings in the aftermath of flash floods at Devighat in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on September 8, 2026. Photo: Pedro Pardo/AFP. Rescue work continued in Nepal for a 14th day after the devastating glacial and mountain collapse near the China-Nepal border swept away roads, bridges and homes. In China, 43 people were confirmed dead and 519 missing, according to state media, bringing the overall toll to 1,400 dead and 5,845 missing. Nepali rescuers are focusing on three hydropower projects where they believe workers could still be trapped, the disaster agency said. Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — has raised hopes that others could still be alive. “Our search and rescue operation is ongoing,” Dharam Raj Uprety, chief of the country’s disaster authority, told AFP. “We are hoping that there might still be survivors in at least three projects, and we are pushing our operations there.”‘ Embed from Getty Images Foreign experts, including from China, India and South Korea, are aiding Nepali teams. “We have also received reports that there are stranded people higher on the hill,” Uprety added. With mortuaries overflowing, Nepal has buried hundreds of bodies in mass graves after collecting DNA samples for future identification, according to police. While the exact cause of the glacial collapse is unclear, climate change is accelerating glacial melt worldwide, increasing the risk of such disasters. Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people that has contributed little to the greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming, has said reconstruction could cost billions of dollars. David Fisher, of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, said reaching communities isolated by the floods was a daunting task because of “narrow and dangerous” access routes. “Every delay means families wait longer for the support they urgently need,” he said in a statement.
body.zh: 尼泊尔灾害管理局在 8 月 26 日灾难发生近两周后表示，周二，尼泊尔毁灭性洪水造成的死亡人数上升至 1,357 人，仍有 5,326 人失踪。 2026 年 9 月 8 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区德维加特发生山洪，人们希望找回自己的财物。照片：Pedro Pardo/法新社。中尼边境附近发生毁灭性的冰川和山体崩塌，道路、桥梁和房屋被冲毁，尼泊尔的救援工作已持续了第 14 天。据官方媒体报道，中国已确认 43 人死亡、519 人失踪，使总人数达到 1,400 人死亡、5,845 人失踪。尼泊尔救灾机构表示，救援人员正在重点救援三个水电项目，他们认为工人仍可能被困。数百名水电工人失踪，但从隧道深处救出三人——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了其他人仍然活着的希望。该国灾害管理局局长达拉姆·拉杰·乌普雷蒂（Dharam Raj Uprety）告诉法新社：“我们的搜救行动正在进行中。” “我们希望至少三个项目中仍有幸存者，我们正在那里推进我们的行动。”嵌入来自盖蒂图片社的外国专家，包括来自中国、印度和韩国的外国专家，正在为尼泊尔团队提供援助。乌普雷蒂补充道：“我们还收到报告称，山上还有人被困。”据警方称，由于太平间已满，尼泊尔在收集 DNA 样本以供将来识别后，将数百具尸体掩埋在乱葬坑中。虽然冰川崩塌的确切原因尚不清楚，但气候变化正在加速全球冰川融化，增加发生此类灾害的风险。尼泊尔是一个拥有 3000 万人口、以农村为主的国家，对导致全球变暖的温室气体排放几乎没有造成什么影响，该国表示，重建工作可能需要数十亿美元。红十字会与红新月会国际联合会的大卫·费舍尔表示，由于通道“狭窄且危险”，到达被洪水隔离的社区是一项艰巨的任务。他在一份声明中表示：“每一次延误都意味着家庭需要等待更长的时间才能获得他们迫切需要的支持。”

reflection.en: The relentless scale of loss in Nepal, with over 1,300 confirmed dead and thousands more missing, speaks to a profound and ongoing crisis. In such times of sustained devastation, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a flicker of hope: 'The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔持续不断的巨大损失，超过1300人确认死亡，另有数千人失踪，这反映了一场深刻而持久的危机。在如此持续的毁灭之中，古老的哀歌之书提供了希望的微光：“雅伟的慈爱永不止息；他的怜悯永不枯竭，每日每早都是新的；你的诚实极其广大。”这节经文提醒我们，即使在压倒性的悲伤和损失中，雅伟的信实和怜悯依然存在，为那些继续搜寻和重建的人们提供力量的源泉。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: MTR Corp reports mass fare evasion after video goes viral, vows more patrols
title.zh: 港铁报告大规模逃票事件，因视频疯传，承诺加强巡逻

summary.en: Hong Kong's MTR Corporation has reported a suspected mass fare evasion incident to the police after viral online footage showed over 30 individuals tailgating through barriers at Tsim Sha Tsui station without paying. The video, which gained traction last week, appeared to show a woman tapping her card, allowing...
summary.zh: 香港铁路公司（港铁）已就一宗疑似大规模逃票事件报警。此前，一段在网上疯传的视频显示，超过30人在尖沙咀站尾随他人通过闸机逃票。上周开始流传的视频似乎显示，一名女子刷卡后，数名男女紧随其后，未刷卡便通过闸机，而当时站内似乎没有工作人员进行干预。

body.en: Hong Kong’s rail operator has reported a suspected mass fare evasion incident to police after online footage showed more than 30 people tailgating through barriers at Tsim Sha Tsui station, with no station staff seen intervening. A viral video last week appeared to show a woman, believed to be a tour guide, tap her card at an exit gate in Tsim Sha Tsui station. As the gates opened, several men and women following her passed through in single file without tapping their own cards, causing the gate...
body.zh: 香港铁路运营商向警方报告了一起疑似大规模逃票事件，此前网上视频显示，尖沙咀车站有 30 多人追随障碍物，但没有看到车站工作人员进行干预。上周一段疯传的视频显示，一名据信是导游的女子在尖沙咀车站的出口处刷卡。随着大门打开，几名男女跟着她排成一列，没有刷自己的卡，导致大门……

reflection.en: The viral video from Tsim Sha Tsui station shows a group exploiting the MTR system, raising questions about accountability and the spread of information. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that in any dispute, hearing only one side can lead to premature judgment. This incident, amplified online, underscores the need for careful consideration of all facts before...
reflection.zh: 尖沙咀站疯传的视频揭示了一群人利用港铁系统逃票，引发了关于问责制和信息传播的疑问。《箴言》18:17提醒我们，在任何争端中，只听信一方之词都可能导致过早的判断。这起事件通过网络被放大，更凸显了在形成结论前，审慎考量所有事实的必要性。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Pumping antibiotics out: A new route to bacterial drug resistance
title.zh: 泵出抗生素：细菌耐药的新途径

summary.en: Bacteria can survive antibiotics by pumping them out of their cells. Researchers at the University of Osaka have identified a previously unknown mechanism that enables a bacterium responsible for pneumonia and meningitis to export the antibiotic fosfomycin, offering insights into drug resistance.
summary.zh: 细菌可以通过将抗生素泵出细胞外而存活。大阪大学的研究人员发现了一种先前未知的机制，使引起肺炎和脑膜炎的细菌能够排出抗生素磷霉素，从而为了解耐药性提供了新见解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Bacteria can survive antibiotics in several ways, including by pumping the drugs out of their cells before they can take effect. Researchers at the University of Osaka have discovered a previously unknown mechanism that allows the bacterium responsible for many cases of pneumonia and meningitis to export the antibiotic fosfomycin.

The findings, published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences , reveal how this molecular pump works and could help researchers better understand drug resistance and develop new ways to combat resistant bacteria.

The bacterium Streptococcus pneumoniae, a major cause of pneumonia and meningitis, can develop resistance to antibiotics, yet many of its drug-export systems remain poorly understood. By systematically examining transport proteins in the bacterium, the researchers identified an uncharacterized protein complex, which they named FoeAB. Producing more FoeAB made bacterial cells more resistant to fosfomycin.

The team then isolated FoeAB from a related bacterium, Streptococcus thermophilus, and placed it in artificial membranes, demonstrating directly that the protein transports fosfomycin.

Using cryogenic electron microscopy, they also captured FoeAB in two different shapes: one open toward the inside of the cell and another open toward the outside. These structures revealed key regions involved in recognizing the antibiotic and suggest how the pump changes shape to take up fosfomycin and release it outside the cell.

"Drug efflux pumps have been studied for many years because of their importance in antibiotic resistance," says corresponding author Dr. Atsushi Taguchi.

"Discovering a new pump directly involved in antibiotic export and uncovering how it works is an important step toward understanding drug resistance."

Fosfomycin had not previously been identified as a substrate of a bacterial drug efflux pump, highlighting a previously unrecognized diversity in how bacteria remove harmful compounds. Better understanding these systems could ultimately help guide new strategies to overcome drug resistance and develop more effective treatments for bacterial infections.

Atsushi Taguchi et al, Structural insights into fosfomycin efflux by a streptococcal ABC transporter, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (2026). DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2535933123

BSc Life Sciences & Ecology. Microbiology lab background with pharmaceutical news experience in oil, gas, and renewable industries. Full profile →

Bachelor's in mathematical biology, Master's in creative writing. Well-traveled with unique perspectives on...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 细菌可以通过多种方式在抗生素的作用下存活下来，包括在药物发挥作用之前将药物从细胞中泵出。大阪大学的研究人员发现了一种以前未知的机制，可以使导致许多肺炎和脑膜炎病例的细菌输出抗生素磷霉素。 该研究结果发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》杂志上，揭示了这种分子泵的工作原理，可以帮助研究人员更好地了解耐药性并开发对抗耐药细菌的新方法。 肺炎链球菌是肺炎和脑膜炎的主要原因，它可以对抗生素产生耐药性，但其许多药物输出系统仍知之甚少。通过系统地检查细菌中的转运蛋白，研究人员发现了一种未表征的蛋白质复合物，并将其命名为 FoeAB。产生更多的 FoeAB 使细菌细胞对磷霉素更具抵抗力。 研究小组随后从相关细菌嗜热链球菌中分离出 FoeAB，并将其放置在人造膜中，直接证明该蛋白质可转运磷霉素。 使用低温电子显微镜，他们还捕获了两种不同形状的 FoeAB：一种向细胞内部开放，另一种向细胞外部开放。这些结构揭示了参与识别抗生素的关键区域，并表明泵如何改变形状以吸收磷霉素并将其释放到细胞外。 “药物外排泵因其在抗生素耐药性中的重要性而被研究了多年，”通讯作者 Atsushi Taguchi 博士说。 “发现一种直接参与抗生素输出的新泵并揭示其工作原理是了解耐药性的重要一步。” 磷霉素此前并未被确定为细菌药物外排泵的底物，这凸显了细菌去除有害化合物的方式此前未被认识到的多样性。更好地了解这些系统最终可以帮助指导克服耐药性的新策略并开发更有效的细菌感染治疗方法。 Atsushi Taguchi 等人，链球菌 ABC 转运蛋白对磷霉素外流的结构见解，《美国国家科学院院刊》（2026 年）。 DOI：10.1073/pnas.2535933123 生命科学与生态学理学士。微生物学实验室背景，具有石油、天然气和可再生行业的制药新闻经验。完整档案 → 数学生物学学士学位，创意写作硕士学位。游历广泛，对...有独特的观点

reflection.en: The intricate workings of life, even at the microscopic level of bacteria, reveal a profound order. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you... In all these the hand of Yahweh has done this.' The Osaka researchers' discovery of a new mechanism in bacterial antibiotic resistance is a testament to the wisdom embedded in creation,...
reflection.zh: 生命中错综复杂的运作，即使在细菌的微观层面，也揭示了深刻的秩序。《约伯记》12:7-9 提醒我们：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你……这一切都是雅伟的手所做的。”大阪研究人员发现细菌抗生素耐药性的新机制，证明了创造中蕴含的智慧，等待着通过勤奋的观察而被揭示。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Current events: Scientists keep close eye on Atlantic Ocean changes
title.zh: 当前事件：科学家密切关注大西洋变化

summary.en: The year is 2060. London experiences prolonged Nordic winter freezes. Northern Europe faces withered forests and collapsed cereal yields due to severe frost and drought. Coastal cities like Miami and Charleston are dealing with three feet of sea-level rise, causing routine tidal flooding. In the North Atlantic,...
summary.zh: 2060年，伦敦经历漫长的北欧式严冬。北欧因严寒和干旱导致橡树和山毛榉森林枯萎，谷物产量崩溃。迈阿密和查尔斯顿等沿海城市海平面上升三英尺，潮汐洪水泛滥成灾。北大西洋深海营养物质被困，浮游生物匮乏，导致从鳕鱼到鲸鱼的大量死亡，海洋的生命引擎已停滞。

body.en: The year is 2060. London shudders through months of Nordic winter freezes. Across northern Europe, oak and beech forests wither under severe frost and drought, while cereal yields collapse from temperatures plunging as low as 27 degrees Fahrenheit below today's averages. In U.S. coastal cities such as Miami and Charleston, South Carolina, sea levels have risen three feet (about 0.9 meters), with routine tidal flooding washing away streets. Meanwhile, in the North Atlantic, deep-sea nutrients remain trapped on the ocean floor, starving plankton blooms and triggering a cascade of die-offs from cod to migrating whales. The ocean's engine has stalled.
body.zh: 2060 年，伦敦经历了数月的北欧冬季冰冻。在整个北欧，橡树林和山毛榉林因严重霜冻和干旱而枯萎，而谷物产量则因气温比今天的平均温度低至 27 华氏度而大幅下降。在迈阿密和南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿等美国沿海城市，海平面上升了三英尺（约0.9米），潮汐洪水经常冲毁街道。与此同时，在北大西洋，深海营养物质仍然滞留在海底，导致浮游生物大量繁殖，并引发从鳕鱼到迁徙鲸鱼的一系列死亡。海洋的引擎已经熄火了。

reflection.en: The report paints a stark picture of ecological collapse in the North Atlantic, where the ocean's vital systems are faltering, leading to widespread die-offs. This scientific observation of a world groaning under environmental stress echoes the Psalmist's awe at the Earth's intricate provisions, reminding us of our responsibility to care for this creation....
reflection.zh: 这篇报道描绘了北大西洋生态系统崩溃的严峻景象，海洋的生命系统正在衰竭，导致大规模的生物死亡。这种对世界承受环境压力而呻吟的科学观察，呼应了诗篇作者对大地丰富造物的惊叹，提醒我们有责任照管这受造界。 当我们目睹生态系统可能瓦解时，我们被呼召反思雅伟编织进生命肌理中的深邃智慧与丰盛，并思考我们在管理这些宝贵资源中的角色。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Do black holes grow along with the universe? A new study says yes
title.zh: 黑洞会随着宇宙一同增长吗？新研究称是的

summary.en: A new paper by theoretical physicists Valerio Faraoni and Massimiliano Rinaldi challenges the assumption that gravitationally bound objects like black holes are immune to the universe's expansion, proposing instead that they must expand along with it.
summary.zh: 理论物理学家 Valerio Faraoni 和 Massimiliano Rinaldi 的一篇新论文挑战了黑洞等引力束缚天体不受宇宙膨胀影响的假设，并提出它们实际上必须随之膨胀。

body.en: We know the universe is constantly expanding. We also know that gravitationally bound objects, such as solar systems and black holes, seem to be immune to that expansion. But a new paper by theoretical physicists Valerio Faraoni and Massimiliano Rinaldi challenges that assumption. They suggest that black holes can't just ignore the expanding universe around them. Instead, they have to expand along with it. Their paper is posted to the arXiv preprint server.
body.zh: 我们知道宇宙在不断膨胀。我们还知道，受引力束缚的物体，例如太阳系和黑洞，似乎不受这种膨胀的影响。但理论物理学家瓦莱里奥·法拉奥尼和马西米利亚诺·里纳尔迪的一篇新论文挑战了这一假设。他们认为黑洞不能忽视周围不断膨胀的宇宙。相反，他们必须随之扩张。他们的论文已发布到 arXiv 预印本服务器。

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos continues to reveal its intricate workings. This new research suggests even the most massive and seemingly isolated objects, black holes, are part of the universe's grand, expanding narrative. It reminds us that all creation, from the smallest particle to the largest structure, is interconnected and subject to the same fundamental...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚不断揭示其精密的运作方式。这项新研究表明，即使是最庞大、看似孤立的天体——黑洞——也是宇宙宏大、膨胀叙事的一部分。它提醒我们，所有受造物，从最小的粒子到最大的结构，都是相互关联的，并受制于维系万物的基本法则。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: 'River is flowing better than it has for 25 years'
title.zh: 25年来河流状况最佳

summary.en: The River Deben is flowing better than it has in 25 years following major restoration efforts. Excavation and tree removal, part of a community and multi-agency initiative, have improved water flow after a weir collapse and bridge damage caused water levels to drop significantly.
summary.zh: 经过大规模修复工程后，德本河的河流状况比过去25年来都要好。挖掘和移除树木是多方机构和社区共同努力的一部分，在堰坝倒塌和桥梁损坏导致水位大幅下降后，这些工作改善了河流的流速。

body.en:
A river is flowing better than it has for a quarter of a century after a major restoration but the next stage of works will be "really critical", according to a parish councillor.

Water levels in the River Deben in Suffolk dropped by more than a metre after heavy rain caused a weir structure at Ufford, near Woodbridge, to fall away and a bridge to partially collapse.

While they are still to be fixed, water in the river is again running freely after a multi-agency and community effort saw vital excavations and tree removal take place.

Councillor David Finley, river warden at Ufford Parish Council, said it was a "really exciting moment to actually see the water flowing" again.

"This section of the river used to be cleaned out every five to 10 years, so it's not been like this for 25 years," he said.

"Now, you can see gravel bits and silt bits, and so it's actually creating a really potentially dynamic river."

The collapse in April caused a water-filled crater known as Ufford Hole to drain on to surrounding land, including on a side channel towards the East Suffolk railway line.

It happened after tree roots grew into the weir, which subsequently "fell to pieces", Finley said, resulting in "all the water" rushing towards the Hawkeswade/Lower Ufford Bridge which "cracked" it.

The Essex & Suffolk Rivers Trust said it caused "significant damage to habitats along a large stretch of the river".

A wooden walkway next to the bridge, which allows people to follow a footpath on the river bank, had to be closed off and it is still awaiting repair.

Trevor Gill, from the Lower Deben Riparian Owners Group, said the collapse had a detrimental effect on biodiversity.

"It had a really big impact on nature, but also on people who love this, people who've been fishing and swimming here for decades," he said.

"People were worried about fish dying, which did happen, and it was pretty barren.

"What we've done so far shows people that we are here to get behind this problem and fix it."

After the incident, councils and a consortium of landowners and farmers worked with the Environment Agency and others to form an action plan.

The first phase of that focused on clearing the dried-out channel from Old Melton Mill to Ufford Hole to allow water to flow back to the mill.

Now that has been achieved, attention has turned to repairing the weir before the "winter flood" and also the footpath to restore access.

"The really critical bit is getting this weir sorted out so the water doesn't just accelerate the channel and create real problems further down the river," Finley said.

Follow Suffolk news on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , Instagram , external and X , external .

River level plunges with drought. Video, 00:04:00 River level plunges with drought
body.zh: 一位教区议员表示，经过重大修复后，河流的流量比四分之一个世纪以来的情况要好，但下一阶段的工程将“非常关键”。 大雨导致伍德布里奇附近的乌福德的一个堰结构脱落，一座桥梁部分倒塌，萨福克郡德本河的水位下降了一米多。 虽然它们仍有待修复，但在多机构和社区的努力下进行了重要的挖掘和树木清除后，河水再次自由流动。 乌福德教区议会河流管理员、议员大卫·芬利表示，“再次看到水流流动真是令人兴奋的时刻”。 他说：“这一段河以前每五到十年就会被清理一次，所以已经有 25 年没有这样了。” “现在，你可以看到砾石和淤泥，因此它实际上正在创造一条真正具有潜在活力的河流。” 4 月份的塌陷导致一个名为 Ufford Hole 的充满水的火山口流到周围的土地上，包括通往东萨福克铁路线的侧通道。 芬利说，树根长进堰后，堰随后“碎裂”，导致“所有的水”涌向霍克斯瓦德/下乌福德大桥，导致堰“破裂”。 埃塞克斯和萨福克河信托基金表示，它“对沿河大片河段的栖息地造成了严重破坏”。 桥旁的一条木制走道允许人们沿着河岸的人行道行走，但不得不关闭，目前仍在等待修复。 下德本河岸业主小组的特雷弗·吉尔表示，塌方对生物多样性产生了不利影响。 “它对自然产生了巨大的影响，也对热爱这里的人们，几十年来一直在这里钓鱼和游泳的人们产生了巨大的影响，”他说。 “人们担心鱼类死亡，这种情况确实发生了，而且那里非常贫瘠。 “到目前为止，我们所做的事情向人们表明，我们是来支持这个问题并解决它的。” 事件发生后，议会以及土地所有者和农民组成的财团与环境局和其他机构合作制定了一项行动计划。 第一阶段的重点是清理从老梅尔顿磨坊到乌福德洞的干涸通道，让水流回磨坊。 既然已经实现了这一目标，人们的注意力就转向在“冬季洪水”到来之前修复堰以及恢复通道的人行道。 芬利说：“真正关键的一点是解决这个堰，这样水就不会加速河道流速，并在河流下游造成真正的问题。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注萨福克新闻。 河流水位因干旱而下降。视频，00:04:00 河流水位因干旱而暴跌

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see the River Deben flowing freely again after significant restoration work. This success, achieved through collaborative effort, reminds us of the goodness of creation and our role in its care. May this restoration inspire continued stewardship and a deep appreciation for the natural world Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 看到德本河经过大规模修复工程后再次自由流淌，令人鼓舞。这项通过共同努力取得的成功，提醒我们受造物的良善以及我们在其照管中的作用。愿这次修复能激励我们继续尽责，并深深地欣赏雅伟所造的自然世界。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Scientists discover a powerful new antivenom hidden in rattlesnake blood
title.zh: 科学家在响尾蛇血液中发现强效新抗蛇毒剂

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that combinations of toxin-blocking proteins naturally present in rattlesnake blood can effectively neutralize venom from several dangerous snake species. Laboratory tests showed these mixtures were approximately 10 times more potent than a current commercial antivenom, suggesting a...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，响尾蛇血液中天然存在的毒素阻断蛋白组合能够有效中和多种危险蛇类的毒液。实验室测试表明，这些混合物的效力约为当前市售抗蛇毒剂的10倍，为治疗蛇咬伤开辟了一条有前景的新途径。

body.en:
University of Maryland researchers have identified a promising new way to treat venomous snakebites by borrowing from snakes' own natural defenses. Their approach uses toxin-blocking proteins that western diamondback rattlesnakes evolved to protect themselves from venom.

By combining specific proteins found in rattlesnake blood, the researchers achieved unusually strong protection against venom from several dangerous snake species.

The study was led by Distinguished University Professor of BiologySean B. Carroll and published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences . The findings could help researchers develop more powerful antivenoms for deadly snakebites, which remain a major health threat in some regions of the world.

"This is one of those great stories when nature has already solved a problem we've been grappling with for decades," said Carroll, who also holds the Andrew and Mary Balo and Nicholas and Susan Simon Endowed Chair at UMD.

Snakebite is considered one of the world's most neglected tropical diseases. According to the World Health Organization, venomous snakes kill an estimated 80,000 to 140,000 people annually, while hundreds of thousands of survivors are left with permanent disabilities. Many of those affected live in rural areas where effective antivenom can be difficult to obtain.

Existing antivenoms save lives, but they also have major drawbacks. They are typically produced by exposing large animals to snake venom and then collecting the antibodies those animals generate. Manufacturing these treatments can be costly, their quality and effectiveness can vary, and they may not work equally well against the many different toxins found in venom from different snake species. They can also cause serious immune reactions.

Those limitations have pushed scientists to search for better options. In this case, the researchers turned to snakes themselves for clues.

"We've known from anecdotes for 100 years that vipers tend to be resistant to their own venom," Carroll said. "But for a long time, nobody knew what exactly was circulating in their blood that protected them."

In 2022, Carroll's laboratory found part of the answer: a protein called FETUA-3. The researchers discovered that it could block the activity of many metalloproteinase toxins found in western diamondback rattlesnake venom. It could also bind to and inhibit toxins from the venoms of several other rattlesnake species.

"Here was evolution's way for snakes to protect themselves from accidental self-envenomation," he said, which prompted a follow-up question. "Why rely on horse antibodies when nature has packaged an effective antidote right there in the snake?"

For the new research, co-authors including Elda Sánchez, director of the National Natural...
body.zh: 马里兰大学的研究人员利用蛇自身的自然防御能力，发现了一种治疗毒蛇咬伤的有前途的新方法。他们的方法使用西方小菜斑响尾蛇进化来的毒素阻断蛋白来保护自己免受毒液的侵害。 通过结合响尾蛇血液中发现的特定蛋白质，研究人员获得了针对几种危险蛇类毒液的异常强大的保护作用。 该研究由杰出大学生物学教授肖恩·B·卡罗尔（Sean B. Carroll）领导，并发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。这些发现可以帮助研究人员开发出更强大的抗蛇毒血清来治疗致命的蛇咬伤，蛇咬伤仍然是世界某些地区的主要健康威胁。 “这是一个伟大的故事，大自然已经解决了我们几十年来一直在努力解决的问题，”卡罗尔说，他也是马里兰大学安德鲁和玛丽巴洛以及尼古拉斯和苏珊西蒙捐赠主席。 蛇咬伤被认为是世界上最被忽视的热带疾病之一。据世界卫生组织称，毒蛇每年导致约 80,000 至 140,000 人死亡，数十万幸存者留下永久性残疾。许多受影响者生活在农村地区，那里很难获得有效的抗蛇毒血清。 现有的抗蛇毒血清可以挽救生命，但它们也有重大缺点。它们通常是通过将大型动物暴露于蛇毒中，然后收集这些动物产生的抗体来产生的。制造这些治疗方法可能成本高昂，其质量和效果也各不相同，而且它们对于不同蛇类毒液中发现的多种不同毒素的效果可能不同。它们还会引起严重的免疫反应。 这些限制促使科学家寻找更好的选择。在这种情况下，研究人员转向蛇本身寻找线索。 卡罗尔说：“我们从 100 年来的轶事中得知，毒蛇往往对自己的毒液有抵抗力。” “但很长一段时间，没有人知道他们的血液中到底循环着什么来保护他们。” 2022 年，卡罗尔的实验室找到了部分答案：一种名为 FETUA-3 的蛋白质。研究人员发现，它可以阻止西方小菜斑响尾蛇毒液中发现的许多金属蛋白酶毒素的活性。它还可以结合并抑制其他几种响尾蛇物种的毒液中的毒素。 “这是蛇的进化方式，可以保护自己免受意外的自我毒害，”他说，这引发了一个后续问题。 “当大自然已经在蛇体内包装了有效的解毒剂时，为什么还要依赖马抗体呢？” 对于这项新研究，合著者包括国家自然科学中心主任埃尔达·桑切斯……

reflection.en: The natural world is a testament to Yahweh's intricate design and wisdom. In this case, the very creatures that possess dangerous venom also hold the key to its neutralization within their own biology. This discovery reminds us that by observing and understanding creation, we can uncover profound solutions and appreciate the Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 大自然是雅伟精妙设计和智慧的明证。在此案例中，拥有剧毒的生物本身也蕴藏着中和毒液的关键。这一发现提醒我们，通过观察和理解受造界，我们可以揭示深刻的解决方案，并欣赏创造者的奇思妙想。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Your personality may be more genetic than scientists realized
title.zh: 你的个性可能比科学家们意识到的更具遗传性

summary.en: A study has identified over 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits, suggesting a significant genetic link between personality and various life outcomes such as health, longevity, careers, and income. The research involved an international collaboration analyzing data from 46 cohorts...
summary.zh: 一项研究确定了与“大五”人格特质相关的1200多个基因变异，表明人格与健康、寿命、职业和收入等多种生活结果之间存在显著的遗传联系。该研究涉及一项国际合作，分析了来自全球46个研究队列的数据。

body.en:
An international team of scientists has identified more than 1,200 genetic variants associated with the Big Five personality traits. The findings also suggest that many of the same genetic patterns connected to personality are related to a wide range of life outcomes, including health, longevity, education, careers, and income.

The study, led by the Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium, brought together data from 46 research cohorts around the world. Participants provided DNA samples and completed questionnaires designed to measure the Big Five personality traits: openness to experience, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism.

These traits describe relatively stable patterns in how people tend to think, feel, and behave. Researchers compared participants' genetic data with differences in their personality scores to identify genetic variants associated with each trait.

"There is no single 'personality gene,'" said Ted Schwaba, lead author of this study and faculty at MSU's Department of Psychology. "Personality traits are associated with many genetic variants, but even the largest effects of individual genetic variants are still very small. However, even though any individual genetic variant makes very little difference in personality, the effects of many variants together can be more sizeable."

Although the influence of any one genetic variant was tiny, the researchers found that their combined effects were more substantial and consistent. The genetic patterns also appeared to hold across very different groups of people.

For instance, variants associated with extraversion in a young adult living in the Netherlands could also help predict extraversion in an older retired adult in the United States. By using methods that compared relatives with one another, the team found evidence that these genetic associations could not simply be explained by growing up in the same environment.

Even so, genetics is only part of the picture. The findings also reinforced the important role that a person's environment plays in shaping personality.

The researchers found that genetic variants associated with personality overlap with genetic patterns connected to many other areas of life. These include mental and physical health, longevity, education, career choices and outcomes, as well as the way people are viewed by those close to them.

Some of the links involved everyday habits. Genetic variants associated with conscientiousness were also related to being more active during the daytime. Meanwhile, variants associated with openness to experience and extraversion were connected with a greater tendency to be a night owl.

The results also highlight how genetics and environment can interact with one another rather than operating...
body.zh: 一个国际科学家团队已鉴定出 1,200 多种与“大五人格”特征相关的基因变异。研究结果还表明，许多与性格相关的相同遗传模式与广泛的生活结果相关，包括健康、长寿、教育、职业和收入。 这项研究由复兴人格基因组学联盟 (Revived Genomics of Personality Consortium) 领导，汇集了来自全球 46 个研究队列的数据。参与者提供了 DNA 样本并完成了旨在衡量五大人格特征的调查问卷：开放性、责任心、外向性、宜人性和神经质。 这些特征描述了人们如何思考、感受和行为的相对稳定的模式。研究人员将参与者的遗传数据与他们的性格评分差异进行比较，以确定与每个特征相关的遗传变异。 “不存在单一的‘人格基因’，”这项研究的主要作者、密歇根州立大学心理学系的教员泰德·施瓦巴 (Ted Schwaba) 说。 “人格特征与许多遗传变异有关，但即使单个遗传变异的最大影响仍然很小。然而，即使任何单个遗传变异对人格的影响很小，但许多变异加在一起的影响可能会更大。” 尽管任何一种遗传变异的影响都很微小，但研究人员发现它们的综合影响更为实质性和一致。这些遗传模式似乎也适用于非常不同的人群。 例如，与生活在荷兰的年轻人的外向性相关的变异也可以帮助预测美国老年退休成年人的外向性。通过使用相互比较亲属的方法，研究小组发现证据表明这些遗传关联不能简单地用在同一环境中长大来解释。 即便如此，遗传学只是问题的一部分。研究结果还强调了一个人的环境在塑造人格方面所发挥的重要作用。 研究人员发现，与性格相关的遗传变异与与生活许多其他领域相关的遗传模式重叠。这些因素包括身心健康、寿命、教育、职业选择和结果，以及亲近的人看待人们的方式。 有些链接涉及日常习惯。与责任心相关的基因变异也与白天更加活跃有关。与此同时，与开放经验和外向性相关的变异与夜猫子的更大倾向有关。 结果还强调了遗传和环境如何相互作用而不是操作......

reflection.en: This research reveals a deep genetic connection to our personalities, suggesting that much of who we are is woven into our very being. It echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself, in its intricate design, speaks of the Creator's profound knowledge and the complex tapestry of human life.
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了与我们个性深厚的遗传联系，表明我们很大程度上是被编织进我们自身的存在中的。它呼应了古老的智慧，即创造本身，以其错综复杂的设计，诉说着造物主深邃的知识和人类生命的复杂织锦。
