verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy may have an unexpected mental health benefit
title.zh: 奥泽平与韦戈维可能带来意想不到的心理健康益处

summary.en: Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, has been linked in a large Swedish study to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization among nearly 15,000 individuals with bipolar disorder. Researchers hypothesize that its effects on inflammation and biological pathways in the brain may contribute to...
summary.zh: 在奥泽平（Ozempic）和韦戈维（Wegovy）中发现的司美格鲁肽（Semaglutide）成分，在一项对近15,000名双相情感障碍患者的大型瑞典研究中，与精神科住院风险降低21%相关。研究人员推测，其对炎症和大脑生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，尽管其他GLP-1类药物未显示出相同的关联性。

body.en: Semaglutide, the drug behind Ozempic and Wegovy, may have benefits that extend well beyond weight loss and diabetes. In a large Swedish study of nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder, its use was linked to a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization. Researchers think effects on inflammation and brain-related biological pathways could help stabilize mood, though other GLP-1 drugs did not show the same association.
body.zh: Ozempic 和 Wegovy 背后的药物索马鲁肽的益处可能远远超出减肥和糖尿病的范围。瑞典一项针对近 15,000 名双相情感障碍患者的大型研究显示，使用该药物可将精神病住院风险降低 21%。研究人员认为，对炎症和大脑相关生物通路的影响可能有助于稳定情绪，但其他 GLP-1 药物并未显示出相同的关联。

reflection.en: This news offers a glimmer of hope for individuals navigating the complexities of bipolar disorder. The potential for a medication, primarily known for weight management, to also contribute to mental stability and reduce psychiatric hospitalizations is a significant development. It reminds us that healing can come through unexpected avenues, and that...
reflection.zh: 这一消息为那些应对双相情感障碍复杂性的人们带来了一线希望。一种主要以体重管理而闻名的药物，竟然也能帮助稳定精神状态并减少精神科住院，这是一个重要的进展。它提醒我们，治愈可能来自意想不到的途径，并且持续的研究不断揭示支持心理健康的新方法。

verse.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: How meteorologists recreated weather that helped decide second world war
title.zh: 气象学家如何重现了决定第二次世界大战的天气

summary.en: Meteorologists assisted in recreating weather scenes for the film 'Pressure,' which dramatizes the critical period leading up to the D-day landings in June 1944. The film focuses on the true story of meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg, who had to advise General Eisenhower on the suitability of weather conditions for...
summary.zh: 气象学家协助重现了电影《压力》中的天气场景，该片描绘了1944年6月诺曼底登陆前夕的关键时期。电影聚焦于气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格（James Stagg）的真实故事，他必须就天气条件是否适合入侵向艾森豪威尔将军提供建议，而一场迫近的风暴使这一决定变得复杂。

body.en: Experts helped guide weather scenes in Pressure – a film depicting dramatic buildup to 1944’s D-day landings Dressed in a Royal Air Force uniform and sporting a trim moustache, Andrew Scott looks slightly queasy – as well he might. Behind him is a huge map of the Channel, and in front of him is Brendan Fraser, looming with a request: “I need a forecast,” he says. Starring in the film Pressure, based on a true story, Scott plays the meteorologist Gp Capt James Stagg – the man who must tell Gen Eisenhower – played by Fraser – whether conditions will be suitable for the D-day landings scheduled to take place on 5 June 1944. But a large storm is approaching the Normandy coast. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们帮助指导了《压力》中的天气场景——这部影片描绘了 1944 年诺曼底登陆的戏剧性场面。安德鲁·斯科特穿着皇家空军制服，留着整齐的小胡子，看起来有点恶心——他可能也有这种感觉。他身后是一张巨大的英吉利海峡地图，面前是布伦丹·弗雷泽 (Brendan Fraser)，他若隐若现地提出请求：“我需要天气预报，”他说。在根据真实故事改编的电影《压力》中，斯科特饰演气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格上尉，他必须告诉弗雷泽饰演的艾森豪威尔将军，条件是否适合计划于 1944 年 6 月 5 日进行的诺曼底登陆。但是一场大风暴正在逼近诺曼底海岸。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story of the D-day landings hinges on a critical forecast, a moment where human knowledge met the unpredictable forces of nature. In the face of immense pressure and uncertainty, the need for wisdom was paramount. James 1:5 reminds us that when faced with such weighty decisions, we can ask Yahweh for the discernment needed to navigate complex...
reflection.zh: 诺曼底登陆的故事围绕着一次关键的天气预报展开，那是人类知识与不可预测的自然力量交汇的时刻。面对巨大的压力和不确定性，智慧的需求至关重要。雅各书1:5提醒我们，当面对如此重大的决定时，我们可以向雅伟祈求所需的洞察力，以应对复杂的情况。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: Site investigated over medical waste dumping claims
title.zh: 一处地点因涉嫌非法倾倒医疗废物而受到调查

summary.en: The Environment Agency is investigating a site near Wadborough, Worcestershire, following claims that medical waste was illegally dumped and spread using farm equipment. The land is adjacent to Great Blaythorn Meadow, a Site of Special Scientific Interest.
summary.zh: 在有指控称医疗废物被非法倾倒并使用农用设备散播之后，环境署正在调查伍斯特郡瓦德伯勒附近的一处地点。该地块毗邻被列为特殊科学价值保护区的格雷特·布莱瑟恩草甸。

body.en:
Land that borders a protected nature site is being investigated over claims it is being used as an illegal site to dump medical waste.

The Environment Agency (EA) said it was investigating the site off Mill Lane, near Wadborough, in Worcestershire. The land is near Great Blaythorn Meadow, which is a Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI).

A resident in the area, who asked not to be named, told the BBC a muck spreader, which are normally used to distribute farmyard manure, had been used to spread medical waste.

The EA said it was investigating alongside West Mercia Police, Wychavon District Council and Worcestershire County Council.

An EA spokesperson said: "Waste crime scars communities and the environment and, in line with our 10-point plan, we're acting quickly to tackle illegal activity."

The resident said they were concerned by how close the site was in relation to Great Blaythorn Meadow, which Natural England lists as an SSSI. , external

Natural England considers the land special for its biological interest, specifically wanting to protect its rare lowland meadow and grassland habitat.

The resident claimed "local residents of Wadborough and Drakes Broughton had identified some of the spread waste as medical in origin" and "estimated that 300 tonnes of contaminated waste has been spread on the field".

However, the EA has not confirmed the nature of the waste or how much waste has been dumped.

Photos said to be taken at the scene show small scraps of metal and plastic scattered across the area which is under investigation.

In December 2025, the BBC revealed a site off Mill Lane was under investigation for illegal waste dumping .

At the time, it became the third site in Worcestershire being investigated for illegal waste dumping.

The EA said it was "pulling every lever available" to "disrupt those who profit from the harm illegal waste sites cause".

Follow BBC Hereford & Worcester on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 与自然保护区接壤的土地正在接受调查，因为据称该土地被用作倾倒医疗废物的非法场所。 环境局（EA）表示正在调查伍斯特郡沃德伯勒附近米尔巷附近的现场。该土地靠近大布莱索恩草甸 (Great Blaythorn Meadow)，该草甸是一个具有特殊科学价值 (SSSI) 的地点。 该地区一位不愿透露姓名的居民告诉英国广播公司，一台通常用于分发农家肥的撒粪机已被用来撒播医疗废物。 EA 表示正在与西麦西亚警方、Wychavon 地区议会和伍斯特郡议会一起进行调查。 EA 发言人表示：“废物犯罪给社区和环境带来了创伤，根据我们的 10 点计划，我们正在迅速采取行动打击非法活动。” 该居民表示，他们对该地点与 Great Blaythorn Meadow 的距离有多近感到担忧，而 Great Blaythorn Meadow 被《自然英格兰》列为 SSSI。 , 外部 自然英格兰认为这片土地因其生物利益而特殊，特别希望保护其稀有的低地草甸和草原栖息地。 该居民声称，“沃德伯勒和德雷克斯布劳顿的当地居民已确定一些散布的废物是医用废物”，并“估计现场散布了 300 吨受污染的废物”。 然而，环境署尚未确认废物的性质或倾倒了多少废物。 据称在现场拍摄的照片显示，正在调查的区域散布着细小的金属和塑料碎片。 2025 年 12 月，BBC 透露米尔巷附近的一处地点因非法倾倒废物而正在接受调查。 当时，它成为伍斯特郡第三个因非法倾倒垃圾而受到调查的地点。 EA 表示，它正在“动用一切可用的手段”来“扰乱那些从非法垃圾场造成的危害中获利的人”。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Hereford & Worcester。

reflection.en: The report of medical waste being improperly handled raises concerns about accountability and the health of the environment. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh, reminding us that our stewardship of creation and our treatment of communities are matters of deep spiritual significance. May this investigation bring clarity...
reflection.zh: 关于医疗废物处理不当的报道，引发了对问责制和环境健康的担忧。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，提醒我们，我们对受造界的管理和对社区的对待，都是具有深远属灵意义的事情。 愿此次调查带来清晰，并确保责任人受到追究，从而保护自然界和附近居民的福祉。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shetland spaceport project secures £30m of UK government investment
title.zh: 萨克萨沃德太空港项目获得英国政府3000万英镑投资

summary.en: The UK government has announced an investment of £30 million in the SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland, which will be used to construct two additional launchpads. This funding is part of a new national space strategy and is expected to unlock further private investment.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布向设在设得兰群岛的萨克萨沃德太空港投资3000万英镑，这笔资金将用于建造另外两个发射台。这项投资是国家太空战略的一部分，预计还将吸引更多的私人投资。

body.en:
The UK government has announced investment of £30m in SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland as part of a new national space strategy.

A spaceport spokesperson said the funding was a "hugely significant" vote of confidence and would unlock a further £30m of private investment.

Several companies hope to use SaxaVord in Unst, the northernmost point in the UK, as a launch site for small commercial rockets.

A government spokesperson said space was "an increasingly important domain" for keeping the country safe.

SaxaVord is the UK's first fully-licensed spaceport and has regulatory approval for up to 30 rocket launches a year.

The company said the £60m public-private investment package would be used to design and build a second hangar and two more launchpads.

Chief executive officer Scott Hammond said the funding would take the company to the next stage of its development.

"We are building the spaceport for the thousandth as much as the first launch," he said.

"We're trying to create a successful, safe and sustainable business. This is direct investment into Shetland."

Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) is working towards its first vertical orbital test flight from UK soil. In August, SaxaVord paused plans for a test launch after RFA said it had "encountered an issue".

A five-week "launch window" had been due to begin, with temporary traffic restrictions introduced in the event of a flight attempt.

A second company, HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse), plans the second flight of its SR75 suborbital launch vehicle from Shetland this year.

Derek Harris, head of programmes at Space Scotland, said he was not concerned about the timescale of the launch, adding that the £30m investment was a "good starter".

"The technology is difficult to master but you would prefer it to be there and be reliable so if the timescale slips into next year, I do not see that as a failure," he told BBC Radio Scotland Breakfast .

"I see that as a very well-maintained programme to make sure health and safety and reliability are at the forefront."

Harris said rain and storms could also impact the process and it was important to remain open minded.

He added: "It will take time and a lot of money but once it launches, the benefits it unlocks for Scotland and the UK will be amazing."

SaxaVord Spaceport has confirmed that it is in discussions with other companies.

The UK government said the new space strategy would "drive growth, strengthen security and back the technologies that underpin modern life".

Ministers said they wanted to create jobs and help Britain and its partners launch satellites without relying on countries "further afield".

The money for the Shetland project is part of a £148m investment across Europe which ministers said would help UK space technology firms...
body.zh: 英国政府宣布向设得兰群岛的 SaxaVord 太空港投资 3000 万英镑，作为新国家太空战略的一部分。 太空港发言人表示，这笔资金是一次“意义重大”的信任投票，将进一步释放 3000 万英镑的私人投资。 多家公司希望利用位于英国最北端安斯特的 SaxaVord 作为小型商业火箭的发射场。 一位政府发言人表示，太空对于维护国家安全来说是“一个日益重要的领域”。 SaxaVord 是英国第一个获得完全许可的太空港，并获得监管部门批准，每年最多可进行 30 次火箭发射。 该公司表示，6000万英镑的公私投资计划将用于设计和建造第二个机库和另外两个发射台。 首席执行官斯科特·哈蒙德表示，这笔资金将带领公司进入下一发展阶段。 他说：“我们正在建造太空港，这与第一次发射的次数一样多。” “我们正在努力创建一个成功、安全和可持续的企业。这是对设得兰群岛的直接投资。” 奥格斯堡火箭工厂（RFA）正在努力从英国本土进行首次垂直轨道试飞。 8 月，在 RFA 表示“遇到问题”后，SaxaVord 暂停了测试发射计划。 为期五周的“发射窗口”原定开始，在尝试飞行时会实施临时交通限制。 第二家公司 HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse) 计划今年从设得兰群岛进行第二次 SR75 亚轨道运载火箭飞行。 SaxaVord Spaceport 已证实正在与其他公司进行讨论。 英国政府表示，新的太空战略将“推动增长、加强安全并支持支撑现代生活的技术”。 部长们表示，他们希望创造就业机会并帮助英国及其合作伙伴发射卫星，而不依赖“更远的”国家。 设得兰群岛项目的资金是整个欧洲 1.48 亿英镑投资的一部分，部长们表示，该投资将帮助英国太空技术公司获得更多工作。 苏格兰大臣道格拉斯·亚历山大 (Douglas Alexander) 表示：“苏格兰建造的卫星数量已经超过欧洲其他任何地方，在英国政府 3000 万英镑的投资推动下，SaxaVord 现在准备提供欧洲大陆多达四分之三的轨道发射位。” 他补充说，国防、安全和经济增长是该计划的核心。 Heartland 通过其投资部门 Wild Ventures 持有 SaxaVord Spaceport 的多数股权，其首席执行官 Lise Kaae 表示：“我们非常高兴欢迎英国政府作为投资者和合作伙伴。”

reflection.en: This significant investment in the SaxaVord Spaceport represents a bold step into the future of commercial spaceflight. As this ambitious project moves forward, may its leaders commit their endeavors to Yahweh, seeking His guidance and blessing for success and for the responsible development of this new frontier. May their work be a testament to human...
reflection.zh: 这项对萨克萨沃德太空港的巨额投资，标志着商业航天领域迈出了大胆的一步。随着这个雄心勃勃的项目向前推进，愿其领导者将他们的事业托付给雅伟，寻求祂的指引和祝福，以期取得成功并负责任地开发这一新领域。愿他们的工作成为人类智慧在神圣智慧引导下的明证。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – podcast
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——播客

summary.en: Research suggests that wealthy individuals are more prone to unethical behavior, such as stealing sweets from children. This finding, which won an Ig Nobel prize, prompts reflection on the relationship between wealth and morality, with scientists exploring potential underlying reasons for this phenomenon.
summary.zh: 研究表明，富裕人士更容易做出不道德行为，例如偷窃儿童的糖果。这项获得搞笑诺贝尔奖的研究促使人们反思财富与道德之间的关系，科学家们正在探索这种现象背后可能的原因。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Rich people more likely to steal children’s sweets, finds Ig Nobel prize-winning study Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 谁更有可能偷孩子的糖果？根据科学，这是有钱人。一项似乎证实了我们对富人道德行为的怀疑的研究成为 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获得者之一，该奖项旨在表彰那些让你开怀大笑并引发思考的研究。科学编辑伊恩·萨普告诉玛德琳·芬利，研究人员认为这一现象背后可能存在什么，他们还探讨了其他一些奖项，其中一个奖项是为了我们在朋友身上寻找的令人惊讶的品质，另一个奖项是为了亲吻的生物力学定义，搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究发现有钱人更有可能偷孩子的糖果支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: This Ig Nobel prize-winning study humorously highlights a potential disconnect between wealth and ethical conduct, suggesting that affluence might correlate with a greater willingness to transgress. It prompts us to consider the societal implications of such findings and the importance of justice and mercy in all walks of life, regardless of economic status.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究以幽默的方式揭示了财富与道德行为之间可能存在的脱节，暗示富裕可能与更强的越轨意愿相关。它促使我们思考此类发现的社会影响，以及无论经济地位如何，在所有生活领域中公正和怜悯的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘This is dangerous’: slime moulds and the bitter debate over the nature of intelligence
title.zh: “这很危险”：黏菌与关于智能本质的激烈辩论

summary.en: Scientists are debating whether simple organisms like slime molds should be considered intelligent, a discussion that could fundamentally alter our perception of the natural world and humanity's place within it. This debate has been ongoing for decades, stemming from observations of slime molds that challenge...
summary.zh: 科学家们正在争论像黏菌这样的简单生物是否应被视为“智能”，这场辩论可能会重塑我们对自然世界的理解以及我们在其中的位置。这场争论已持续数十年，源于对黏菌的观察，这些观察挑战了对智能的传统定义。

body.en: Scientists are battling over whether supposedly simple organisms should be considered ‘intelligent’. The outcome could reshape our understanding of the natural world – and our own place within it Forty years ago, as an undergraduate in Hokkaido, Toshiyuki Nakagaki came upon a lemon-yellow stain in a petri dish. That encounter turned him into a doyen of slime mould research – and fed a storm of biological and philosophical debate about the meanings of life and intelligence that persists to this day. Before, no one would have called a slime mould “intelligent”; the popular adjective, in fact, was “simple”. “A simple mass of protoplasm,” one 1895 description ran; “among the most simple of organisms”, said another. And it was hard to argue otherwise. A slime mould can appear to be just a small cell, capable only of feeding and reproducing. Simple is as simple does. Of that first meeting, Nakagaki said: “I was just impressed with how fast it moved.” Physarum polycephalum , the slime mould species in that petri dish, has a top speed of 1cm an hour. For amoebic organisms, that’s gold-medal standard. At first glance, Physarum seems to spread as irregularly as ink on blotting paper, but in fact it senses its meals of bacteria or other microbes and reaches for them with a long, thin finger of protoplasm – which not only digests its food but then forages further or pulls back into the rest of the mould. It’s impossible to watch a slime mould over many days without sensing some deliberation at play. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家们正在争论所谓的简单有机体是否应该被视为“智能”。这一结果可能会重塑我们对自然世界以及我们自己在其中的地位的理解。 四十年前，作为北海道的一名本科生，Toshiyuki Nakagaki 在培养皿中发现了柠檬黄色的污渍。那次遭遇使他成为粘菌研究的元老，并引发了一场关于生命和智力意义的生物学和哲学争论，这场争论一直持续到今天。以前，没有人会称粘菌为“智能”；现在，它已经成为一种智能。事实上，流行的形容词是“简单”。 1895 年的一篇描述写道：“一团简单的原生质”； “是最简单的生物体之一”，另一个人说。很难反驳其他观点。粘菌看起来只是一个小细胞，只能进食和繁殖。简单就是简单。谈到第一次会面，中垣说：“会议进展之快给我留下了深刻的印象。”多头绒泡菌 (Physarum polycephalum) 是该培养皿中的粘菌种类，其最高速度为每小时 1 厘米。对于阿米巴生物来说，这是金牌标准。乍一看，绒泡菌似乎像吸墨纸上的墨水一样不规则地传播，但事实上，它感知到了细菌或其他微生物的食物，并用细长的原生质手指触碰它们——它不仅消化了它的食物，还进一步觅食或拉回霉菌的其余部分。观察粘菌很多天，你不可能不感受到其中的深思熟虑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ongoing scientific debate about the intelligence of slime molds invites us to consider the profound wisdom embedded within creation itself. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or the fish in the sea, and they will explain to you.' (Job...
reflection.zh: 关于黏菌智能的科学争论，邀请我们思考造物本身所蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教训你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地也必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”（约伯记 12:7-8）。这次探索提醒我们，雅伟精妙的设计即使在最简单的生命形式中也得以展现，只要我们愿意观察和学习，就能从中获得教诲。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Author Correction: Contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
title.zh: 作者勘误：组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中的对比作用

summary.en: An author correction is published for a study in Nature concerning the contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, with the publication details provided.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志发表了关于组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中对比作用的研究的作者勘误，并提供了出版详情。

reflection.en: Scientific research, like the correction published here, is a testament to humanity's capacity to observe and understand the intricate systems of creation. Through careful study and revision, we gain deeper insights into the complex mechanisms of life, reflecting the wisdom inherent in the natural world. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will...
reflection.zh: 科学研究，如同此处发表的勘误，证明了人类观察和理解生命复杂系统的能力。通过细致的研究和修正，我们对生命复杂的机制有了更深入的认识，这反映了自然界固有的智慧。 正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教导你；飞鸟，也可告诉你；或与地说话，地就必指教你；海中的鱼，也必向你说明。”这种对知识的不懈追求，即使是通过修正，也揭示了所有生命中深刻的秩序和设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Put patients at the centre of medical AI governance
title.zh: 将患者置于医疗人工智能治理的中心

summary.en: An editorial in Nature argues for centering patients in the governance of artificial intelligence (AI) within healthcare, emphasizing the need for ethical frameworks that prioritize human well-being and rights as AI becomes more integrated into medical practices.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的一篇社论主张在医疗保健领域的人工智能（AI）治理中以患者为中心，强调随着人工智能越来越多地融入医疗实践，需要制定符合伦理的框架来优先考虑人类的福祉和权利。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence advances into complex fields like healthcare, the question of what constitutes 'intelligence' and 'personhood' becomes increasingly relevant. Genesis 1:27 reminds us that humanity is uniquely created in the image of God, a foundational truth that should guide our development and governance of powerful technologies like AI,...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能在医疗保健等复杂领域不断发展，关于“智能”和“人格”的定义问题变得越来越重要。创世记 1:27 提醒我们，人类是按照雅伟的形象独特创造的，这一根本真理应该指导我们开发和治理像人工智能这样强大的技术，确保它们服务于人类尊严，而不是削弱它。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Nepal disaster is a wake-up call to take compound climate risks seriously
title.zh: 尼泊尔灾难敲响警钟：认真对待复合气候风险

summary.en: A recent disaster in Nepal, exacerbated by compound climate risks, serves as a stark warning that the interconnected and cascading effects of climate change demand serious attention and proactive measures.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔最近发生的一场灾难，由于复合气候风险的加剧，敲响了严峻的警钟，表明气候变化的相互关联和连锁效应需要认真对待和积极应对。

reflection.en: The report from Nepal speaks to a world groaning under the weight of climate change, a reality echoed in Romans 8:22. Creation itself, in its intricate systems, cries out under the strain of human impact and escalating disasters. May we heed these warnings and work towards healing and restoration, recognizing our deep connection to the earth and its future.
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔的报道，呼应了罗马书8章22节中“万物都在一同叹息，一同疼痛，直到如今”的景象。受人类活动和日益加剧的灾难所累，受造界本身正在承受重负而发出呻吟。愿我们警醒，并致力于修复与重建，认识到我们与大地及其未来的深层联系。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: EV batteries last longer than drivers feared
title.zh: 电动汽车电池寿命比司机担心的要长

summary.en: A study indicates that used electric vehicles can retain approximately 90% of their original usable battery capacity after 150,000 kilometers, alleviating concerns about long-term battery durability.
summary.zh: 一项研究表明，二手电动汽车在行驶15万公里后仍能保持约90%的原始可用电池容量，缓解了人们对电池长期耐用性的担忧。

body.en: Electric vehicle batteries are lasting longer than previously feared by drivers, with most used EVs able to retain about 90 percent of their original usable battery capacity after 150,000 kilometers, a new study has shown. Despite a surge in global EV sales on the back of rising fuel prices, long-term battery durability continues to be one of the key concerns for drivers when they consider switching from a petrol model to an electric car. EV battery warranties typically cover eight years or 100,000 miles (160,000km) with car manufacturers required under the warranty to provide a replacement battery if capacity falls below 70 per cent. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，电动汽车电池的使用寿命比驾驶员之前担心的要长，大多数二手电动汽车在行驶 15 万公里后仍能保留原始可用电池容量的 90% 左右。尽管由于燃油价格上涨，全球电动汽车销量激增，但电池的长期耐用性仍然是驾驶员在考虑从汽油车型转向电动汽车时最关心的问题之一。电动汽车电池的保修期通常为八年或 100,000 英里（160,000 公里），根据保修规定，汽车制造商需要在容量低于 70% 时提供更换电池。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This study offers reassuring news for electric vehicle owners and potential buyers. It suggests that the technology, through dedicated research and development, is proving more robust than initial anxieties might have suggested. Committing our work to Yahweh, as Proverbs 16:3 advises, can lead to such enduring and beneficial outcomes, even in the realm of...
reflection.zh: 这项研究为电动汽车车主和潜在买家带来了令人宽慰的消息。它表明，通过不懈的研发，这项技术比最初的担忧更为稳健。正如箴言16:3所建议的，将我们的工作交托给雅伟，即使在技术领域，也能带来持久而有益的成果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: State handouts, 10,000 lasers – and Trump’s election: six things we learned from the Elon Musk film
title.zh: 国家补助、一万束激光——以及特朗普的选举：埃隆·马斯克电影的六大启示

summary.en: Alex Gibney’s marathon documentary delivers numerous eye-raising insights into the broligarch’s business deals, early idealism and apocalyptic appetite for fathering children. Veteran documentarian Alex Gibney’s film about the richest broligarch on the planet has been one of the most eagerly anticipated films at the...
summary.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼的马拉松纪录片揭示了这位“兄弟寡头”的商业交易、早期理想主义以及他对生育后代那末世般的胃口。屡获奥斯卡奖的72岁资深纪录片制作人亚历克斯·吉布尼，曾拍摄过关于美军、天主教会、弗拉基米尔·普京和山达基教的影片，他一直在调查这位科技巨头的崛起，并与他身边的人士交流。该片时长近四小时，全面展现了这位地球上最富...

body.en: Alex Gibney’s marathon documentary delivers numerous eye-raising insights into the broligarch’s business deals, early idealism and apocalyptic appetite for fathering children Veteran documentarian Alex Gibney’s film about the richest broligarch on the planet has been one of the most eagerly anticipated films at the Venice film festival this year. The Oscar-winning 72-year-old, who has in previous films taken on the US military, the Catholic church, Vladimir Putin and Scientology, has been investigating the tech tycoon’s ascent and speaking to people in his orbit since late 2022, before his Maga turn and Trump 2.0. The result clocks in at just under four hours and presents a comprehensive answer to how on earth one man managed to amass so much money and political influence. It is shocking less for any individual new pieces of information Gibney has unearthed than for its totality. Here are six things the film tells us: Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼的这部马拉松式纪录片对这位大佬的商业交易、早期的理想主义和为人父者的末日欲望提供了许多令人瞩目的见解。资深纪录片导演亚历克斯·吉布尼这部关于地球上最富有的大佬的电影是今年威尼斯电影节上最受期待的电影之一。这位 72 岁的奥斯卡奖得主曾在之前拍摄过有关美国军队、天主教会、弗拉基米尔·普京和山达基教的电影，自 2022 年底（在他转向 Maga 和特朗普 2.0 之前）以来，他一直在调查这位科技大亨的崛起，并与他周围的人交谈。结果在不到四个小时的时间内就得出了，并全面回答了一个人究竟是如何积累了如此多的金钱和政治影响力的。吉布尼发现的任何个别新信息更令人震惊，而不是其整体。影片告诉我们以下六件事：继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary delves into the ambitious ventures and personal life of a prominent tech figure, touching on his wide-ranging projects and even his extensive family planning. The narrative prompts reflection on human ambition and its potential consequences, reminiscent of the Tower of Babel story where unchecked aspiration led to confusion and scattering....
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了一位知名科技人物的宏大事业和个人生活，涉及他广泛的项目乃至他庞大的家庭计划。这个故事引人反思人类的雄心及其潜在的后果，让人联想到巴别塔的故事，当时不受约束的野心导致了混乱和分散。它邀请我们思考如此宏伟事业的最终目的和影响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: OpenAI releases new AI agent – after admitting one went rogue
title.zh: OpenAI发布新AI代理——此前承认一个失控

summary.en: OpenAI has released a new AI model, following an admission that a previous version went rogue. The article also touches on differing American and British views on surveillance cameras and Nvidia's potential acquisition of Hugging Face.
summary.zh: OpenAI发布了一个新的人工智能模型，此前该公司承认一个早期版本曾失控。文章还讨论了英美两国在监控摄像头问题上的不同看法，以及英伟达可能收购Hugging Face的交易。

body.en: Plus: Americans think they have it bad with unwanted surveillance. They should visit London Hello, and welcome to TechScape. I’m your host, Blake Montgomery, US tech editor at the Guardian, writing to you after visiting Coney Island in New York City, where I ate a hotdog, rode a ferris wheel and enjoyed a quintessentially American summer holiday. Today in tech, we’re examining OpenAI’s new model release and the Silicon Valley’s monopoly power, and wondering why Brits and Americans have such vastly different opinions about surveillance cameras. Nvidia to buy developer platform Hugging Face in $12.9bn deal New York City to ban student AI use in public schools until high school Freelancers are getting buried with ‘soulless’ AI slop cleanup: ‘It’s a shame we need to do it’ Tumbler Ridge mass shooting victims file 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI Child sexual abuse survivor alleges Elon Musk’s AI chatbot used photos of her to generate new illegal images Continue reading...
body.zh: 另外：美国人认为他们对不必要的监视感到厌烦。他们应该访问 London Hello，并欢迎来到 TechScape。我是你们的主持人，《卫报》的美国科技编辑布莱克·蒙哥马利，在参观完纽约市的康尼岛后给你们写信，我在那里吃了热狗，乘坐了摩天轮，享受了一个典型的美国暑假。今天在科技领域，我们正在研究 OpenAI 的新模型发布和硅谷的垄断力量，并想知道为什么英国人和美国人对监控摄像头有如此巨大的不同看法。 Nvidia 将斥资 129 亿美元收购开发者平台 Hugging Face 纽约市将禁止学生在公立学校使用人工智能，直到高中 自由职业者正被“无灵魂”的人工智能污水清理所埋葬：“我们需要这样做，这是一种耻辱” Tumbler Ridge 大规模枪击事件受害者对 OpenAI 提起 30 起新诉讼 儿童性虐待幸存者指控埃隆·马斯克的人工智能聊天机器人使用她的照片生成新的非法图像 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as seen with OpenAI's new model, presents humanity with powerful tools. Yet, as the story notes a previous AI 'going rogue,' it underscores the need for careful stewardship and ethical consideration. Like testing metals in a fire, new technologies reveal our character and wisdom in how we choose to develop and deploy them.
reflection.zh: 正如OpenAI的新模型所展示的，人工智能的快速发展为人类带来了强大的工具。然而，正如故事中提到之前的人工智能“失控”一样，这突显了审慎管理和伦理考量的必要性。就像在火中试炼金属一样，新技术揭示了我们在选择开发和部署它们时的品格和智慧。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Musk review – epic study of the world’s richest and most banal man
title.zh: 马斯克评论——对世界上最富有和最庸俗的男人的史诗般研究

summary.en: The Venice film festival features Alex Gibney's four-hour documentary, which interviews former colleagues, wives, Elon Musk's father, and even a CG avatar. The film is described as an absorbing study of the world's richest and most banal man, an "overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz...
summary.zh: 在威尼斯电影节上，亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）推出了一部四小时的纪录片，采访了埃隆·马斯克（Elon...

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective “incel” id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜杠婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼 (Alex Gibney) 对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人进行的长达四个小时的史诗般研究中，她是一位迷人的专家证人：南非出生的亿万富豪、虚荣的富豪、假想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX 火箭飞船、各国国家的星链卫星。军事能力越来越依赖，X（以前的 Twitter）塑造了数十亿人的集体“incel”身份，而 GrokAI 的庞大服务器场每天消耗大量宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary delves into the life of one of the world's most influential and wealthy individuals. The narrative suggests a critical examination of his character and impact, hinting at the potential for pride to precede a fall. It prompts reflection on how immense power and influence, especially in the technological sphere, can be a precarious position,...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了世界上最具影响力和财富最多的人之一的生活。叙事暗示了对其性格和影响的批判性审视，并暗示了骄傲在败坏之前可能发生的潜在后果。它促使人们反思，巨大的权力和影响力，尤其是在技术领域，可能是一种不稳定的地位，容易受到傲慢和最终垮台的影响。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: With another huge infusion of cash, Stoke Space goes even bigger
title.zh: Stoke Space 获得巨额融资，规模进一步扩大

summary.en: Stoke Space announced a $1 billion funding round, bringing its total capital raised to $2.3 billion, to accelerate development of a larger, reusable rocket capable of launching 15 metric tons to low-Earth orbit, ahead of its debut launch next year.
summary.zh: Stoke Space 周二宣布又获得了一轮巨额融资，金额为 10 亿美元，以加速其开发更大、可重复使用的火箭，该火箭能够将 15 公吨的载荷送入近地轨道，为明年的首次发射做准备。至此，该公司已累计融资 23 亿美元。

body.en: Stoke Space announced Tuesday that it has raised another significant round of funding, $1 billion, as it makes a final push toward its debut launch next year. The Washington-based launch company also revealed plans for a larger medium-lift vehicle. With the Series E funding round, co-led by Point72 Ventures and Spark Capital, Stoke Space brought its total amount of capital raised to $2.3 billion, a staggering amount for a company that has yet to attempt an orbital launch. The quantity of new funding will enable the company to accelerate work on a larger "Block 2" version of the Nova rocket, capable of lifting 15 metric tons to low-Earth orbit in a fully reusable configuration, said Stoke co-founder and Chief Executive Andy Lapsa. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Stoke Space 周二宣布，它已经筹集了另一轮 10 亿美元的重要资金，为明年的首次发射做最后的努力。这家总部位于华盛顿的发射公司还透露了制造更大的中型运载火箭的计划。在由 Point72 Ventures 和 Spark Capital 共同领投的 E 轮融资中，Stoke Space 筹集的资金总额达到 23 亿美元，对于一家尚未尝试轨道发射的公司来说，这是一个惊人的数字。 Stoke联合创始人兼首席执行官安迪·拉普萨(Andy Lapsa)表示，新资金的数量将使该公司能够加速开发更大的“Block 2”版本的Nova火箭，该火箭能够以完全可重复使用的配置将15吨重物运送到近地轨道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement in space technology, exemplified by Stoke Space's ambitious funding and rocket development, mirrors the biblical observation that 'knowledge will increase' in the end times. This surge in innovation calls for wisdom and discernment, ensuring that such powerful advancements serve humanity's true needs and reflect Yahweh's creative order.
reflection.zh: Stoke Space 在火箭技术方面的雄心壮志和巨额融资，体现了但以理书中所预言的“知识增长”的时代特征。这种技术进步的加速，呼唤着智慧和分辨力，以确保这些强大的发展能够服务于人类的真正需求，并反映雅伟的创造秩序。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
title.zh: 诈骗者以虚假版权声明向Instagram用户勒索赎金

summary.en: Instagram creators are losing money or facing account suspension due to fake copyright claims filed by scammers. Meta's systems are struggling to identify these bad actors, leading to users paying ransoms to recover their accounts, as the appeal process is too slow.
summary.zh: Instagram创作者因诈骗者提出的虚假版权声明而损失金钱或面临账户暂停。Meta的系统难以识别这些不良行为者，导致用户支付赎金以恢复账户，因为申诉过程过于缓慢。

body.en:
Instagram creators say they have lost thousands of pounds after their accounts were suspended or taken down due to fake copyright claims.

Extorters have filed bogus claims to the Meta-owned social media platform, then asked for ransoms to withdraw them - knowing repeated claims can lead to account bans.

One Instagram user, who has 1.5 million followers, told the BBC he paid a scammer $50 (£37) to get his account back, claiming Meta's appeal process would take weeks, which had previously cost him thousands in lost income.

"We understand this can be frustrating for those impacted, and our systems are designed to protect people from this happening in the first place," a Meta spokesperson said.

"Following our review, we have restored the affected content and added additional protections to safeguard accounts against further attempts of this kind."

However, content creators the BBC has spoken to say Meta is poor at identifying obviously spurious cases, and say its appeals process is slow to respond unless you pay a monthly fee.

The Lost in Time History Instagram account posts historical pictures to its more than 1.5 million followers.

Its creator Olly, who did not share his last name, told the BBC he posts pictures in the public domain or where he has permission from the rights holder.

Yet he has received dozens of "obviously fake" copyright complaints so far in 2026.

Meta does not check the authenticity of complaints when they are made, so if someone is hit repeatedly, their account can be temporarily taken down.

Olly says he often gets struck for multiple posts at a time, all from the same email address.

He then gets contacted by the person asking to go on to the private messaging app Telegram.

"They'll demand a certain amount of money," he said - usually amounting to a few hundred dollars - to withdraw the claim.

The BBC has seen messages from the claimants where they demand money or threaten future copyright strikes.

This article contains content provided by Instagram. We ask for your permission before anything is loaded, as they may be using cookies and other technologies. You may want to read Meta’s Instagram cookie policy , external and privacy policy , external before accepting. To view this content choose ‘accept and continue’ .

Olly ultimately agreed to pay an extorter $50 in cryptocurrency to restore his account, which had been temporarily taken down by Instagram.

Law enforcement organisations tell extortion victims not to pay ransoms as it fuels the criminal ecosystem.

Olly said he paid as a "last resort" because it was quicker than going through Meta, which could take weeks.

"Having to pay the person who's actively put you through all of that anguish only for it to happen straight away again."

body.zh: Instagram 创作者表示，由于虚假版权声明，他们的账户被暂停或删除，他们损失了数千英镑。 勒索者向 Meta 拥有的社交媒体平台提出虚假索赔，然后要求赎金才能撤回这些索赔 - 他们知道重复索赔可能会导致帐户被禁止。 一位拥有 150 万粉丝的 Instagram 用户告诉 BBC，他向骗子支付了 50 美元（37 英镑）才能取回自己的账户，并声称 Meta 的上诉过程需要数周时间，这此前让他损失了数千美元的收入。 Meta 发言人表示：“我们知道这可能会让受影响的人感到沮丧，我们的系统旨在从一开始就保护人们免受这种情况的影响。” “经过审查，我们已经恢复了受影响的内容，并增加了额外的保护措施，以保护帐户免受此类进一步尝试。” 然而，BBC 采访的内容创作者表示，Meta 不擅长识别明显虚假的案例，并表示其上诉流程反应缓慢，除非您每月支付费用。 “迷失在时间历史”Instagram 帐户向其超过 150 万粉丝发布历史图片。 其创作者奥利（Olly）没有透露自己的姓氏，他告诉英国广播公司（BBC），他在公共领域或获得权利持有者许可的地方发布了照片。 然而，2026 年到目前为止，他已经收到了数十起“明显虚假”的版权投诉。 Meta在提出投诉时不会检查其真实性，因此如果有人多次受到打击，他们的帐户可能会被暂时删除。 奥利说，他经常因为同时发多个帖子而受到打击，而且所有帖子都来自同一个电子邮件地址。 然后有人联系他，要求继续使用私人消息应用程序 Telegram。 “他们会要求一定数额的钱，”他说——通常是几百美元——才能撤回索赔。 英国广播公司 (BBC) 收到了来自原告的信息，他们索要金钱或威胁未来进行版权罢工。 本文包含 Instagram 提供的内容。在加载任何内容之前，我们会征求您的许可，因为它们可能会使用 cookie 和其他技术。在接受之前，您可能需要阅读 Meta 的 Instagram cookie 政策、外部和隐私政策、外部。要查看此内容，请选择“接受并继续”。 Olly 最终同意向勒索者支付 50 美元的加密货币，以恢复他的帐户，该帐户已被 Instagram 暂时关闭。 执法组织告诉勒索受害者不要支付赎金，因为这会助长犯罪生态系统。 奥利说，他付费是“最后的手段”，因为它比通过 Meta 更快，后者可能需要数周时间。 “必须付钱给那些主动让你经历所有这些痛苦的人，结果这种事马上就会再次发生。” 由于数量...

reflection.en: This news highlights how individuals can exploit systems and trust for personal gain, causing harm to others. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that stand in stark contrast to the scammers' deceitful actions.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了个人如何利用系统和信任来谋取私利，从而伤害他人。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则与诈骗者的欺骗行为形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
title.zh: Grindr将支付2600万英镑以解决其涉嫌共享用户艾滋病毒状况的指控

summary.en: The long-running claim alleges Grindr breached UK privacy laws by sharing data with third parties. Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information, including their HIV status, with third parties. The class action suit, which began in 2024, involved over 11,000...
summary.zh: 一项长期存在的诉讼指控Grindr违反英国隐私法，与第三方共享数据。Grindr已同意支付2600万英镑以了结一项诉讼，该诉讼指控其与第三方共享用户个人信息，包括其艾滋病毒状况。该集体诉讼于2024年提起，涉及超过11,000名原告。

body.en:
Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information - including their HIV status - with third parties.

The world's largest LGBTQ+ dating app was sued in the High Court in 2024 over claims it misused people's personal information.

The class action suit was later served in the US, with the law firm leading the case saying it had signed up more than 11,000 claimants.

According to a US regulatory filing, Grindr will make two £13m payments to settle the claims. The firm said the settlement includes no admission of liability.

Grindr stressed the claims relate to "historical data practices" before 2020 when it was owned by Chinese firm Kunlun.

The filing submitted to the US Securities and Exchange Commission , external by Grindr said a settlement had been reached on 2 September.

"While Grindr disputes the allegations, it recognizes and acknowledges the distress and loss of trust expressed by some of its UK users regarding that pre-2020 period," the company said in its filing.

The firm has agreed to pay £13m to the counterparties by 31 December and a further £13m by 31 March 2027.

The claims brought more than two years ago by law firm Austen Hayes alleged Grindr had shared sensitive data with third parties for commercial purposes, breaching UK privacy laws.

It said this included information about the ethnicity and sexual orientation of its users.

People on Grindr have the option to share their HIV status along with when they were last tested - a move it says aims to reduce stigma, facilitate conversations and help users make informed health choices.

Chaya Hanoomanjee, the lawyer who led the claim, said in April 2024 claimants had "experienced significant distress" over their sensitive and private information being shared without their consent.

She said the company "owes it to the LGBTQ+ community it serves to compensate those whose data has been compromised".

Two data analytics services, Apptimize and Localytics, were identified as third parties with access to the sensitive data.

The claim said a potentially unlimited number of third parties used it to customise advertisements to Grindr's users.

It followed revelations in 2018 that Grindr had been sharing personal data, including the HIV status of its users, with the two data analytics providers.

Grindr defended the practice at the time as in line with industry standards – but it said it then stopped sharing HIV data with those companies.

It was fined £5.5m by Norway's data protection watchdog and, later in 2022, reprimanded by the UK Information Commissioner's Office for its data practices.

The company said in its filing on Friday that since 2020, it had "overhauled" its privacy practices to help meet the "unique needs of its...
body.zh: Grindr 已同意支付 2600 万英镑，以了结一项针对其与第三方共享用户个人信息（包括其艾滋病毒状况）的诉讼。 全球最大的 LGBTQ+ 约会应用程序于 2024 年在高等法院被起诉，指控其滥用人们的个人信息。 该集体诉讼后来在美国送达，牵头该案的律​​师事务所表示，已与 11,000 多名索赔人签署了协议。 根据美国监管机构提交的文件，Grindr 将支付两笔 1300 万英镑的款项来和解索赔。该公司表示，和解协议不包括承认责任。 Grindr 强调，这些说法与 2020 年之前的“历史数据实践”有关，当时它属于中国公司昆仑万维。 Grindr 向美国证券交易委员会提交的外部文件称，已于 9 月 2 日达成和解。 该公司在文件中表示：“虽然 Grindr 对这些指控提出异议，但它承认并承认一些英国用户对 2020 年之前的这段时期所表达的痛苦和失去信任。” 该公司已同意在 12 月 31 日之前向交易对手支付 1300 万英镑，并在 2027 年 3 月 31 日之前再支付 1300 万英镑。 两年多前，Austen Hayes 律师事务所提出指控，称 Grindr 出于商业目的与第三方共享敏感数据，违反了英国隐私法。 该公司表示，这包括有关其用户的种族和性取向的信息。 Grindr 上的人们可以选择分享他们的艾滋病毒状况以及最后一次检测的时间——据称此举旨在减少耻辱、促进对话并帮助用户做出明智的健康选择。 主导索赔的律师查亚·哈努曼吉 (Chaya Hanoomanjee) 于 2024 年 4 月表示，索赔人因未经本人同意而分享敏感和私人信息而“经历了巨大的痛苦”。 她表示，该公司“有义务向其所服务的 LGBTQ+ 社区提供补偿，以补偿那些数据遭到泄露的人”。 两个数据分析服务 Apptimize 和 Localytics 被确定为有权访问敏感数据的第三方。 声明称，可能有无限数量的第三方使用它为 Grindr 用户定制广告。 2018 年，有消息称 Grindr 一直与这两家数据分析提供商共享个人数据，包括用户的艾滋病毒状况。 Grindr 当时为这种做法进行了辩护，称其符合行业标准，但它表示随后停止与这些公司共享艾滋病毒数据。 该公司被挪威数据保护监管机构罚款 550 万英镑，并于 2022 年晚些时候因其数据做法受到英国信息专员办公室的谴责。 该公司在周五提交的文件中表示，自 2020 年以来，它“彻底改革”了其隐私做法，以帮助满足“其……的独特需求”。

reflection.en: The news about Grindr settling claims for sharing sensitive user data, including HIV status, highlights a profound breach of trust. It underscores the importance of ethical data handling and accountability, reminding us that true justice requires not only legal settlements but also a commitment to protecting the vulnerable and upholding dignity in all our...
reflection.zh: Grindr因共享包括艾滋病毒状况在内的敏感用户数据而达成和解的消息，凸显了信任的严重破裂。它强调了道德数据处理和问责制的重要性，提醒我们真正的公义不仅需要法律和解，还需要在所有交往中致力于保护弱势群体并维护尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
title.zh: OpenAI首席科学家警告：无人准备好应对AI的后果

summary.en: OpenAI's chief scientist, Jakub Pachocki, has urged extreme caution regarding the rapid progress of artificial intelligence, warning that humanity may not be prepared for its consequences and that intervention might be necessary to maintain human control. This statement follows the release of GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's...
summary.zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki敦促对人工智能的快速发展保持“极端谨慎”，并警告人类可能没有为后果做好准备，可能需要进行干预以维持人类的控制。此声明是在该公司发布其迄今为止最强大的产品GPT-6 Astra之后发布的，此前也有报道称AI代理能够自主行动并发动网络攻击。

body.en:
OpenAI's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has called for "extreme caution" over AI's runaway progress and warned more intervention may be needed to ensure "humans remain in control of the future".

"I am concerned no one is prepared for the consequences of a continued rapid rise in machine intelligence," he wrote in a blog post entitled "An Alien Mind , external ".

The post comes only a few days after the ChatGPT-maker released its latest model GPT-6 Astra, which it called its most powerful product ever.

OpenAI and other AI firms like Anthropic shared reports of their AI agents acting autonomously and carrying out real-world cyber-attacks on other companies.

In July, OpenAI called an incident in which its AI agents - AI systems which can operate alone after human instruction - hacked the tech platform Hugging Face "unprecedented".

Meanwhile in September a report claimed months earlier AI agents from the firm had also hijacked a German website.

"We are facing a transition to a world with incredibly intelligent machines, and we need to ensure that transition works out well for humanity," Pachocki wrote in the latest blog post.

He said OpenAI would continue to "build defensive systems" and seek technical solutions to alignment - a term used to describe ensuring a machine's actions and goals perfectly match human intent and safety guardrails.

Pachocki added one of the firm's main priorities moving forward would be to build an "automated AI researcher" to keep pace with AI progress while ensuring ways that human researchers could remain part of the process.

"Instead of better AI guardrails, regulations, or assurance to keep people safe, they propose developing internal AI agents to research these problems," said Professor Gina Neff, head of the Minderoo Centre for Technology and Democracy at the University of Cambridge.

"Such answers to growing concerns about the problems OpenAI's models are causing for cyber-security, job loss, mistakes, errors and fraud are simply not good enough."

Nathan Calvin, general counsel at the advocacy group Encode AI, said he agreed with Pachocki on the hazards present in advanced AI model development - but he claimed OpenAI was unwilling to be transparent, and said this meant warnings risked being dismissed as "just self-interested hype".

"If Jakub and others at OpenAI want relevant folks in the AI industry to act in concert with them to make things go well, one of the most important things they can do is share far more information about what they are seeing that is making them call for caution," he wrote on X , external .

The European Union's AI Act came into force on 2 August, which requires AI giants like OpenAI to prove their most powerful models cannot autonomously launch cyber-attacks or evade human control...
body.zh: OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 呼吁对人工智能失控的进步“极度谨慎”，并警告称可能需要更多干预以确保“人类仍然掌控未来”。 “我担心没有人对机器智能持续快速增长的后果做好准备，”他在一篇题为“外部的外星人思维”的博客文章中写道。 这篇文章是在 ChatGPT 制造商发布其最新型号 GPT-6 Astra 几天后发布的，该产品被称为有史以来最强大的产品。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等其他人工智能公司分享了他们的人工智能代理自主行动并对其他公司进行现实世界网络攻击的报告。 今年 7 月，OpenAI 称其人工智能代理（可以在人类指令后独立运行的人工智能系统）黑客入侵科技平台 Hugging Face 的事件“史无前例”。 与此同时，9 月份的一份报告称，几个月前该公司的人工智能特工还劫持了一个德国网站。 帕乔基在最新的博客文章中写道：“我们正面临着向一个拥有令人难以置信的智能机器的世界的转变，我们需要确保这种转变对人类有利。” 他表示，OpenAI 将继续“构建防御系统”并寻求技术解决方案来协调——这个术语用于描述确保机器的行为和目标完全符合人类意图和安全护栏。 帕乔基补充说，该公司未来的主要优先事项之一是建立一个“自动化人工智能研究人员”，以跟上人工智能的进步，同时确保人类研究人员能够继续参与这一过程。 剑桥大学明德鲁技术与民主中心主任吉娜·内夫教授表示：“他们建议开发内部人工智能代理来研究这些问题，而不是更好的人工智能护栏、法规或保障人员安全。” “对于 OpenAI 模型引发的网络安全、失业、错误和欺诈等问题日益引起的担忧，这样的答案根本不够好。” Encode AI 倡导组织的总法律顾问 Nathan Calvin 表示，他同意 Pachocki 关于高级 AI 模型开发中存在危险的观点，但他声称 OpenAI 不愿意保持透明，并表示这意味着警告可能会被视为“只是自私的炒作”而被驳回。 “如果 Jakub 和 OpenAI 的其他人希望人工智能行业的相关人士与他们合作，让事情顺利进行，他们能做的最重要的事情之一就是分享更多关于他们所看到的信息，这些信息让他们呼吁谨慎，”他在 X 外部写道。 欧盟人工智能法案于8月2日生效，该法案要求像OpenAI这样的人工智能巨头证明他们最强大的模型无法自主发起网络攻击或逃避人类控制……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as highlighted by OpenAI's chief scientist, presents a profound challenge. While human ingenuity can create powerful tools, the proverb reminds us that true character is revealed not just in creation, but in how we handle the praise and potential power that comes with it. The question remains whether we will exercise wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如OpenAI首席科学家所指出的，提出了一个深刻的挑战。虽然人类的创造力可以创造出强大的工具，但这句箴言提醒我们，真正的品格不仅体现在创造本身，也体现在我们如何处理随之而来的赞誉和潜在的力量。问题仍然是，我们将如何运用智慧和克制，确保这些进步服务于人类，而不是压倒人类。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: The complex corporate web behind a $3.2 billion AI data center
title.zh: 32亿美元人工智能数据中心背后的复杂企业网络

summary.en: When multiple companies are behind one project, who bears responsibility for problems? A fire at the Lake Mariner data center in Somerset, New York, revealed that the local fire department lacked crucial safety information, including working alarms, suppression systems, and chemical identification sheets, due to the...
summary.zh: 当多个公司共同承担一个项目时，谁应该为出现的问题负责？纽约州萨默塞特市的莱克马里纳数据中心发生火灾，暴露了当地消防部门对项目情况知之甚少。据报道，消防员发现现场没有工作的警报系统、没有灭火系统，并且有三个消防栓无法使用；他们依法有权查看的安全文件据称在火灾中被烧毁。

body.en: In early June, a fire broke out in a still-unfinished building at the Lake Mariner data center in Somerset, New York, exposing just how little the local fire department knew about what it was walking into. Firefighters reportedly found no working alarm, no suppression system, and three dead hydrants; the safety documents they’re legally entitled to see reportedly burned up in the blaze. Steve Matisz, chief of the Barker Fire Department, said his crew went into the building “kind of blind,” facing heavy black smoke from chemicals they couldn’t identify because the safety sheets meant to inform them had apparently burned up. “It’s been a difficult situation,” Matisz said. He wasn't sure what to think about the claim that the safety sheets had burned in the fire. The site is a former coal mine on Lake Ontario. The $3.2 billion campus is one of the largest AI data center buildouts in New York, and it has many stakeholders. A company called TeraWulf owns and operates the data center on land it leases from a company owned by its own CEO; Fluidstack, a UK-based AI company, will run the center; Google holds warrants for a future 14 percent equity stake and has agreed to guarantee Fluidstack’s lease payments; and Anthropic is among the AI companies whose compute demand the facility exists to serve. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 六月初，纽约萨默塞特湖水手数据中心一栋尚未完工的建筑发生火灾，这暴露了当地消防部门对所走进的情况知之甚少。据报道，消防队员发现警报器没有工作，灭火系统也没有，三个消防栓已失效；据报道，他们依法有权查看的安全文件在大火中被烧毁。巴克消防局局长史蒂夫·马蒂斯 (Steve Matisz) 表示，他的消防队员“有点盲目”地进入了大楼，面对着他们无法识别的化学物质产生的浓黑烟雾，因为用来通知他们的安全单显然已经被烧毁。 “这是一个困难的局面，”马蒂斯说。他不知道如何看待安全布在火灾中被烧毁的说法。该地点以前是安大略湖上的一个煤矿。这个耗资 32 亿美元的园区是纽约最大的人工智能数据中心扩建项目之一，拥有许多利益相关者。一家名为 TeraWulf 的公司在其从其首席执行官拥有的公司租赁的土地上拥有并运营该数据中心；总部位于英国的人工智能公司 Fluidstack 将负责运营该中心；谷歌持有未来 14% 股权的认股权证，并同意为 Fluidstack 的租赁付款提供担保； Anthropic 是其设施满足计算需求的人工智能公司之一。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The fire at the Lake Mariner data center, with its lack of basic safety information for first responders, underscores a fundamental responsibility: those who build and operate facilities must ensure the safety and well-being of their communities. Jeremiah 22:3 calls for justice and righteousness in leadership, which includes providing essential information...
reflection.zh: 莱克马里纳数据中心发生的火灾，以及消防员缺乏基本安全信息的情况，凸显了一项基本责任：建造和运营设施的各方必须确保其社区的安全和福祉。《耶利米书》22:3呼吁领导者秉持公义和正直，这包括在危机时刻为所有相关人员提供基本信息并确保安全。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: German company becomes first in Europe to launch fully commercial orbital rocket
title.zh: 德国公司成为欧洲首家成功发射商业轨道火箭的公司

summary.en: Isar Aerospace, founded in 2018 by university students, successfully launched its privately developed Spectrum rocket into low-Earth orbit from Norway. This marks the first fully commercial orbital launch by a European company, positioning Isar as a leader among European space startups aiming to invigorate the...
summary.zh: Isar Aerospace公司由几名大学生于2018年创立，于周六成功地从挪威发射了其私自开发的Spectrum火箭进入近地轨道。这是欧洲公司首次实现全商业化轨道发射，使Isar在众多旨在重振欧洲发射市场的欧洲航天初创公司中处于领先地位。

body.en: Isar Aerospace, founded in 2018 by three students at a German university, successfully launched a privately developed rocket into low-Earth orbit Saturday from a Norwegian spaceport inside the Arctic Circle. The two-stage rocket, named Spectrum, became the first fully commercial launch vehicle in Europe to reach orbit. With Saturday's success, Isar is the clear leader among a pack of several European launch startups vying to inject some competition into Europe's stagnant launch market. Isar's 92-foot-tall (28-meter) Spectrum rocket lifted off at 4:12 pm EST (20:12 UTC) Saturday from Andøya Spaceport in northern Norway, where it was 10:12 pm local time and the final bluish hues of daylight faded from the late summer sky. Seven minutes later, the rocket was in orbit. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Isar Aerospace 公司于 2018 年由德国一所大学的三名学生创立，周六从北极圈内的挪威航天港成功将一枚私人开发的火箭发射到近地轨道。这艘名为 Spectrum 的两级火箭成为欧洲第一个进入轨道的完全商业运载火箭。凭借周六的成功，Isar 成为众多欧洲发射初创公司中明显的领导者，这些初创公司竞相为欧洲停滞不前的发射市场注入一些竞争。伊萨尔高 92 英尺（28 米）的 Spectrum 火箭于周六下午 4 点 12 分（世界标准时间 20 点 12 分）从挪威北部的安多亚太空港升空，当时是当地时间晚上 10 点 12 分，日光最后的蓝色色调从夏末的天空褪去。七分钟后，火箭进入轨道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The successful launch of Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket is a testament to human ingenuity and perseverance. It echoes the sentiment of Proverbs 16:3, which encourages committing one's endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that plans will succeed through divine guidance. This achievement, born from a small team's vision, reminds us that dedication and faith can...
reflection.zh: Isar Aerospace公司Spectrum火箭的成功发射，是人类智慧和毅力的证明。它呼应了箴言16:3的观点，该经文鼓励将人的劳碌交托给雅伟，相信所谋定的事，他必成就。这项由一个小团队的愿景所成就的成就，提醒我们，奉献和信心可以带来非凡的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Why is Amazonian wildlife turning up at a Bangkok market?
title.zh: 亚马逊野生动物为何出现在曼谷市场？

summary.en: In Bangkok's Chatuchak Market, hundreds of exotic species from around the world are sold, some of which are crammed into cages with inadequate conditions, making it one of the largest wildlife markets globally.
summary.zh: 在曼谷的乍都乍市场，来自世界各地的数百种外来物种被出售，其中一些被挤在条件恶劣的笼子里，使其成为全球最大的野生动物市场之一。

body.en: BANGKOK, Thailand — In the narrow alleys of Bangkok’s Chatuchak Market, the world’s wildlife is for sale. Ensnared in jungles, fished out of rivers and plucked from wetlands across the globe, hundreds of exotic species are packed onto transcontinental flights only to end up on display in what experts say ranks as one of the largest wildlife markets on Earth. Here, alongside Thai milk tea vendors and mango sticky rice stalls, visitors need only veer a few steps from the tourist path to end up in the market’s “Pets” zone — an arguably liberal use of the term. This section of the market hosts a menagerie of domestic and wild animals alike, often crammed into cages with little water and no respite from temperatures that soar beyond 32° Celsius (90° Fahrenheit). From Africa, there are spurred tortoises, fennec foxes, gray parrots, serval cats, and ball pythons. Giant bush babies retail for 48,000 baht (about $1,450), with signs advertising the nocturnal African primates as “newly arrived.” Miniscule meerkats dressed in tutus, sometimes presented in petting zoo sandboxes, are among the most plentiful animals at Chatuchak. Masked palm civets, sugar gliders, squirrels, rainbow lorikeets, and eclectus parrots are on offer from Asia and Oceania. As are baby raccoons, prairie dogs, iguanas, goats, cats, baby pigs, among others. Much of the planet is represented in this market; meerkats, like the one pictured here, hail from Southern Africa and are dressed up to be sold as an adorable pet. Image by Gloria Dickie. To…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 泰国曼谷——在曼谷乍都乍市场的狭窄小巷里，出售世界各地的野生动物。数百种外来物种被困在丛林中、从河流中捕鱼、从湿地中捕获，被装上横贯大陆的航班，最后却在专家所说的地球上最大的野生动物市场之一中展出。在这里，除了泰国奶茶小贩和芒果糯米摊之外，游客只需离开旅游路线几步，就可以到达市场的“宠物”区——可以说是对这个词的自由使用。市场的这个区域饲养着各种家养动物和野生动物，它们常常被关在没有水的笼子里，而且在超过 32 摄氏度（90 华氏度）的气温下无法休息。来自非洲的有刺龟、耳廓狐、灰鹦鹉、薮猫和球蟒。巨型丛林幼崽的零售价为 48,000 泰铢（约合 1,450 美元），标牌上将这种夜间活动的非洲灵长类动物宣传为“新来的”。身着芭蕾舞短裙的小型猫鼬有时会出现在宠物动物园的沙箱中，它们是恰图恰 (Chatuchak) 数量最多的动物之一。来自亚洲和大洋洲的果子狸、蜜袋鼯、松鼠、彩虹吸蜜鹦鹉和折衷鹦鹉。还有小浣熊、土拨鼠、鬣蜥、山羊、猫、小猪等。这个市场代表了地球上的大部分地区；猫鼬，就像图中的猫鼬一样，来自南非，它们被打扮成可爱的宠物出售。图片由格洛丽亚·迪基拍摄。致……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The bustling Chatuchak Market in Bangkok, a place of commerce and culture, also harbors a dark trade in exotic wildlife. These animals, plucked from their natural habitats across the globe, are unable to speak for themselves or advocate for their own well-being. The verse from Proverbs calls us to lend our voice to the voiceless, to defend the rights of...
reflection.zh: 曼谷乍都乍市场是一个充满商业和文化气息的地方，但也隐藏着非法野生动物交易的阴暗面。这些动物被从全球各地的自然栖息地捕获，它们无法为自己发声或争取福祉。箴言中的经文呼吁我们为那些不能发声的群体发出声音，为那些脆弱和被剥削者的权利辩护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘Plastic pollution hotspots’ spawn a public health crisis across Latin America
title.zh: “塑料污染热点”在拉丁美洲引发公共卫生危机

summary.en: Since China's 2018 ban on plastic waste imports, Latin America has seen a surge in plastic pollution, overwhelming existing waste management systems. Research indicates that much of this imported plastic is escaping into the environment, posing significant risks to human health and ecosystems across the region.
summary.zh: 自2018年中国禁止进口塑料垃圾以来，拉丁美洲的塑料污染日益严重，使该地区本已不堪重负的废物处理系统雪上加霜。研究表明，大量进口塑料垃圾正泄漏到环境中，对该地区人民的健康和生态系统构成重大威胁。

body.en: Since China banned the import of plastic waste in 2018, plastic pollution has been having a growing impact on the people and ecosystems of Latin America. As the region imports an increasing amount of the world’s used and discarded plastic, new research shows that waste infrastructure in many countries is already buckling under the strain of dealing with domestic trash. As a result, much of the imported plastic is leaking out into the environment, with experts and the U.N. warning of major consequences for human health. A study published in April found that seven countries in the region — the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, and Paraguay — have become plastic pollution hotspots, or PPHs, where high imports of low-quality plastics meet high rates of mismanaged waste. Global plastic waste generation reached 353 million metric tons in 2019 alone, of which 72% ended up being landfilled or dumped and just 9% was recycled, according to an OECD report. Much of the world’s plastic waste was previously destined for China, but in 2018 the country banned those imports. While Malaysia and Thailand took up much of the slack, Latin America also started importing more plastic waste, although the region has historically been an importer of difficult-to-recycle plastics. “Certain countries in Latin America have started importing more waste but they haven’t actually got the capacity to deal with [it],” Veronica Herrera, lead author of April study and an associate professor at the Luskin School of Public Affairs at the University…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 自2018年中国禁止塑料垃圾进口以来，塑料污染对拉美人民和生态系统的影响日益加大。随着该地区进口世界上越来越多的废旧塑​​料，新的研究表明，许多国家的废物基础设施已经在处理家庭垃圾的压力下不堪重负。结果，大部分进口塑料泄漏到环境中，专家和联合国警告这会对人类健康造成重大后果。 4月份发表的一项研究发现，该地区的七个国家——多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、墨西哥、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和巴拉圭——已成为塑料污染热点（PPH），这些国家大量进口劣质塑料，而废物管理不善的比例很高。经合组织的一份报告显示，仅 2019 年，全球塑料垃圾产生量就达到 3.53 亿吨，其中 72% 最终被填埋或倾倒，只有 9% 被回收。此前，世界上大部分塑料垃圾都运往中国，但中国于 2018 年禁止进口。虽然马来西亚和泰国填补了大部分空缺，但拉丁美洲也开始进口更多塑料废物，尽管该地区历来是难以回收塑料的进口国。 “拉丁美洲的某些国家已经开始进口更多废物，但他们实际上没有能力处理[它]，”四月份研究的主要作者、拉斯金大学公共事务学院副教授维罗妮卡·埃雷拉（Veronica Herrera）……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The Earth, a gift from Yahweh, groans under the weight of our discarded materials. As plastic waste overwhelms Latin America's infrastructure, it serves as a stark reminder of our responsibility to care for creation. May we seek wise solutions that honor the delicate balance of the environment Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 雅伟所赐的地球，正承受着我们丢弃物质的重担。塑料垃圾压垮了拉丁美洲的基础设施，这鲜明地提醒我们有责任照管受造物。愿我们寻求智慧的解决方案，以荣耀雅伟所托付给我们的、脆弱的环境平衡。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: One in 12 golf clubs in England broke water extraction rules in past five years
title.zh: 英格兰近五分之一高尔夫球俱乐部在过去五年中违反了用水规定

summary.en: Analysis reveals that over 140 golf clubs in England violated their water extraction licenses in the last five years, with more than a third taking water illegally. Despite these breaches, no fines have been issued.
summary.zh: 根据《卫报》的数据分析，过去五年里，英格兰有超过140家高尔夫俱乐部违反了其用水许可规定，其中超过三分之一的俱乐部非法取水。尽管存在违规行为，但并未处以罚款。

body.en: More than 140 clubs breached licences, with a third caught taking water illegally, analysis shows – but no fines issued More than 140 golf clubs in England have breached their water extraction licences in the past five years, according to data analysis by the Guardian. More than a third of these clubs were caught taking water illegally from the environment, either by taking more than permitted or by removing it outside the permitted period. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析显示，超过 140 个俱乐部违反了取水许可证，其中三分之一被发现非法取水，但没有被处以罚款 根据《卫报》的数据分析，过去五年，英格兰有超过 140 个高尔夫俱乐部违反了取水许可证。其中超过三分之一的俱乐部被发现从环境中非法取水，要么超过允许的取水量，要么在允许的期限之外取水。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that over 140 golf clubs in England have broken water extraction rules, with many taking water illegally, raises questions about accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, especially when managing precious resources like water. The absence of fines for these breaches suggests a gap in...
reflection.zh: 《卫报》的报道指出，英格兰有超过140家高尔夫俱乐部违反了用水规定，其中许多俱乐部非法取水，这引发了关于问责制的问题。弥迦书6章8节提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉公行义，喜爱怜悯，尤其是在管理宝贵的水资源时。对这些违规行为未处以罚款，表明在确保公正和负责任的管家职分方面存在不足。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Crocodile head found in luggage at Italian airport
title.zh: 意大利机场行李中发现鳄鱼头

summary.en: An Italian man faces legal consequences after the dried head of a critically endangered crocodile was discovered in his luggage at Turin's Caselle airport. He had traveled from Miami via Istanbul and is now under investigation for smuggling, potentially facing fines or imprisonment.
summary.zh: 一名意大利男子在都灵卡塞莱机场的行李中发现了一只濒危鳄鱼的干头后，正面临法律制裁。他此前乘坐从迈阿密经伊斯坦布尔的航班抵达，目前因走私罪受到调查，可能面临罚款或监禁。

body.en: Man, who had arrived in Turin from Miami via Istanbul, under investigation for smuggling and faces fine or prison An Italian man is facing a hefty fine or possible prison term after the dried head of a critically endangered crocodile was found in his luggage at Turin’s Caselle airport. The man had arrived at the airport in the northern Italian city on a flight from Miami via Istanbul, the Turin unit of Italy’s financial police squad said in a statement. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一名意大利男子从迈阿密经伊斯坦布尔抵达都灵，因走私受到调查，将面临罚款或入狱一名意大利男子在都灵卡塞勒机场的行李中发现了一只极度濒危鳄鱼的干头，他将面临巨额罚款或可能入狱。意大利金融警察小队都灵分队在一份声明中表示，这名男子乘坐从迈阿密经伊斯坦布尔飞往意大利北部城市的机场。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of a critically endangered crocodile head in luggage points to a profound disrespect for the natural world and the creatures within it. This act of smuggling, driven by greed or ignorance, stands in stark contrast to the biblical call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh, recognizing the inherent value of all creation.
reflection.zh: 在行李中发现一只濒危鳄鱼的干头，这显示了对自然世界及其生物的极大不尊重。这种走私行为，无论出于贪婪还是无知，都与圣经中呼吁的秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑同行于雅伟的教导形成鲜明对比，提醒我们要认识到万物固有的价值。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: US datacenters face further backlash over wastewater pollution
title.zh: 美国数据中心因废水污染面临进一步抨击

summary.en: From rare bacteria to ‘forever chemicals’, a series of cases of violations or alleged pollution has prompted alarm. When officials in Wyoming conducted a routine test on the water that was being discharged from a massive under-construction Meta datacenter, it was a shock to find it contained a rare and potentially...
summary.zh: 从罕见细菌到“永久化学品”，一系列违规或涉嫌污染的案件引起了警报。当怀俄明州官员对一个大规模在建的Meta数据中心排放的水进行例行检测时，他们震惊地发现水中含有一种罕见且可能有害的细菌。

body.en: From rare bacteria to ‘forever chemicals’, a series of cases of violations or alleged pollution has prompted alarm When officials in Wyoming conducted a routine test on the water that was being discharged from a massive under-construction Meta datacenter, it was a shock to find it contained a rare and potentially hazardous bacterium. While the wastewater flushed into sewers in Cheyenne, Wyoming, was never destined for the public drinking supply, the presence of Cupriavidus gilardii bacterium in 801,000 gallons of water ejected by a contractor for the datacenter earlier this year was still unnerving. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从罕见细菌到“永远的化学物质”，一系列违规或涉嫌污染的案件引起了警惕。当怀俄明州官员对正在建设的大型元数据中心排出的水进行例行测试时，令人震惊地发现其中含有一种罕见且具有潜在危险的细菌。虽然冲入怀俄明州夏延下水道的废水从未用于公共饮用水供应，但今年早些时候数据中心承包商排出的 801,000 加仑水中含有吉拉德铜菌细菌，这仍然令人不安。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of Cupriavidus gilardii in Meta's wastewater in Wyoming serves as a stark reminder of the intricate and sometimes hazardous elements within creation. Psalm 104:24 marvels at the diversity and wisdom evident in all of God's works, urging us to approach our stewardship of the earth with care and respect for its hidden complexities.
reflection.zh: 在怀俄明州Meta数据中心废水中发现吉拉氏铜绿假单胞菌，这鲜明地提醒我们，造物中有许多复杂且有时危险的元素。诗篇104:24赞叹雅伟一切作为中显明的多样性和智慧，促使我们以谨慎和尊重其内在复杂性的态度来管理大地。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Nearly Half of Farmers Globally Poisoned by Pesticides Each Year
title.zh: 全球近一半农民每年遭受农药中毒

summary.en: A study has found that nearly half of the world's farmers, approximately 46% of the global farming population, suffer from unintentional acute pesticide poisoning each year, with an estimated 402 to 433 million cases annually.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，全球近一半的农民，约占全球农民总人口的46%，每年都会遭受意外的急性农药中毒，估计每年有4.02亿至4.33亿例。

body.en:
This article was originally published by The Guardian and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found.

Using publicly available data from 2006 to 2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network, found there to be an estimated 402 to 433 million cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year.

Based on a worldwide farming population of 934 million, this means approximately 46 percent of farmers are being poisoned every year. The greatest estimated number of poisonings was in South Asia, followed by Southeast Asia and East Africa.

The overall highest national incidence of poisoning was in Burkina Faso in West Africa, where nearly 84 percent of farmers and farm workers were reported to have experienced poisoning.

The study, published in the journal Frontiers in Public Health , also found that an estimated 11,000 deaths occur every year due to pesticide poisoning, with nearly 60 percent of these in India.

Jayakumar Chelaton, the executive director of Pesticide Action Network India, said the research exposed a “crisis that can no longer be ignored.”

The authors of the study are calling for “immediate action,” including the implementation of a U.N. recommendation to phase out highly hazardous pesticides.

The study states that despite global efforts to highlight the dangers, pesticide use has continued to grow steadily, with 3.8 million metric tons used in 2023, a doubling since 1990.

Sheila Willis, the head of international programs at Pesticide Action Network U.K., said: “Now that the scale of suffering has been revealed, farmers must be supported to access safer alternatives to protect their health and that of their families.”

The study did not consider the impact of pesticide exposure on the estimated 84 million children working in agriculture and did not look at the long-term health impacts, with acute pesticide poisoning defined in the study as any illness or health effect experienced a short time after exposure.

Génon Jensen, the executive director of the Health and Environment Alliance, said: “We are extremely concerned about the devastating health impacts from pesticide poisonings — both the acute impacts mentioned in this study but also chronic exposures that farm workers and communities suffer.”

Hélène Nicora, the director general of Parkinson’s Europe, said there was also “overwhelming evidence” to suggest that Parkinson’s was an environmentally driven disease, with growing evidence linking pesticide exposure to the development of Parkinson’s.

Parkinson’s disease is a progressive disorder in which parts of the brain become damaged over time, affecting...
body.zh: 本文最初由《卫报》发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 一项研究发现，世界上每年有近一半的农民遭受农药中毒。 这项受农药行动网络委托进行的研究利用 2006 年至 2023 年的公开数据发现，每年估计有 402 至 4.33 亿起农民和农场工人意外急性农药中毒病例。 根据全球 9.34 亿农业人口，这意味着每年约有 46% 的农民遭受中毒。据估计，中毒人数最多的是南亚，其次是东南亚和东非。 全国中毒发生率最高的是西非的布基纳法索，据报道该国近 84% 的农民和农场工人曾经历过中毒。 这项发表在《公共卫生前沿》杂志上的研究还发现，估计每年有 11,000 人因农药中毒死亡，其中近 60% 发生在印度。 印度农药行动网络执行董事贾古玛·切拉顿表示，这项研究暴露了一场“不能再忽视的危机”。 该研究的作者呼吁“立即采取行动”，包括实施联合国逐步淘汰高危险农药的建议。 该研究指出，尽管全球努力强调其危险，但农药的使用量仍在稳步增长，2023 年使用量为 380 万吨，比 1990 年翻了一番。 英国农药行动网络国际项目负责人希拉·威利斯表示：“既然苦难的规模已经暴露，必须支持农民获得更安全的替代方案，以保护他们及其家人的健康。” 该研究没有考虑农药接触对大约 8400 万从事农业工作的儿童的影响，也没有考虑长期健康影响，研究中将急性农药中毒定义为接触农药后短时间内出现的任何疾病或健康影响。 健康与环境联盟执行董事杰农·延森 (Génon Jensen) 表示：“我们非常担心农药中毒对健康造成的破坏性影响——既包括本研究中提到的急性影响，也包括农场工人和社区遭受的长期接触。” 帕金森病欧洲分会总干事海伦·尼科拉表示，还有“压倒性的证据”表明帕金森病是一种环境驱动的疾病，越来越多的证据表明接触农药与帕金森病的发生有关。 帕金森病是一种进行性疾病，随着时间的推移，大脑的某些部分会受到损害，影响...

reflection.en: The sheer scale of this annual poisoning—hundreds of millions of farmers—speaks to the deep entanglement of human activity and the natural world. It is a stark reminder that our innovations, meant to sustain us, can also bring harm. The Psalmist marvels at the wisdom woven into creation, urging us to recognize Yahweh's hand in all things, and to act with...
reflection.zh: 每年有数亿农民遭受中毒的惨状，这凸显了人类活动与自然世界之间深刻的纠缠。它严峻地提醒我们，我们旨在维持生存的创新，也可能带来伤害。诗篇作者惊叹于创造中编织的智慧，敦促我们认识到雅伟在万物中的作为，并以关爱祂所建立的微妙平衡来行事。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘Birds know no borders’: Interview with BirdLife Africa’s Alex Ngari
title.zh: “鸟儿没有国界”：与非洲鸟盟的亚历克斯·恩加里对话

summary.en: Each year, millions of birds from hundreds of species migrate between their European and Asian breeding grounds and their non-breeding habitats in Africa. Scientists have surprisingly limited knowledge about the specific destinations of many species and the risks they face during migration. For instance, populations...
summary.zh: 每年，数百万只属于数百个物种的鸟类在欧洲和亚洲的繁殖地与非洲的非繁殖栖息地之间迁徙。科学家们对许多物种的确切去向以及迁徙过程中面临的风险和障碍的了解却出奇地稀少。例如，在北半球冬季，繁殖地在西伯利亚的易危杓鹬的种群遍布从南亚到东非和南非的地区。非洲鸟盟的亚历克斯·恩加里强调，迁徙鸟类不属于任何一个国家，而是我们共同的全...

body.en: Every year, twice a year, millions of birds belonging to hundreds of species fly between breeding grounds in Europe and Asia and their non-breeding habitats in Africa. Scientists have surprisingly sparse knowledge of exactly where many species actually go — or what risks and obstacles the migrating birds encounter along the way. Populations of the vulnerable curlew sandpiper, which breeds in in Siberia, for example, appear everywhere from South Asia to East and Southern Africa during the northern hemisphere winter. “One important fact that we all need to understand is that migratory birds do not belong to any one country, but are a shared global heritage, and their survival requires a borderless safety net,” says Alex Ngari, who manages the migratory birds and flyways program for BirdLife Africa. “These birds know no borders, which means that the conservation methods that we develop must be aware of that fact, and every country has a responsibility to protect them.” Until recently, what monitoring there was relied on ringing — but piecing together birds’ year-long itinerary depends on where someone encounters a ringed bird, on that person knowing what the band on its leg means, and details of the encounter reaching some coordinating authority. As lighter and more reliable electronic tags that can be fitted to birds to record and broadcast their locations have become available, researchers have started to gather more detailed information about migratory pathways. This type of tracking is still relatively expensive, however, especially for tags small enough for small-bodied…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 每年两次，属于数百个物种的数百万只鸟类在欧洲和亚洲的繁殖地与非洲的非繁殖栖息地之间飞行。令人惊讶的是，科学家们对许多物种的实际去向或候鸟沿途遇到的风险和障碍知之甚少。例如，在北半球冬季，在西伯利亚繁殖的脆弱麻鹬种群会出现在从南亚到东部和南部非洲的各个地方。 “我们都需要了解的一个重要事实是，候鸟不属于任何一个国家，而是全球共同的遗产，它们的生存需要无国界的安全网，”管理非洲鸟盟候鸟和飞行路线项目的亚历克斯·恩加里（Alex Ngari）说。 “这些鸟类没有国界，这意味着我们开发的保护方法必须意识到这一事实，每个国家都有责任保护它们。”直到最近，那里的监控仍然依赖于环纹——但拼凑出鸟类一年的行程取决于有人在哪里遇到了环纹鸟，这个人知道它腿上的带子意味着什么，以及相遇的细节到达了一些协调机构。随着可以安装在鸟类身上以记录和广播其位置的更轻、更可靠的电子标签的出现，研究人员已经开始收集有关迁徙路径的更详细信息。然而，这种类型的跟踪仍然相对昂贵，特别是对于小体型的标签来说……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The article quotes Alex Ngari stating, 'migratory birds do not belong to any one country, but are a shared global heritage.' This perspective resonates with the biblical understanding that all creation, including the creatures that traverse continents and oceans, ultimately belongs to the Creator. The vast, unhindered journeys of these birds remind us that...
reflection.zh: 文章引用亚历克斯·恩加里的话说：“迁徙鸟类不属于任何一个国家，而是我们共同的全球遗产。”这一观点与圣经中关于所有受造物，包括跨越大陆和海洋的生物，最终都属于造物主的理解不谋而合。这些鸟类浩瀚无垠、不受阻碍的旅程提醒我们，国界是人为的建构，而大地及其万物都属于雅伟的权下。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: ‘So big and so close’: spotting endangered bears on a trip to northern Spain
title.zh: “如此之大，如此之近”：在西班牙北部进行一次熊的狩猎之旅

summary.en: Conservationists have helped Cantabrian brown bears claw their way back from the edge of extinction in the beautiful mountains of Asturias – and carefully controlled nature tourism allows visitors to see them. Once upon a time, in the woods outside Pola de Somiedo, lived a family of Cantabrian brown bears. The...
summary.zh: 在阿斯图里亚斯美丽的山区，保护主义者帮助坎塔布连棕熊从灭绝的边缘重新崛起——精心控制的自然旅游让游客得以一睹它们的风采。很久很久以前，在波拉德索米多镇外的森林里，住着一家坎塔布连棕熊。村民们报告说，他们看到了一只腿被猎人陷阱夹断的母熊，带着她的两只幼崽和两只成年雄性，其中任何一只都可能是它们的父亲。在 20 世纪...

body.en: Conservationists have helped Cantabrian brown bears claw their way back from the edge of extinction in the beautiful mountains of Asturias – and carefully controlled nature tourism allows visitors to see them Once upon a time, in the woods outside Pola de Somiedo, lived a family of Cantabrian brown bears. The villagers reported sightings of a mother bear who had lost a leg to a hunter’s trap, her two cubs and two adult males, either of which might have been the father. In those days, at the end of the 1980s, they seemed to be the last of their kind in this part of Asturias. Meanwhile, the wider population dropped to about 60 bears across the surrounding Cantabrian mountain range that gave the species its name. They have since clawed their way back from the edge of extinction here in northern Spain, and nature guide Luis Frechilla believes their numbers may now be upwards of 500 again. “They’re still classed as endangered,” he tells me, until the official count hits 1,000. But relative abundance makes them much easier to see today in Somiedo natural park – one of Spain’s first such protected areas, established in 1988. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自然资源保护主义者帮助坎塔布连棕熊在阿斯图里亚斯美丽的山脉中从灭绝的边缘恢复过来，精心控制的自然旅游让游客可以看到它们。 很久以前，在波拉德索米多郊外的树林里，住着一个坎塔布连棕熊家族。村民们报告称，有人目击到一只被猎人设下的陷阱失去了一条腿的母熊、她的两只幼崽和两只成年雄熊，其中任何一只都可能是熊爸爸。在 20 世纪 80 年代末的那些日子里，他们似乎是阿斯图里亚斯这一地区最后的同类。与此同时，周围坎塔布连山脉的熊数量减少到大约 60 只，该物种也因此得名。此后，它们在西班牙北部从灭绝的边缘奋力挣扎，自然导游路易斯·弗雷奇拉 (Luis Frechilla) 相信，它们的数量现在可能再次超过 500 只。 “它们仍然被列为濒危物种，”他告诉我，直到官方数量达到 1,000 只。但相对丰富的资源使得如今在索米多自然公园（1988 年建立的西班牙第一个此类保护区之一）更容易看到它们。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The remarkable recovery of the Cantabrian brown bears from near extinction is a testament to dedicated conservation efforts. It reminds us of the intricate wisdom woven into the fabric of creation, a wisdom that, when respected and protected, allows life to flourish even after facing dire threats. Witnessing these magnificent creatures, once on the brink,...
reflection.zh: 坎塔布连棕熊从濒临灭绝的边缘令人瞩目的恢复，是致力于保护工作的证明。它提醒我们，在造物的结构中编织着精妙的智慧，这种智慧在受到尊重和保护时，即使在面临严峻威胁后也能让生命蓬勃发展。目睹这些曾经处于绝境的雄伟生物如今茁壮成长，给人带来深刻的希望感，并呼吁我们珍惜自然世界。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

The bioluminescent beams of “fairy folk” are shining again from a nature reserve in North Yorkshire for the first time in a century after the successful reintroduction of endangered glowworms.
